models.name: A-Frame Chalkboard Sign
models.description: A folding A frame sidewalk sign about 1 m tall with blank chalkboard faces in oak frames, ready for a menu or specials.

models.name: Abandoned Folding Wheelchair
models.description: Folding steel wheelchair about 1 m tall with a sagging vinyl sling seat and large rear wheels that turn. Pitted chrome, rust and grime.

models.name: Abandoned Fuel Station
models.description: Abandoned roadside fuel station on a cracked 20 x 12 m forecourt. A canopy with a peeling fascia and torn soffit panels hanging down, toppled pumps, a boarded-up kiosk with a broken door, a blank sign pylon and weeds in the cracks.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Abandoned Hospital Gurney
models.description: Wheeled hospital gurney about 2 m long with a stained vinyl mattress and a back section that raises. Pitted chrome frame, rust and grime from years of neglect.

models.name: Abandoned Hospital Set
models.description: Six abandoned hospital props: a wheeled gurney with a stained mattress and raised back, a folding wheelchair, an IV stand, a steel instrument trolley, a privacy screen with torn curtains and a tipped-over steel cabinet. Pitted chrome, chipped enamel, rust and grime.

models.name: Abandoned Instrument Trolley
models.description: Steel instrument trolley about 0.7 m wide and 1 m tall on casters, with a kidney dish and instruments on the top shelf and a tray of rusty water below. Grimy and rusting.

models.name: Abandoned IV Stand
models.description: Wheeled IV drip stand about 2 m tall with hooks for bags at the top. Pitted chrome pole on a castor base, rusty and grimy.

models.name: Abandoned Warehouse Interior
models.description: An abandoned 20 x 30 m brick warehouse hall seen from inside, open at one end. Rusted roof trusses, broken rooflights and a torn roof let daylight onto puddles, peeling walls, collapsed pallet racking, debris, a roller door jammed half open and a wrecked mezzanine office.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Abstract Painted Canvas
models.description: An abstract painting on a stretched canvas, 80 by 60 cm and 3 cm deep, with no frame. Loose strokes of blue, ochre and white with raised paint and a few metallic flecks, wrapped round the edges.

models.name: AC Unit Cluster
models.description: Outdoor air conditioner units for building walls, 0.8 m wide, as four separate groups: on ground stands, on a wall bracket, on a two-tier frame and a cluster of three. Weathered ivory casings with fan grilles, taped pipes and wall ducts, streaked with grime and rust.

models.name: Group of Three Air Conditioners
models.description: Three outdoor air conditioner units, one on a wall bracket and two on ground blocks, with pipes and wall ducts, about 2.4 m wide and 2.9 m tall. Weathered ivory casings with grime and rust.

models.name: Air Conditioner on Ground Blocks
models.description: Outdoor air conditioner unit 0.8 m wide standing on low blocks, with taped pipes running up a wall duct about 2.4 m high. Weathered ivory casing with a fan grille, grime and rust streaks.

models.name: Air Conditioner on Wall Bracket
models.description: Outdoor air conditioner unit 0.8 m wide on a steel wall bracket, with taped pipes and a short duct. Weathered ivory casing with a fan grille, grime and rust streaks.

models.name: Air Conditioners on Two-Tier Frame
models.description: Two outdoor air conditioner units stacked in a galvanized two-tier frame, about 1.3 m wide and 2.6 m tall with pipes and ducts. Weathered ivory casings with fan grilles, grime and rust.

models.name: Acoustic Guitar
models.description: A dreadnought steel-string acoustic guitar, 1.03 m long, standing upright on its end. Sunburst spruce top with a rosette and tortoiseshell pickguard, mahogany back and sides with cream binding, a rosewood fretboard with dot markers and six steel and bronze strings.

models.name: Adobe House
models.description: One-storey flat-roofed adobe house, about 16 x 7 m with its walled yard and clay bake oven. Thick earth-plastered walls with soft rounded corners and uneven parapets, protruding roof beams, drain spouts, a weathered plank door and small deep-set windows.

models.name: Advent Candle Arch
models.description: Electric seven-candle window arch, 45 cm wide and about 36 cm tall. A stepped white wooden stand with white candle sleeves and flame-shaped bulbs that read lit at night, and a white cord with a switch and plug trailing behind.

models.name: Agar Petri Dish
models.description: An open glass petri dish, 9 cm across, holding a thin layer of pale amber agar.

models.name: Agave Rosette
models.description: Agave rosette about 1.8 m across and 0.8 m tall, thick glaucous blue-grey leaves with toothed edges and sharp tips.

models.name: Aircraft Hangar
models.description: Steel aircraft hangar, 60 x 45 m and 18 m tall, with a 43 m wide door opening. Grey profiled cladding under a shallow arched roof, six blue grey door leaves stacked open at the corners (they slide sideways to close), lattice trusses, high bay lamps, floor markings and an office block inside.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Passenger Stairs Truck
models.description: Generic self-propelled passenger stairs truck, about 6.6 m long and 2.3 m wide, with the stairs raised to a 3.3 m airliner door. White stairs and cab on a dark grey chassis, with railings, a glazed canopy over the top platform and lifting rams, worn by daily boarding.

models.name: Alchemy Table
models.description: A heavy oak alchemist's bench 1.5 by 0.7 m and 86 cm high, its plank top marked by spills, rings, knife cuts and scorch marks. Stoneware jars and a stack of books sit on the shelf below.

models.name: Alloy Baseball Bat
models.description: An 84 cm (33 in) alloy baseball bat lying on the ground, with a black wrapped grip, a scuffed barrel and a cupped end cap.

models.name: Aluminium Mess Tin
models.description: A rectangular aluminium mess tin about 19 cm long with a wire handle folded down over the rim, scuffed and blackened from the fire.

models.name: Aluminium Stepladder
models.description: A 1.5 m five step aluminium stepladder standing open, with a top platform and rubber feet. Scuffed metal flecked with paint; the rear legs fold.

models.name: Amber Potion Vial
models.description: A slim glass vial of glowing amber brew, about 17 cm tall, stopped with cork and twine. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Ambulance
models.description: Generic box-body ambulance on a van chassis, about 7.2 m long, 2.3 m wide and 2.9 m tall. White with a two-row yellow-green check pattern, blue warning lights, a kerb-side door and two rear doors opening onto a stretcher, cabinets and an attendant seat.

models.name: Ammo Can
models.description: Pressed steel ammunition can, 28 x 15 x 19 cm, in olive drab paint chipped to bare steel on the edges, with abstract yellow stencil marks. The hinged lid has a rubber seal, a cam latch and a folding handle; inside stand cardboard cartons, one open on a block of cartridges.

models.name: Analytical Balance
models.description: An analytical balance, 34 cm deep and 30 cm tall, with a weighing pan inside a glass draft shield and a small green display on the front.

models.name: Ancient Coin Tray
models.description: A shallow wooden display tray of twelve ancient gold, silver and bronze coins on red velvet, 30 by 20 cm. Each coin is struck with a beaded rim and a wheel motif.

models.name: Angle Grinder
models.description: A cordless 125 mm angle grinder about 40 cm long with its battery, resting on its disc guard. Orange and charcoal body, a steel gear head, a side handle and a worn abrasive disc.

models.name: Wood Ant Mound
models.description: Wood ant mound of spruce needles and twigs, about 1 m across and 0.7 m tall. A rounded cone of golden-brown thatch with small entrance holes, running out into a skirt of darker litter, with a few spruce cones and a rotten stick leaning against it. No ants.
models.changes: Rebuilt as a bristly thatch of spruce needles and twigs with entrance holes, a litter skirt, cones and a rotten stick.

models.name: Anthracite Column Radiator
models.description: A floor standing column radiator in anthracite grey, 12 sections and about 55 cm wide by 66 cm tall. Three rows of round steel columns between rounded headers, with brass valves at both ends.

models.name: Anti-Slip Manhole Cover
models.description: Round cast iron manhole cover about 0.7 m across with a plain anti-slip casting pattern. Worn dark metal set flush in a road or sidewalk.

models.name: Apartment Block
models.description: Modern six-storey apartment block, 30 x 14 m and 20 m tall, with three shops on the ground floor. Red brick bays alternate with white rendered bays of stacked balconies with black steel railings; blank lit shop signs, a canopied entrance, rooftop plant and lit windows at night.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Apartment Playground
models.description: Apartment courtyard playground on an 8 x 6 m field of rubber safety tiles. A slide tower with a pyramid roof, stairs, ladder and climbing wall, a two-seat swing and a seesaw, in bright powder-coated steel and plastic, sun-faded and scuffed.

models.name: Furnished Apartment Room
models.description: Furnished living room, 6 x 4 m with a 2.6 m ceiling, open on the front so a camera can look in. Warm white plaster, oak floor, two white windows with curtains and blinds, a grey wool sofa, oak coffee table, rug, bookshelf, arc lamp and houseplant. Lamps and ceiling light glow.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Apple Tree
models.description: Pruned orchard apple tree, about 5 m tall, in summer leaf and hung with ripe red apples. A short, gnarled trunk splits low into spreading limbs around an open centre, with a few windfalls on the ground below.

models.name: Apple Tree in Blossom
models.description: Pruned orchard apple tree, about 5 m tall, in spring blossom. A short, gnarled trunk splits low into spreading limbs covered in white and pink flowers among fresh young leaves.

models.name: Fabric Armchair
models.description: Mid-century style armchair, 0.78 m wide and 0.84 m tall, upholstered in mustard wool. Padded arms, a reclined back that curves a little round the sitter and a loose piped seat cushion, on four splayed, tapered walnut legs.

models.name: Arming Sword
models.description: One-handed medieval arming sword, about 0.92 m long. A fullered double-edged steel blade with polish lines and honed edges, a forged cross guard, a dark leather grip with risers and a wheel pommel.

models.name: Armoured Scrap Truck
models.description: A survivor pickup armoured with welded scrap plate: a spiked I beam ram on the nose, a mesh screen over the windscreen, plated doors with mesh windows, firing slots and a pipe cage round the bed, caged lamps, a spare tyre and fuel cans, all on big lugged tyres.

models.name: Aspen
models.description: European aspen, about 14 m tall, with a straight trunk of smooth grey-green bark marked by dark diamond scars, dark and furrowed at the base, and a tall, narrow, open crown of round, trembling leaves.

models.name: Assault Rifle
models.description: Assault rifle carbine, about 86 cm long, an original generic design. Matte black pocketed receivers with a flat-top rail, a tan slotted handguard, folding iron sights, a tan adjustable stock with a cheek riser, a sculpted grip with stippled panels and a ribbed curved magazine.

models.name: Assembly Line Conveyor
models.description: Modular factory conveyor kit with a 4 m powered roller straight, a 90 degree roller curve, a 1.5 m belt transfer and a 1 m end piece with an end stop. Light grey frames on adjustable legs, blue gearmotors, galvanized rollers and guide rails, lightly scuffed from daily use.

models.name: Asteroid Set
models.description: Four asteroids from 2 m to 30 m: a loose rubble pile, a cratered stony lump, a small metallic chunk and an elongated two-lobed rock. Dark, dusty and pitted, each a separate object centred on its own origin.

models.name: Astronaut in Spacesuit
models.description: An astronaut in a white pressurized spacesuit, about 1.9 m tall in the suit. A bubble helmet with a gold metal visor, bearing rings at the joints, hoses from the life-support pack to the chest unit, gloves and heavy boots; plain and unmarked, dusty below the knees.

models.name: Freestanding ATM Kiosk
models.description: A freestanding bank cash machine kiosk, 1.9 m tall and 0.8 m wide, in dark graphite with a brushed steel fascia. A glowing screen under a privacy hood, a sloped keypad, a card reader and a blank lit header.

models.name: Baby Stroller
models.description: A modern pram with a padded carrycot, a folding hood, a silver alloy frame and a foam push bar. Large rear wheels with a foot brake, swivelling front wheels and a storage basket underneath.

models.name: Back Bar Shelves
models.description: Back bar unit, 3 m wide and 2.6 m tall, that stands against the wall behind a bar. Walnut cabinets with a black granite top, mirrored bays with lit glass shelves and a stainless speed rail, stocked with bottles of many shapes, colours and fill levels with blank labels.

models.name: Baggage Tractor and Carts
models.description: Generic airport baggage train, about 13 m long: a small open orange tractor towing three covered baggage carts, each 2.5 m long and 1.5 m wide. The carts have blue canvas side curtains, one side drawn back to show a few cases, and steering drawbars, scuffed from ramp work.

models.name: Baguette
models.description: A French baguette, 60 cm long and 5 cm tall. Five diagonal slashes open into crisp ears along a golden, blistered crust with a light dusting of flour.

models.name: Baker's Awning Stall
models.description: A baker's market stall 2.5 m wide under a red and cream striped awning. Its plank counter holds baskets of loaves and round breads, with a sack beneath.

models.name: Bald Cypress
models.description: Old bald cypress about 20 m tall, the classic swamp tree. A fluted, buttressed trunk flares wide at the water line, knobbly knees rise around it, and flat feathery sprays of soft green needles spread in tiers under a broad top, with grey moss hanging from the lower limbs.

models.name: Bamboo Clump
models.description: A clump of bamboo about 7 m tall. Jointed green to yellow culms of mixed age lean out from a tight base and arch under dense sprays of narrow drooping leaves, with fallen sheaths at the foot.

models.name: Banana
models.description: A ripe banana lying on its side, about 21 cm along its curve. The yellow ridged peel has a green tinge at the stalk, a dark tip and a few brown speckles.

models.name: Banana Plant
models.description: Banana plant about 4 m tall with a fruit bunch. A thick false stem of overlapping blotched sheaths carries huge paddle leaves torn into strips along their veins, dead leaves hang down the stem and two young suckers grow at its foot.

models.name: Bank Lobby Arched Window Wall
models.description: A 4 m wide, 6 m tall cream marble bank hall wall with a tall arched window. The bronze frame has a fanlight and glazing bars, under a green keystone, with fluted half pilasters at both ends.

models.name: Bank Lobby Coffered Ceiling Tile
models.description: A 4 m square coffered ceiling cell for a classical bank hall, with nine deep teal coffers framed in cream beams and gilt steps, each holding a gilt rosette. It hangs 6 m above its origin.

models.name: Bank Lobby Marble Floor Tile
models.description: A 4 m square cell of polished bank hall floor. Cream and grey marble squares laid on the diagonal inside a green marble border edged with brass strips, so laid cells show a border every 4 m.

models.name: Bank Lobby Fluted Column
models.description: A 6 m tall fluted marble column for a classical bank hall, 1.24 m wide at its square black plinth. The tapering shaft has twenty flutes under a moulded capital and a green marble block.

models.name: Bank Lobby Marble Wall
models.description: A 4 m wide, 6 m tall classical bank hall wall in cream marble. Raised panel frames sit between a green marble dado and a moulded cornice, with a fluted half pilaster at each end so neighbouring walls share a full one.

models.name: Bank Lobby Revolving Door
models.description: A 4 m wide, 6 m tall bank entrance wall holding a bronze and glass revolving door 2.4 m across. The four glazed wings spin inside a curved glass drum, with glazed side lights and a transom screen above.

models.name: Bank Teller Counter Bay
models.description: A 2 m bay of classic bank teller counter, 2.7 m tall, that snaps to its neighbours in a run. Mahogany panels on black marble under a white marble ledge, bronze-framed security glass with a speaking grille and deal tray, and a teller worktop with drawers behind.

models.name: Bank Teller Counter Gate Bay
models.description: A 1.2 m end bay for a classic bank teller counter, 2.7 m tall, with a glazed bronze gate that swings open on its hinges. A mahogany end post and cornice close the counter run.

models.name: Bank Vault Door
models.description: Round bank vault door, 2.4 m across, in a brushed steel frame for a 0.7 m wall. An engine-turned face with a five spoke handle and two dials, a ring of chrome locking bolts, a crane hinge and a glazed bolt-work cover on the back, with a barred day gate behind it.

models.name: Banded Banknote Bundle
models.description: A single banded bundle of plain green-tinted banknotes, 16 cm long. The notes carry only an abstract border and medallion under a coloured paper band; there is no text or currency design.

models.name: Stack of Banknote Bundles
models.description: A loose stack of six banded banknote bundles, 16 cm long and 7 cm tall, a few laid crosswise. Plain green-tinted notes under paper bands of three colours, with no text or currency design.

models.name: Baobab Tree
models.description: African baobab about 16 m tall, with a massive bottle-shaped trunk some 8 m round. The smooth grey bark is folded and wrinkled, and a sparse crown of thick, stubby branches carries a few leaves and velvety pods on long stalks.

models.name: Bar Stool
models.description: Bar stool with a 0.75 m seat height for kitchen islands and counters. A round solid oak seat with a soft edge on four splayed black steel tube legs, joined by a foot ring.

models.name: Barrel Cactus
models.description: Barrel cactus about 1 m tall with deep ribs, hooked red spines and a crown of yellow fruit on top.

models.name: Survivor Barricade Set
models.description: Five improvised survivor barricades in a row, 1 to 4 m wide: a tyre and pallet wall, a corrugated sheet fence, a shield wall of salvaged car doors, a concrete block and a scrap metal gate that swings open. Rusted, weathered and patched.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Basalt Columns
models.description: Cluster of dark hexagonal basalt columns about 4.6 x 3.4 m, up to 6 m high, with broken tops stepping down to the front, plus three loose fallen column pieces. Cross joints, chipped edges, brown weathering, iron stains, lichen on the tops and moss low down.

models.name: Baseball
models.description: A regulation baseball, 74 mm across, with white leather and red double stitching. The cover is scuffed and lightly stained.

models.name: Baseball Base
models.description: A white canvas baseball base, 38 cm (15 in) square and 7.5 cm thick, with rounded edges. The top is scuffed and dusty with infield dirt.

models.name: Baseball Batting Helmet
models.description: A gloss navy baseball batting helmet with one ear flap, about 27 cm long, resting on its side. The shell is scuffed with vents on top and foam padding inside.

models.name: Baseball Field
models.description: Full baseball field with 90 ft base paths, a 100 m foul line and a 122 m centre field. Checkerboard mown grass, a clay infield and warning track, a raised mound, bases and chalk boxes, padded walls with yellow foul poles, two dugouts and a netted backstop.

models.name: Baseplate Compass
models.description: A clear baseplate orienteering compass about 12 cm long, with a black bezel ring, a fluid capsule and a red and white needle. A lanyard cord trails from one end.

models.name: Basketball
models.description: Size 7 basketball, 24 cm across, in orange pebbled rubber. Fine round pebbles, slightly worn on top, with the recessed black channels of a classic eight-panel ball.

models.name: Basketball Court
models.description: Outdoor full basketball court, 28 x 15 m, with 2 m of run-off. Green acrylic with terracotta keys, centre circle and run-off, and all the standard white markings, including 6.75 m three-point lines. Hoops are separate models.

models.name: Basketball Hoop
models.description: Outdoor basketball hoop, 3.05 m to the rim. A clear 1.8 x 1.05 m backboard with a white border, an orange 45 cm rim and a white net, on a padded steel pole that sets the board 1.2 m inside the baseline.

models.name: Basketball Rack
models.description: Two-tier steel ball rack, 1 m long, holding six basketballs. Black powder-coated tube frames with round rails worn bright where the balls sit, on rubber feet. The balls can be taken off the rack.

models.name: Bat
models.description: Small brown bat with a 0.35 m wingspan. Thin leathery wings over finger bones, a furry body, big ears and tiny clawed feet. Animated flying (in place: move it at about 4 m/s) and hanging upside down by the feet.

models.name: Bathroom Accessories
models.description: Bathroom set: a toothbrush cup, a soap pump, three folded towels and a 60 cm round bath rug. A sage ceramic cup with two brushes, a stone white pump with a chrome head and soft terry towels. Each item is its own node, so they can be placed on a vanity, a shelf or the floor.

models.name: Bathroom Vanity
models.description: Wall-hung bathroom vanity, 0.8 m wide, with a grey oak drawer unit, a white ceramic basin top at 86 cm and a chrome tap. Above it hangs a 0.8 x 0.7 m mirror with a slim light bar. The back of the model is the wall it hangs on.

models.name: Bathtub
models.description: Built-in white bathtub, 1.7 m long and 0.75 m wide, set in a surround of light grey glazed tiles. A chrome bath shower mixer sits on the deck at the tap end, with the hand shower resting on top and its hose looping into the tub.

models.name: Battle Axe
models.description: Two-handed bearded battle axe, about 0.93 m long. A forged iron head with hammer marks, a long beard and a bright honed edge on an ash haft with a dark leather grip wrap.

models.name: Beach Toys
models.description: An inflatable beach ball, a plastic sand bucket and a spade, set out on a 0.6 m patch. Sun-faded red, yellow, blue and white vinyl, a blue bucket half full of damp sand and a red spade. Each toy is a separate node that can be moved on its own.

models.name: Beach Umbrella
models.description: A 2 m tilting beach umbrella planted in the sand, about 2.2 m tall. Alternating navy and cream canvas panels with a scalloped valance, sun-faded toward the rim, on a white aluminium pole. The pointed lower end sits 0.25 m below the ground line.

models.name: Beaker 100 ml
models.description: An empty 100 ml glass beaker, 7 cm tall, with a pouring spout and white scale marks.

models.name: Beaker 250 ml
models.description: A 250 ml glass beaker, 10 cm tall, with a pouring spout and white scale marks, half full of clear liquid.

models.name: Beaker 600 ml
models.description: A 600 ml glass beaker, 13 cm tall, with a pouring spout and white scale marks, half full of blue liquid.

models.name: Stack of Full Beer Crates
models.description: Three scuffed yellow plastic beer crates stacked about 0.9 m tall, full of brown glass bottles under blank labels. For a liquor store back door or an alley.

models.name: Beer Crate with Empty Bottles
models.description: Scuffed red plastic beer crate full of empty brown bottles, with one bottle lying on the ground beside it. About 0.6 m long.

models.name: Bench Vise
models.description: A blue cast iron bench vise with 100 mm jaws, about 24 cm long. Chipped paint, rusty serrated jaw plates and a steel screw with a sliding handle; the front jaw slides open.

models.name: Benchtop Centrifuge
models.description: A benchtop centrifuge, 38 x 46 cm and 32 cm tall, with a lift-up domed lid over a stainless chamber and an aluminium rotor. A lit display sits on the dark front panel.

models.name: Bentwood Cafe Chair
models.description: A classic bentwood cafe chair, about 90 cm tall, with a steam bent dark stained frame and a woven cane seat.

models.name: Bicycle Parking Set
models.description: Two-tier galvanized bicycle rack, 2.5 m wide and 2.3 m tall, with five city bicycles parked in it, plus one standing bicycle. Step-through shopping bikes in different colours with wire front baskets, mudguards, chain cases, rear carriers and two-leg stands.

models.name: Trackside Video Screen
models.description: Trackside video screen, 10 x 6 m with its lower edge about 3.5 m up, in a black bezel. A dark back cabinet sits on a grey steel frame with raking struts, a service walkway and a ladder. The screen face is a separate dark emissive surface mapped 0 to 1, ready for a video texture.

models.name: Bicycle Rack
models.description: Galvanized wave bicycle rack for five bikes, 1.85 m long and 0.83 m tall. One bent steel tube in three loops, bolted to two small concrete feet, with the zinc rubbed bright where bike frames lean on it.

models.name: Bilberry Bush
models.description: Low bilberry (blueberry) shrub about 35 cm tall: green angular stems, small oval leaves and a few ripe blue berries. Origin on the ground at the centre; carries _WIND data with leaf flutter for vertex shader sway.

models.name: Giant Screen Set
models.description: Three giant wall-mounted LED screens: a 12 x 8 m landscape screen, a 6 x 12 m portrait screen and a 12 m screen that curves around a building corner. Thin black bezels and steel brackets; each screen shows an abstract colour pattern. Screen faces have plain 0-1 UVs for your own video or images.

models.name: Highway Billboard
models.description: Single-pole highway billboard, 14 m tall, with a blank 12.8 x 4.2 m face. A grey steel pole and head frame with a front catwalk, railing, a caged ladder and four floodlights on outriggers, light road grime and streaks.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Bird of Paradise Plant
models.description: A flowering bird of paradise about 1.2 m tall. Fans of stiff blue-green paddle leaves surround three beak-shaped orange and blue flowers.

models.name: Bitten Glazed Donut
models.description: A glazed ring donut with a bite taken out, 9 cm across and 3 cm tall. Tooth marks edge the bite, which shows the soft, airy crumb inside.

models.name: Black Microwave Oven
models.description: A black countertop microwave oven about 48 cm wide, with a side hinged door that opens. A screened window shows the cavity and glass turntable, beside a plain control strip with a round dial.

models.name: Black Sea Urchin
models.description: Spiny black sea urchin about 21 cm across including its long spines, with a wet, clean surface. For scattering on rocky seabeds.

models.name: Black Steel Street Bollard
models.description: A slim black steel street bollard about 1 m tall, with reflective bands near the top. Scuffed paint, for kerbs and pedestrian zones.

models.name: Blacksmith Forge
models.description: Open-fronted medieval blacksmith's workshop about 8 x 6 m under an oak shingle roof. A stone forge hearth with glowing coals and a hooded flue, leather bellows, an anvil on a stump, a quench trough, tool racks, a grindstone and a charcoal heap fill the earth floor.

models.name: Large Blade Sign
models.description: Flat projecting blade sign about 2.4 m tall with a blue lit face and a ring motif, on steel wall brackets. Blank and glowing at night.

models.name: Small Hanging Blade Sign
models.description: Small blade sign about 1.3 m tall hung from a steel arm, with a lit chevron face in warm colours. Blank and glowing at night.

models.name: Blasthole Drill Rig
models.description: Crawler blasthole drill rig for open pit mining, about 12 m long with a lattice mast 21 m tall. Faded yellow with a grey frame, a cab beside the mast, a rotary head with drill pipe, a pipe carousel, a dust hood and four levelling jacks, dusty from the drill floor.

models.name: Blossom and Wave Manhole Cover
models.description: Round cast iron manhole cover about 0.7 m across with a raised blossom and wave pattern, as seen in East Asian cities. Dark worn metal set flush in the street.

models.name: Blue Enamel Coffee Pot
models.description: Speckled blue enamel coffee pot about 22 cm tall with a spout, a handle and a lid. Chipped enamel at the edges, at home in a cabin kitchen or on a campfire.

models.name: Blue Enamel Mug
models.description: Speckled blue enamel camp mug about 9 cm tall with chipped edges. Matches the blue enamel coffee pot.

models.name: Blue Golf Tee Marker
models.description: Round blue plastic tee marker 15 cm across with a domed top and grass scuffs, set on the tee box to mark where players tee off.

models.name: Blue Two-Wheel Hand Trolley
models.description: Two-wheel hand trolley about 1.2 m tall with a blue tubular frame, a steel toe plate and solid wheels that spin. Paint chipped and rusty from deliveries.

models.name: Blue Hydrangea
models.description: A blue mophead hydrangea shrub about 90 cm tall. Round flower heads made of hundreds of single florets sit above broad, serrated leaves.

models.name: Blue Mana Potion
models.description: A teardrop fantasy potion bottle of glowing blue brew, about 17 cm tall, under a dripping blue wax seal. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Blue Sand Bucket
models.description: Blue plastic sand bucket about 20 cm tall, half full of damp sand. Sun-faded from the beach.

models.name: Blue Wooden Sawhorse Barrier
models.description: Blue painted wooden sawhorse barrier about 2.4 m long and 1.1 m tall, a plank across two folding leg stands. Plain, with chipped paint and street grime.

models.name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
models.description: A rugged portable speaker, an 18 cm cylinder lying on its side. A navy fabric middle sits between black rubber end caps, with a raised key strip, a strap loop and a status light.

models.name: Falu Red Boathouse
models.description: Small Nordic boathouse, 4 x 7 m, half on a stone plinth and half on piles over the water. Red ochre board-and-batten cladding, white trims and a dark tin roof; open doors on the water gable show a white rowboat afloat inside. The water level is at the origin height.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Boiler Room
models.description: A 10 x 8 m basement boiler room, 4.2 m high: a riveted shell boiler with a firebox door and gauges, lagged and bare pipes with hand-wheel valves, a galvanised water tank and a catwalk with a ladder. Sooty brick over green painted walls, caged lamps. Includes a 4 m wall pipe run that tiles.

models.name: Street Bollard Set
models.description: Set of three street bollards, up to 1 m tall, side by side. A black steel post with reflective bands, a round concrete stump and a removable folding steel post on a hinged base plate. Each bollard is a separate object.

models.name: Book Row with Leaning Book
models.description: A short row of seven upright books ending in one that leans against the others, about 30 cm long. Mixed hardcovers and paperbacks with blank, faded spines.

models.name: Painted Bookshelf
models.description: Tall painted bookshelf, 1.9 m high, 0.9 m wide and 0.3 m deep, filled with books. Grey-blue linseed paint worn through to the wood on the edges, five open shelves and plain cloth-bound books in muted colours, standing, leaning and stacked.

models.name: Bookshelf Speaker
models.description: A walnut bookshelf speaker, 33 cm tall and 18 cm wide, on rubber feet. The black front holds a woofer, a dome tweeter in a waveguide and a flared bass port, with gold binding posts at the back.

models.name: Bored Metro Tunnel Curve Left
models.description: Left-curving 10 m piece of a 5.7 m bored metro tunnel in precast concrete rings, with slab track, covered third rail, raised walkway, cable runs, red fire main and wall lamps. Chains end to end.

models.name: Bored Metro Tunnel Curve Right
models.description: Right-curving 10 m piece of a 5.7 m bored metro tunnel in precast concrete rings, with slab track, covered third rail, raised walkway, cable runs, red fire main and wall lamps. Chains end to end.

models.name: Bored Metro Tunnel Straight
models.description: Straight 10 m piece of a 5.7 m bored metro tunnel lined with precast concrete rings, with slab track, a covered third rail, a raised walkway with handrail, cable runs, a red fire main and wall lamps. Chains end to end along the track.

models.name: Bow Rake
models.description: A steel bow rake about 1.6 m long lying flat with its teeth up, on a long ash handle. Chipped green paint and rust on the head.

models.name: Bowed Snow Marker Pole
models.description: A roadside snow marker pole 2 m tall, slightly bowed and leaning sideways after a winter of ploughing. Banded orange red and black with a white reflective sleeve and a black cap, scuffed and grimy low down.

models.name: Boxing Corner Stool
models.description: A boxer's corner stool about 50 cm tall, with a padded red seat on a chrome frame.

models.name: Boxing Ring
models.description: A raised boxing ring 7.3 m square with the canvas 1 m above the floor. Worn canvas floor, four levels of ropes, red, blue and neutral corner cushions, a navy skirt and steps at one corner.

models.name: Bracken Fern
models.description: Clump of bracken, knee to waist high and wider than tall, with broad tripinnate fronds spreading at varied angles, fiddleheads and dead fronds at the base. Clumps planted about 1 m apart merge into a continuous canopy.

models.name: Braided Oval Rug
models.description: A 1.2 x 1.8 m oval rug of fabric braids coiled round and round, in mixed muted blues, greens, reds, mustard and cream. Each three strand braid has its own relief, and the strands change fabric along the way.

models.name: Brain Coral
models.description: Brain coral dome about 0.8 m across and 0.4 m tall, covered in deep winding grooves. Healthy, saturated reef colour with paler ridges.

models.name: Braking Marker Boards
models.description: Set of three trackside braking boards (100, 200 and 300), 1.4 x 0.95 m on posts 1.6 m tall. Plain black figures on white aluminium plates, clamped to galvanised posts on small concrete footings. Each board can be placed on its own before a corner.

models.name: 100 m Braking Marker Board
models.description: A trackside braking board marking 100 m before a corner. Plain black figures on a 1.4 x 0.95 m white aluminium plate, clamped to galvanised posts 1.6 m tall on small concrete footings.

models.name: 200 m Braking Marker Board
models.description: A trackside braking board marking 200 m before a corner. Plain black figures on a 1.4 x 0.95 m white aluminium plate, clamped to galvanised posts 1.6 m tall on small concrete footings.

models.name: 300 m Braking Marker Board
models.description: A trackside braking board marking 300 m before a corner. Plain black figures on a 1.4 x 0.95 m white aluminium plate, clamped to galvanised posts 1.6 m tall on small concrete footings.

models.name: Brass Beer Tap Tower
models.description: A brass T-bar beer tower with four chrome taps, 64 cm tall to the handle tips, standing in a stainless drip tray. The tall black tap handles carry blank cream badges and each one pulls toward the bartender.

models.name: Brass Candelabra
models.description: A brass candelabra 61 cm tall with two curved arms and three lit wax candles. The flames glow.

models.name: Brass Candlestick
models.description: A turned brass candlestick holding a tall cream taper candle, about 45 cm tall in all. The worn brass has a stepped round base and the candle carries one wax drip.

models.name: Brass Door Key on Ring
models.description: A 7 cm brass door key on a steel split ring, with a worn shine. A pickup for house and office doors.

models.name: Brass Queue Post
models.description: A polished brass queue post, 1 m tall on a weighted round base 33 cm across. Ring eyes on both sides take velvet ropes hung between posts 1.4 m apart.

models.name: Brass Rope Barrier
models.description: Two polished brass stanchions, 1 m tall and 1.6 m apart, with a red velvet rope hooked between them. A classic barrier for galleries, theatres and queues.

models.name: Brass Wall Sconce
models.description: Small wall sconce about 30 cm tall: a brass wall plate and arm holding a glowing opal glass globe. For hallways and living rooms.

models.name: Office Break Room
models.description: Office break room set, 4 x 4 m, built against a sage green partition. A white kitchenette has a fridge-freezer, sink, wall cabinets, coffee machine and microwave, next to recycling bins and a blank vending machine with lit snack shelves. A table with four orange chairs stands in front.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Breakable Crate
models.description: Breakable 60 cm pine supply crate, shipped both intact and pre-broken into 15 pieces. Pale planks in nailed, braced frames, black steel angle irons on the edges and red stencilled arrows and marks; the pieces show splintered, freshly torn wood.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel Corner
models.description: A 4 m corner of old brick sewer tunnel that turns 90 degrees. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel Dead End
models.description: A 4 m dead end of old brick sewer tunnel closed by a wall with an iron outflow grate. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel Ladder Shaft
models.description: A 4 m section of old brick sewer tunnel with an iron ladder up a shaft to a manhole cover, about 7 m tall in all. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel Pipe Outlet
models.description: A 4 m section of old brick sewer tunnel with a side pipe pouring into the channel. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel Straight
models.description: A straight 4 m section of old brick sewer tunnel. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Brick Sewer Tunnel T-Junction
models.description: A 4 m T junction of old brick sewer tunnel where a side tunnel branches off. Damp, sooty brick barrel vault 3.5 m wide with a water channel between two walkways and caged wall lamps. Joins the other 4 m sewer pieces.

models.name: Broken Amphora
models.description: A broken terracotta amphora spread over about 1.4 m: the lower half on its side, the neck with both handles and a few shards. The breaks are jagged and show the wall thickness.

models.name: Broken Doric Column
models.description: A fluted Doric marble column broken off at about 2.4 m, with a rough fracture on top. Splinters of the lost drum and dry grass lie around its foot.

models.name: Broken Granite Boulder
models.description: An angular piece of broken granite about 0.8 m long. Pinkish tan granite with chipped edges, dark patina and lichen, with a tuft of dry grass at its foot.

models.name: Broken Statue Plinth
models.description: A marble statue plinth snapped through its die at about 0.7 m, with the upper part and crown lying beside it among fragments. The fracture is rough and the stone weathered.

models.name: Broken Stone Statue Head
models.description: Broken head of a large carved statue half sunk in the ground, about 2.4 by 2.9 m, with chips of stone around it. Original stylised design in mossy grey-green limestone.

models.name: Broken Wooden Stool
models.description: A small stool of old grey oak with a snapped leg, tipped over on its side, about 0.5 m across. Rough, worn wood.

models.name: Bronze Corinthian Helmet
models.description: An ancient bronze Corinthian helmet on a museum rod stand, 41 cm tall overall. The closed face has almond eye openings, a nose guard and cheek pieces nearly meeting at the chin, under green patina.

models.name: Bronze Cup Trophy
models.description: Bronze cup trophy about 45 cm tall: a deep bowl with a rolled lip and handles on a knopped stem, standing on a black plinth. Plain, with no text.

models.name: Bronze Field Cannon
models.description: Black-powder field gun with an aged bronze barrel on a two-wheeled oak carriage with a block trail, about 4.2 m long. Weathered oak and iron fittings; the barrel and wheels move.

models.name: Bronze Leaf Blade Sword
models.description: An ancient bronze sword with a leaf-shaped blade, 66 cm long, resting on two black cradles on an 80 cm wooden board. The grip is wrapped in cord under a lens-shaped pommel.

models.name: Bronze Ribbon Sculpture
models.description: A polished bronze ribbon twisted into an open loop, on a black granite block, 1.76 m tall overall.

models.name: Bronze Tripod Brazier
models.description: A bronze tripod brazier about 1 m tall, its bowl full of ash and charcoal on three curved legs with hoof feet. The bronze has a green patina.

models.name: Bulldozer
models.description: Generic medium crawler bulldozer, about 6 m long with a 3.4 m wide blade and 3.1 m tall to the cab roof. Orange bodywork over black running gear, a curved push blade at the front, a single-shank ripper at the rear and a glazed protective cab, dusty and edge-worn from use.

models.name: Bumper Car Pavilion
models.description: An open-sided 20 x 12 m bumper car pavilion with eight bumper cars in different colours. Steel columns and trusses carry a blue standing-seam roof, a steel ceiling grid and a striped fascia lined with bulbs over a smooth steel floor inside a padded rail.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Kit
models.description: Six 4 m pieces of a poured-concrete Cold War bunker: arched corridor, corner, T junction, a blast door frame with a round wheel-locked door, a stair down and a control room with analogue consoles. Green painted dado, cable trays, a vent duct and caged lamps.

models.name: Burette on Retort Stand
models.description: A 50 ml glass burette in a clamp on a retort stand, 68 cm tall. The burette holds blue liquid above a white stopcock, and the stand has a dark painted iron base and a steel rod.

models.name: Burn Barrel
models.description: A sooty steel drum stood on bricks with glowing embers, half burnt logs and a rebar grate over the rim. Draught holes glow round its base and ash is spilled around it.

models.name: Burnt Truck Cab
models.description: Burnt-out cab-over semi-truck tractor unit, about 6.2 m long, sitting on bare rims with its tyres gone. Scorched rusty cab with traces of red paint low down, broken glass, seats burnt to springs and both doors hanging open.

models.name: Rural Bus Stop
models.description: Rural bus stop marker, a galvanized post with the sign centre 2.3 m above the ground. A blank yellow stop sign with a green border and header band, no text, and a small dark green timetable box holding a blank, damp-stained sheet.

models.name: Business Jet
models.description: Sleek mid-size business jet, about 20 m long with a 18.5 m wingspan. White with a charcoal belly and a thin bronze pinstripe, swept wings with winglets, two rear-mounted engines, a T-tail and a forward airstair door. Shipped with the gear down.

models.name: Control Button Panel
models.description: Wall-mounted industrial control box, 30 x 40 cm, in grey powder coat: a red mushroom stop button on a yellow collar, two green push buttons, a key switch with its key, and green and amber indicator lamps over black plates with abstract white icons. Cable glands underneath.

models.name: C-Clamp
models.description: A black cast iron C clamp about 12 cm tall, lying on its side, with a steel screw and sliding T bar. Worn paint and rust.

models.name: Wall Cable Riser
models.description: A bundle of cables rising from a concrete ground duct, clipped up the wall in steel brackets and bending out at the top. Stained and weathered from years outdoors.

models.name: Caged Hockey Helmet
models.description: A white ice hockey player helmet with a black wire face cage, about 27 cm long, lying tipped on its side. The gloss shell is scuffed and marked, with vents on the crown and black ear guards.

models.name: Caged Tomato Plant
models.description: Bushy tomato plant about 1.2 m tall filling a round wire cage. Ripe red and green tomatoes hang in trusses among the leaves, with yellow flowers near the top.

models.name: Camera Tripod
models.description: An aluminium travel tripod with a ball head, 1.3 m tall with its legs spread. Three tube sections with twist locks, foam grips and a centre column end in a quick release clamp.

models.name: Camouflage Net on Poles
models.description: Woodland camouflage net about 6 m across and 2.5 m tall, draped over five poles and pulled down by guy ropes to stakes. Dark green, olive, brown and khaki garnish with a leafy texture.

models.name: Camp Hatchet
models.description: A 36 cm camp hatchet lying on its side, a forged steel head on a curved hickory handle. The edge is honed bright and the grip is darkened by hands.

models.name: Campfire Ring
models.description: Ring of eleven granite stones, about 1 m across, around an unlit fire bed. The rounded fieldstones are sooted black on the fire side with lichen outside; inside lie grey-white ash, charcoal and four charred log ends, with the centre open for a fire effect.

models.name: Dome Tent
models.description: Two-person dome tent with a green fly sheet, 2.1 m long, 1.35 m wide and 1.1 m tall. Taut panels sag a little between the poles, the door is zipped shut under a storm flap, the grey inner tent shows at the hem and mud is splashed along the bottom. Guy lines run to pegs.

models.name: Canal Narrowboat
models.description: Steel canal boat 20 m long and just over 2 m wide in the narrowboat style. A black hull with a long green cabin and red roof, small round-cornered brass-framed windows, roof planters, a stove chimney, a rope fender on the bow and a swan-neck tiller at the stern.

models.name: Candle Cluster
models.description: Seven melted candles on an old round iron tray, 0.35 m across and 0.29 m tall to the tallest flame. Pillar candles and tapers in old ivory and cream wax with slumped tops, wax runs and pools on the rusty tray. The flames and their glow can be hidden.

models.name: Candle Stub on Iron Dish
models.description: A dripping wax candle stub on a small iron dish with a ring handle, its flame lit and glowing.

models.name: Candy Cane
models.description: A red and white striped candy cane, 15 cm long, lying on its side. The glossy sugar rod has a broad spiral stripe with thin lines either side and a faint dusting of sugar bloom.

models.name: Canister Camp Stove
models.description: A small gas camp stove screwed onto a fuel canister, about 15 cm tall, with serrated pot supports folded out round a sooty burner head.

models.name: Cannon Set
models.description: Black-powder artillery set: a bronze field gun on a two-wheeled carriage, an iron naval gun on a four-truck ship carriage, a pyramid of round shot, a powder keg and a rammer, sponge and worm on trestles. Weathered oak, aged bronze, rusty cast iron and hemp rope.

models.name: Cannon Tools on Trestles
models.description: Gunner's rammer, sponge and worm resting on a pair of oak trestles, about 3.2 m long. Weathered oak, iron fittings and hemp rope.

models.name: Cannonball Pyramid
models.description: Pyramid of rusty cast-iron round shot in a low frame, about 0.6 m across. Stands beside a gun battery or on a ship deck.

models.name: Canvas Backpack with Bedroll
models.description: A canvas backpack with a leather flap, straps and buckles, about 55 cm tall with a striped wool bedroll strapped on top.

models.name: Cappuccino Cup and Saucer
models.description: A white porcelain cappuccino cup on its saucer, 8 cm tall and 15 cm across. The foam carries a poured latte art heart.

models.name: Car Door Shield Barricade
models.description: An improvised shield wall of salvaged car doors bolted in two rows into a rusty steel frame, about 3.9 m wide and 2.3 m tall. Faded, dented paint and rust with no badges.

models.name: Car Ferry
models.description: Roll-on roll-off car ferry, about 92 m long and 17 m wide, with a lifting bow visor and a stern ramp. Green and white hull over red antifouling, three white passenger decks with window rows, a bridge with open wings, twin funnels and lifeboats, salt-stained and rust-streaked from daily crossings.

models.name: Car Seat Bench
models.description: Two salvaged car seats bolted to planks on cinder blocks, one torn to the foam. A crate with a tin cup serves as the side table.

models.name: Stacked Cardboard Boxes
models.description: Three closed cardboard boxes stacked 0.90 m tall, the largest 60 x 40 x 40 cm. Plain brown corrugated board with packing tape, slightly bulging sides, crushed corners, scuffs and grime along the bottom edges. No printing.

models.name: Moving Boxes
models.description: Stack of three taped cardboard moving boxes, about 1 m tall, the largest 60 x 40 x 40 cm. The top box is open with its flaps folded out, holding a row of books and a table lamp. Plain kraft board with packing tape, scuffs and crushed corners, no printing.

models.name: Cargo Bicycle
models.description: Long front-box cargo bicycle, 2.6 m long, with a plywood box, a cushioned bench and seat belts for children. Graphite frame, a small front wheel steered by a link rod under the box, full chain guard, rear rack, lamps and a centre stand.

models.name: Cyber Cargo Van
models.description: Original battered cab-over delivery van, about 5.2 m long, with a faded yellow cab and a dented, grime-streaked white cargo box. An angular nose with slit lamps, an amber roof light bar, cyan marker strips with a dead section and invented glyph tags give it a hard-worked city look.

models.name: Carousel
models.description: A 14 m round carousel with a red and cream striped canopy, painted rounding boards and a mirrored centre drum, all lit by bulbs. Two rings of seats (little cars, carriages and benches) ride on brass poles over a planked platform.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Carved Clay Tablet
models.description: A fired clay tablet carved with rows of invented wedge glyphs, 26 cm tall, leaning on a black stand. One top corner is broken off.

models.name: Carved Limestone Sarcophagus
models.description: A 2.4 m grey limestone sarcophagus carved with a blind arcade along its sides, with a gabled lid that slides off. Worn, stained and chipped.

models.name: Carved Oak Armchair
models.description: A carved oak armchair 1.37 m tall for the head of the table. It has turned front legs, a panelled back, an arched crest rail and a crimson cushion.

models.name: Carving Skis
models.description: A pair of blue carving skis, 1.70 m long, lying flat with bindings and brakes. They have a deep sidecut and a rockered tip.

models.name: Stainless Cash Cart
models.description: A lockable stainless steel cash cart, 1 m long and 1 m tall to its push bar. A box body with a hinged lid and hasp sits on an open tray with rubber corner bumpers and four swivel casters.

models.name: Zipped Cash Deposit Bag
models.description: A flat navy vinyl bank deposit pouch, 30 x 23 cm, lying zipped shut. Piped edges, a zip along the top and a small brass padlock through the pull.

models.name: Cash Duffel Bag
models.description: A full black nylon duffel bag, 66 cm long, packed tight. Webbing bands with carry handles, piped ends and a zip along the top.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall Corner Turret
models.description: A corner piece of castle curtain wall that turns 90 degrees under a corbelled turret, about 6.8 m square and 17.5 m high. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall End Cap
models.description: A short end cap that closes the far end of a castle curtain wall run, about 4.8 m long and 13.4 m high, with a squared stone end. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall with Stairs
models.description: An 8 m piece of castle curtain wall with stone stairs climbing its inner face to the wall walk, about 13.4 m high. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall Start Cap
models.description: A short end cap that closes the start of a castle curtain wall run, about 4.8 m long and 13.4 m high, with a squared stone end. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall Step Down
models.description: An 8 m piece of castle curtain wall whose battlements step down 2 m along its length, for following falling ground. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall Step Up
models.description: An 8 m piece of castle curtain wall whose battlements step up 2 m along its length, for following rising ground. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Curtain Wall Straight
models.description: A straight 8 m piece of crenellated castle curtain wall, about 13.4 m high and 2.6 m thick. Weathered coursed stone with merlons and arrow slits; a wall walk at 11 m. Chains end to end with the other wall pieces.

models.name: Castle Keep
models.description: Square stone castle keep about 25 m tall, with round corner turrets rising to 28 m and a gatehouse. Weathered coursed stone, corbelled crenellations, arrow slits, arched windows and a timber portcullis. Short curtain wall stubs left and right end in square cuts so longer walls can join them.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Casual Walker
models.description: Young man in a grey hoodie, jeans and white trainers. Rigged with a 56-bone humanoid skeleton and four looping animations (idle, walk, wave, look_around). Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z.

models.name: Circuit Catch Fence
models.description: Race circuit debris catch fence, a 5.0 m section, 5.0 m tall on a 1.0 m concrete wall. Painted steel posts carry chain-link mesh and three steel cables, the tops leaning toward the track. The wall's track face is white with a red band. Sections tile every 5 m.

models.name: Cattail Clump
models.description: A dense clump of cattails about 2 m across and 2 m tall, standing in shallow water. Fans of long blue-green strap leaves surround stiff stalks with brown velvet seed heads, a few bursting into fluff, among last year's straw-coloured leaves.

models.name: Sparse Cattail Clump
models.description: A small, open clump of cattails about 1.3 m across and 1.8 m tall. A dozen shoots of blue-green strap leaves, some stalks topped with brown velvet seed heads, and a few dry straw-coloured leaves.

models.name: Cattail Shoreline Strip
models.description: A 6 m strip of cattails about 1 m deep, to line the edge of a pond or swamp. Blue-green strap leaves and brown velvet seed heads stand in a loose band that runs along its length, with dry leaves among them.

models.name: Cauldron
models.description: Black cast-iron cauldron on three short legs, 0.60 m across and 0.50 m tall, filled with a glowing green potion. A round belly with a rolled rim and two lug handles, sooty and rusty, with potion drips. The potion can be hidden or tinted.

models.name: Cave Entrance
models.description: Rocky limestone hillside about 17 x 15 m with a cave mouth 6 m wide and 4 m high in its steep face. The dark, damp passage narrows and closes about 8 m in, fallen blocks lie at the entrance, with moss at the mouth and grass on the slopes. Its edges sink into any terrain.

models.name: Ceiling Smoke Alarm
models.description: A round white smoke alarm for a ceiling, 12 cm across and 4 cm deep, with a vented detector face. Hangs from its origin on the ceiling plane.

models.name: Ceiling Smoke Detector
models.description: Round white ceiling smoke detector, 12 cm across and 4 cm deep, made for 2.6 m rooms.

models.name: Celadon Bud Vase
models.description: A small bud vase in glossy speckled celadon green, about 14 cm tall. A round body tapering into a slim neck for a single stem.

models.name: Cement Mixer Truck
models.description: Generic three-axle concrete mixer truck, about 9.4 m long, 2.5 m wide and 3.8 m tall. White cab and drum with red spiral bands, a tilted rotating drum, a swinging discharge chute and a rear ladder to the hopper, with concrete dust and road grime from site deliveries.

models.name: Cemetery Iron Railing
models.description: Wrought-iron cemetery railing section, 2.5 m long and 1.6 m tall. Spear-topped square bars and one square post, with black paint chipped and rusting, heaviest near the ground. Sections tile every 2.5 m.

models.name: Cemetery Iron Gate
models.description: Wrought-iron double churchyard gate, 2.4 m wide and about 2 m tall, between two stone pillars (3.4 m overall). Spear-topped bars, a band of rings and a ring handle in chipped, rusting black paint, and weathered limestone pillars with lichen and moss.

models.name: Ceramic Soap Pump
models.description: A stone white ceramic soap dispenser with a chrome pump head, about 20 cm tall. For a vanity, sink or kitchen counter.

models.name: Chainsaw
models.description: Petrol chainsaw with a 45 cm guide bar and a full cutting chain, about 85 cm long. Ochre housing scuffed and oil stained, a wraparound front handle, a pull starter and a rusty muffler.

models.name: Chairlift Bottom Station
models.description: Chairlift drive station, about 9 x 9 m, with a 5.2 m bullwheel under a red snow covered canopy. A loading deck, guide rails and an operator hut with a hinged door stand beside it, with icicles on the eaves.

models.name: Chairlift Line Tower
models.description: Galvanised steel chairlift tower, 12 m tall, with sheave trains on a cross arm and a ladder up the column. Snow lies on the cross arm, catwalk and footing. The rope runs 5 m apart over both trains.

models.name: Chairlift Quad Chair
models.description: Four seat chairlift chair, 2.1 m wide and 2.6 m tall to its rope grip, with blue padded seats. The restraint bar with footrests is lowered and hinges up.

models.name: Chairlift Top Station
models.description: Chairlift return station, about 10 x 9 m, with a 5.2 m bullwheel on a tension carriage under a red snow covered canopy. A steel A frame holds it, beside a concrete unloading ramp.

models.name: Chanterelle Cluster
models.description: Six golden chanterelles about 20 cm across growing together from a cushion of moss. Funnel shaped caps with wavy, rolled edges and blunt forked ridges running down the stems.

models.name: Checkout Counter
models.description: Supermarket checkout counter, 3.5 m long and 0.86 m high, with a conveyor belt, scanner, till screen, card terminal and bagging shelf. Grey laminate with stainless trims, a blue band, a lane light post, divider bars, some shopping on the belt and a cashier's swivel chair.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Checkpoint Flag
models.description: Checkpoint flag on a 2.5 m aluminium pole in a round rubber weight, flying a 1 x 0.65 m orange flag. Two white chevrons point to a black and white chequer band on the fly edge; the fabric ripples in a looping wave.

models.name: Cheeseburger
models.description: Cheeseburger about 11 cm wide and 9 cm tall on a glossy sesame brioche bun. A charred beef patty with melted cheese drooping over its edge, red onion, tomato, ruffled lettuce and a little ketchup.

models.name: Cherry Blossom Tree
models.description: Flowering park cherry tree in full bloom, about 8 m tall and 10 m wide. A short, dark trunk with banded bark splits low into long, spreading limbs under a broad umbrella crown of pale pink blossom.

models.name: Wooden Chest of Drawers
models.description: Solid oak chest of drawers, 0.93 m wide and 0.85 m high, with two short drawers over three long ones that pull out. Oiled quarter sawn oak with ray fleck, a moulded top and base, turned bun feet and aged brass bow handles; the drawers are dovetailed and lined in bare oak.

models.name: Chicken Coop
models.description: Small raised timber hen house with a chicken wire run, 2 x 1.2 m and 1.7 m tall. Faded red boards, white trims and a black tin shed roof, with a cleated ramp up to the pop hole and a nest box whose lid lifts.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Children Crossing Sign
models.description: Triangular children warning sign, 90 cm per side, on a 2.5 m galvanized post. Two running children in black on white inside a red border, the sheeting lightly scratched, for streets near schools and playgrounds.

models.name: Supermarket Chillers
models.description: Supermarket chiller pair, 7.5 m long and 2.05 m tall: a five-door glass fridge row and an open multideck dairy chiller, each 3.75 m. Stocked with unbranded drinks, cartons, bottles and yogurts, with white cabinets, black frames and LED strips that glow in the dark.

models.name: Chocolate Sprinkle Donut
models.description: A ring donut with chocolate icing and sprinkles, 9 cm across and 3 cm tall. The glossy icing runs down the sides in short drips, scattered with colourful sugar strands.

models.name: Chopping Block with Axe
models.description: Birch chopping block, 45 cm across and 50 cm tall, with an axe stuck in the top. The greyed end grain is covered in axe cuts and radial checks, with a rim of white birch bark. Three split quarters and a scatter of wood chips lie at its foot.

models.name: Christmas Finial Ornament
models.description: Mirrored glass finial ornament, 14 cm long, shaped like a long teardrop. Green and silver sections with ribs, a spiral point and four deep silver reflector dishes edged in glitter, under a silver cap and hook.

models.name: Christmas Market Chalet
models.description: Wooden Christmas market chalet, 3 m wide, 2.5 m deep and 3.5 m tall. A dark stained timber hut with a steep shingled roof under light snow, its front shutter propped open as an awning over a worn counter, shelves of candles, jars and wooden toys, and a fir garland with red bows and warm lights.

models.name: Christmas Pudding
models.description: A dark steamed Christmas pudding, 15 cm across, on a plate. Thick white sauce is poured over the top and runs down the fruit studded sides, with a sprig of holly and red berries on top.

models.name: Christmas Snow Globe
models.description: A glass snow globe on a turned walnut base, 15 cm tall. Inside the clear water a little snowy village of three cottages and a fir tree sits under flakes caught mid fall, with a small air bubble at the top.

models.name: Christmas Stocking
models.description: A 45 cm knitted Christmas stocking in red, green and cream with Nordic stars and small trees. It is gently filled so it bulges, with a fluffy white cuff and a twisted cord loop to hang it by.

models.name: Decorated Christmas Tree
models.description: Decorated spruce Christmas tree, 2.2 m tall to its straw star, in a green steel stand. About 40 red, gold and silver glass baubles, warm white lights that read lit at night, and straw stars and goats tied with red thread. It sways a little in the wind.

models.name: City Bicycle
models.description: Step-through city bicycle with a front basket, 1.9 m long. Bottle green frame, cream mudguards and chain guard, cream wall tyres, a swept-back bar, sprung brown saddle, rear rack, lamps and a bell.

models.name: Low-Floor City Bus
models.description: Generic two-axle low-floor city bus, 12.0 m long, 2.55 m wide and 3.10 m tall. Plain teal with a light grey roof, a long glass band, a flat windscreen under a blank destination display, two glazed double doors and rows of seats inside. Wheels and steering wheel turn.

models.name: City Litter Bin
models.description: Pressed steel city litter bin, 1.0 m high and 0.6 m across its base plate. Dark green powder coat with chipped edges and rust at the foot, a domed hood with a stubber plate, slotted sides showing the galvanized liner and a lockable front door.

models.name: City Sidewalk With Guard Fence
models.description: Straight 6 x 12 m city sidewalk with a granite kerb on one side, grey concrete paving slabs, a yellow tactile guide line and a white pedestrian guard fence along the kerb. Runs beside the road pieces on the 6 m module.

models.name: City Street Lamp
models.description: City street lamp, 9 m tall, in dark grey steel. A fluted cast base with a service door carries a tapered pole and a mast arm that curves over the street into a flat LED head, whose LED panel glows. The arm reaches about 2.5 m out.

models.name: City Taxi
models.description: Boxy upright saloon taxi, 4.70 m long and 1.70 m wide, in deep blue-black. Chrome bumpers and grille, mirrors on the front wings, a blank lit lantern on the roof and white lace covers on the seats. Wheels steer and spin, and the four doors open.

models.name: Classic 1970s Coupe
models.description: Generic 1970s grand touring coupe, 4.50 m long and 1.74 m wide, in deep metallic green. A long bonnet, a short fastback deck, chrome bumpers and window frames, twin round headlamps and a tan leather cabin.

models.name: Classroom
models.description: School classroom on an 8 x 8 m grid footprint with a 3.6 m storey. Rows of double desks with stacking chairs, a whiteboard wall with the teacher's desk, tray storage and a bookcase, and a wall of tall windows with half-lowered blinds.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Claw Hammer
models.description: A 33 cm claw hammer with a hickory handle, lying flat. The forged head has a black painted eye, a worn striking face and a split claw, and the handle is darkened with grime where it is gripped.

models.name: Clay Oil Lamp
models.description: A small terracotta oil lamp 12 cm long, with a nozzle, a wick hole and a ring handle. The clay is worn and dusty.

models.name: Cleanroom Airlock
models.description: Pass-through cleanroom airlock, 3 x 2.5 m, with sliding glass doors at both ends, stainless air shower nozzle columns, a ceiling filter unit, a steel bench with boots on its shoe shelf and a wall rack of coveralls on hangers.

models.name: Granite Cliff Face
models.description: Tiling rock wall of bedded, jointed granite gneiss, 36 m wide and about 21 m high. Hard beds stand out as ledges, joints split the face into blocks, with dark seepage streaks, lichen and grass on the ledges. Place copies 36 m apart for a continuous cliff.

models.name: Clipped Hedge Corner
models.description: Right-angle corner of clipped garden hedge in a 2 m cell, 1.5 m tall and 75 cm deep. Dense small dark leaves with fresh lighter shoots breaking the clipped outline; it joins its neighbours on a 2 m grid without a seam.

models.name: Clipped Hedge End
models.description: End of a clipped garden hedge, 1.5 m tall and 75 cm deep, with a rounded clipped end. Dense small dark leaves with fresh lighter shoots breaking the clipped outline; it joins its neighbours on a 2 m grid without a seam.

models.name: Clipped Hedge Gateway
models.description: Clipped garden hedge in a 2 m cell with a 1 m opening for a path or gate, 1.5 m tall and 75 cm deep. Dense small dark leaves with fresh lighter shoots breaking the clipped outline; it joins its neighbours on a 2 m grid without a seam.

models.name: Clipped Hedge Straight
models.description: Straight 2 m length of clipped garden hedge, 1.5 m tall and 75 cm deep. Dense small dark leaves with fresh lighter shoots breaking the clipped outline; it joins its neighbours on a 2 m grid without a seam.

models.name: Cloak Peg Rack
models.description: A wall peg board 90 cm wide with a green and a brown hooded wool cloak hanging from it. The board's back sits on the wall and the pegs are 1.62 m up.

models.name: Closed Clam Shell
models.description: Small closed clam shell about 8 cm across with natural growth rings and banding on a wet surface.

models.name: Closed Leather Spellbook
models.description: A closed spellbook 24 cm long and 7 cm thick, bound in oxblood leather. Brass corners guard the boards, a gem medallion sits on the front and a leather strap with a clasp holds it shut.

models.name: Cloth Merchant's Stall
models.description: A cloth merchant's stall 2 m wide with bolts of bright dyed cloth on the counter and lengths hanging from a rail.

models.name: White Clover Patch
models.description: Patch of white clover about 50 cm across, with five round white flower heads on stalks up to 15 cm. Three-part leaves with a pale chevron rise from runners creeping over the ground; older florets turn pink-brown under each head.

models.name: CNC Machine Set
models.description: Machine shop set of an enclosed CNC milling centre about 2.4 m wide, an engine lathe, a pillar drill press and a pallet of crated parts. Light grey enclosure with a sliding glazed door, control screen and signal light, teal grey castings and light shop grime.

models.name: Coast at Dusk Painting
models.description: A small invented seascape, 95 by 75 cm, in a walnut frame with a gilt slip. The sun sets over a calm sea beside a dark rocky headland.

models.name: Roller Coaster Loading Station
models.description: Roller coaster loading station about 18 m long and 10 m wide: a platform under a red standing-seam roof with bulb-lit fascia, railings and five air gates that open. The track runs straight through and joins the kit on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Coaster Track Banked Curve
models.description: Banked 90 degree curve of steel roller coaster track with a 12 m radius, red tubular rails on white lattice columns. Starts at its origin and joins the other pieces on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Coaster Track Crest
models.description: Crest piece of steel roller coaster track about 4 m long that tops out near 8 m high, red tubular rails on a tall white lattice column. Links the lift hill to the drop on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Coaster Track Drop
models.description: Steep drop of steel roller coaster track falling about 8 m over 8 m, red tubular rails on white lattice columns with concrete footings. Starts at its origin on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Roller Coaster Track Kit
models.description: Snap-together steel roller coaster track: straight, banked curve, lift hill, crest, drop, a 16 m vertical loop and a covered station. Red tubular rails on white lattice columns with concrete footings. Every piece starts at its own origin and runs forward on a 1 m grid.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Coaster Track Lift Hill
models.description: Lift hill section of steel roller coaster track, climbing about 6.5 m over 8.5 m with a chain and anti-rollback ratchet between the red rails, on white lattice columns. Starts at its origin on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Coaster Track Straight 8 m
models.description: Straight 8 m piece of steel roller coaster track with red tubular rails on white lattice columns and concrete footings. Starts at its origin and runs forward on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Coaster Track Vertical Loop
models.description: Vertical loop of steel roller coaster track about 17 m tall, red tubular rails held by white lattice columns on concrete footings. Starts at its origin and exits on line on a 1 m grid.

models.name: Roller Coaster Train
models.description: A 13 m roller coaster train of five linked cars seating 20 riders, with a sculpted front car. Bright blue tubs with yellow flashes, padded seats with headrests and a lap bar per row. Its wheels clamp the rails of the Roller Coaster Track Kit; move each car along the track on its own.

models.name: Coffee Bar Counter
models.description: Straight coffee shop counter module, 1.2 m long and 0.95 m high. Reeded oak front, honed marble top, open shelves and a cash drawer on the staff side. Snaps to the corner and flap pieces on a 1.2 m grid.

models.name: Coffee Bar Counter Corner
models.description: Outside corner piece for a coffee shop counter, 0.7 x 0.7 m and 0.95 m high, with reeded oak faces on two sides under a honed marble top. Butts the end of a straight counter module.

models.name: Coffee Bar Counter Flap
models.description: Lift-up counter flap, 0.6 m long, in honed marble on an oak frame, with its origin on the hinge line. Hangs off the end of a coffee bar counter and swings up to let staff through.

models.name: Coffee Table
models.description: Low coffee table in light oak, 1.1 x 0.6 m and 0.42 m tall, in a plain modern style. A solid top with softly rounded corners on square legs, and a lower shelf holding two cloth-bound books and a speckled stoneware bowl.

models.name: Coiled Guitar Cable
models.description: Black instrument cable lying in loose coils on the floor, rising to a jack plug at each end. Spans about 0.45 m.

models.name: Coiled Rope
models.description: A coil of three strand rope about 45 cm across, bundled with wraps around its neck and its taped ends trailing on the ground.

models.name: Coin Purse with Spilled Gold
models.description: A small leather coin purse 12 cm tall, tied with a drawstring, with a handful of gold coins spilled in front of it. The coins lie scattered, stacked and leaning on the purse.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Blast Door
models.description: 4 m bunker corridor piece with a heavy blast door frame and a round steel door that swings open, locked by a turning wheel. Poured concrete with a green dado.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Control Room
models.description: 4 m concrete bunker room lined with analogue control consoles, gauges and switches that glow. Green dado, cable trays and caged lamps. Joins the 4 m bunker corridors.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Corridor Corner
models.description: 4 m right-angle corner of an arched poured-concrete bunker corridor, with a green dado, cable trays and caged lamps. Joins the other 4 m bunker pieces.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Corridor
models.description: Straight 4 m piece of arched poured-concrete bunker corridor with a green painted dado, cable trays, a vent duct and caged lamps. Chains with the other 4 m bunker pieces.

models.name: Cold War Bunker Stair Down
models.description: 4 m concrete bunker piece with a stair dropping one level, about 6 m tall overall. Green dado, handrail, cable trays and caged lamps. Joins the 4 m bunker corridors.

models.name: Cold War Bunker T-Junction
models.description: 4 m T-junction of arched poured-concrete bunker corridors, with a green dado, cable trays and caged lamps. Joins the other 4 m bunker pieces on three sides.

models.name: Color Field Abstract Painting
models.description: A large invented colour field painting, 1.28 by 1.58 m, in a thin black floater frame. Soft-edged red and blue blocks float on an ochre ground.

models.name: Bipedal Combat Mech
models.description: Original two-legged combat mech about 7 m tall, with reverse-jointed legs and three-toed feet. Squat faceted gunmetal armour with orange hazard accents and worn edges, an autocannon arm, a twin-gun arm, a shoulder missile pod and a canopy hatch on the cockpit.

models.name: Combination Pliers
models.description: A pair of 20 cm combination pliers lying flat, with red dipped grips. The steel jaws are worn bright on their teeth.

models.name: Combination Wrench
models.description: A 21 cm combination wrench with an open end and a ring end, lying flat. Worn chrome over steel, dulled and scratched from use.

models.name: Combine Harvester
models.description: Large combine harvester, 10.2 m long with a 7.6 m wide grain header and 4 m tall to the beacons. Plain cream bodywork on a dark grey frame, a glazed cab with seat and controls, big lugged drive tyres and small rear steering wheels, dusty from harvest.

models.name: Commercial Gas Range
models.description: A 1.2 m stainless steel restaurant gas range with six open burners under heavy cast iron grates and two ovens below. It has black knobs under a front rail, a flue riser carrying a high shelf, and the heat tint and baked grease of a hard working line.

models.name: Common Reed Clump
models.description: Clump of common reed standing in shallow water, about 2 x 1.4 m. Green stems 1.5 to 2.5 m tall with grey-green leaves and purple-brown plumes, mixed with last year's straw-coloured stems. Plant clumps about 1.5 m apart along the shore.

models.name: Communications Satellite
models.description: A communications satellite about 15 m across its solar wings: a box body wrapped in crinkled gold foil, silver radiator panels, a 2.6 m reflector dish on a hinged arm and small antennas on top. The wings fold panel by panel.

models.name: Compound Microscope
models.description: A binocular compound microscope, 47 cm tall, with an off-white stand, a black mechanical stage and four objectives on a turret. A small lamp in the base glows under the stage.

models.name: Concert Stage
models.description: Outdoor festival stage with a 16 x 10 m deck at 1.6 m, under a box-truss roof on four towers, about 10.5 m tall. Line-array PA hangs on both wings, moving-head and par lights on the trusses, a blank LED screen upstage, wedge monitors, stairs and a crowd barrier in front.

models.name: Concrete Block Barricade
models.description: A heavy precast concrete block used as a roadblock, about 1.75 m long and 0.9 m high. Chipped, stained grey concrete.

models.name: Building Under Construction
models.description: Five storey reinforced concrete frame under construction, 24 x 18 m and about 19 m tall. Cast floors with mesh edge protection, a top storey of column forms, props and roof slab formwork, a stair core with starter bars and a hoist mast with its cage on the right side.

models.name: Highway Overpass
