models.description: A 30 m concrete box-girder highway overpass, 11.3 m wide, on a twin-column pier between closed abutments. Two lanes with hard shoulders, concrete crash barriers with a steel top rail and three lamp posts whose LED heads glow at night. The road runs left to right.

models.name: Concrete Planter
models.description: Precast concrete planter, 2 x 1 m and 0.8 m tall, planted with clipped evergreen shrubs in mulch. Light grey concrete with rain streaks, scuffs and street grime; heavy enough to double as a vehicle barrier in a pedestrian plaza.

models.name: Concrete Pump Truck
models.description: Generic three-axle truck-mounted concrete pump, about 11 m long, 2.5 m wide and 4 m tall with its four-section placing boom folded. White cab with a grey and yellow stripe, a yellow boom, outriggers and rear hopper, and grey concrete splatter and dust low down.

models.name: Concrete Utility Pole
models.description: Concrete utility pole of a dense East Asian back street, 12 m tall. Crossarms with porcelain insulators, two grey transformers, a heavy bundle of black telecom cables with service drops, step bolts, a small LED street light and a striped guard sleeve. Cables end in short stubs for chaining poles.

models.name: Circuit Concrete Wall
models.description: Race circuit concrete safety wall, a 6.0 m section 3.6 m tall with its debris fence. A 1.1 m jersey wall painted in white and dark grey bands, with chain-link mesh and tensioned wires on steel posts above. Sections tile every 6 m.

models.name: Conical Flask 100 ml
models.description: A 100 ml glass conical flask, 11 cm tall, with a beaded rim and a little red liquid in the bottom.

models.name: Conical Flask 250 ml
models.description: A 250 ml glass conical flask, 15 cm tall, with a beaded rim and a shallow pool of green liquid.

models.name: Container Lashing Bar Rack
models.description: A steel stand holding long container lashing bars upright, about 1.3 m wide and 3.8 m tall. Worn painted steel with rust, used on quays and container yards.

models.name: Container Ship
models.description: Gearless feeder container ship, 141 m long and 22.5 m wide, loaded with stacks of plain coloured containers. Slate blue hull over red antifouling with a bulbous bow, white aft accommodation and funnel, rust streaks and salt from years of coastal service. Floats with the waterline at the origin.

models.name: Three-High 20 ft Container Stack
models.description: Six 20 ft shipping containers stacked two side by side and three high, about 5.3 m wide, 6.1 m long and 7.8 m tall. Boxes in faded plain colours with rust streaks and grime, no text or codes.

models.name: Four-High 40 ft Container Stack
models.description: A single row of four 40 ft shipping containers stacked four high, about 2.4 m wide, 12.2 m long and 10.4 m tall. Boxes in faded plain colours with rust streaks and grime, no text or codes.

models.name: Two-High 40 ft Container Stack
models.description: Four 40 ft shipping containers stacked two side by side and two high, about 5.3 m wide, 12.2 m long and 5.2 m tall. Boxes in faded plain colours with rust streaks and grime, no text or codes.

models.name: Container Stack Set
models.description: Container yard set: blocks of stacked 20 ft and 40 ft ISO boxes two to four high, with yard equipment around them. Boxes in faded plain colours with rust and grime and no text or codes, plus a reefer plug rack, lashing bars, a twistlock bin and a 30 m floodlight mast that glows at night.

models.name: Container Twistlock Bin
models.description: A small steel bin full of loose container twistlocks, about 1.3 m wide and 0.8 m tall. Rusty, dented steel, set down beside container stacks.

models.name: Container Yard Floodlight Mast
models.description: A tall floodlight mast for a container yard, about 31.5 m high, with a railed ring platform carrying a crown of floodlights that glow at night. Weathered grey steel on a concrete footing.

models.name: Factory Control Room
models.description: Raised factory control room, a 6 x 4 m glazed booth on a steel frame 2.45 m up, reached by a steel stair and landing. Light grey panels, a forward leaning window band and a console desk inside with glowing screens, control panels and office chairs, plus a wall display and cabinets.

models.name: Airport Control Tower
models.description: Airport control tower about 42 m tall: a glazed twelve sided cab on a flared concrete shaft over a one storey base. The outward sloping tinted glass shows lit consoles and chairs inside, and the roof carries a radar dome, antenna masts and red obstruction lights.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Belt Conveyor Transfer
models.description: A 1.5 m powered belt conveyor section that carries parts between the roller sections of an assembly line. Light grey frame on adjustable legs with a blue gearmotor and a dark rubber belt, lightly scuffed from daily use.

models.name: Conveyor End Stop
models.description: A 1 m roller conveyor end piece with a sturdy end stop that halts parts at the end of an assembly line. Light grey frame on adjustable legs with galvanized rollers, lightly scuffed from daily use.

models.name: Conveyor Head Pulley Drive
models.description: Head end of an overland belt conveyor: a rubber lagged drive pulley that spins, an electric motor and gearbox on a drive platform, discharge hood and chute, snub pulley, belt scraper, starter cabinet and a work light.

models.name: Roller Conveyor Curve
models.description: A 90 degree roller conveyor curve for a factory assembly line, with galvanized rollers between guide rails. Light grey frame on adjustable legs, lightly scuffed from daily use. It snaps to the matching straight, belt transfer and end stop.

models.name: Roller Conveyor Straight
models.description: A 4 m powered roller conveyor straight for a factory assembly line. Light grey frame on adjustable legs with a blue gearmotor, galvanized rollers and guide rails, lightly scuffed from daily use. It snaps to the matching curve, belt transfer and end stop.

models.name: Conveyor Transfer Tower
models.description: Steel conveyor transfer tower where an incoming belt drops ore through a worn chute onto a belt running at right angles. Clad upper storey, head drive, two floors, stairs, landings, railings, lights and a beacon.

models.name: Electric Cooker
models.description: Freestanding 0.6 m electric cooker, 0.9 m tall to line up with kitchen worktops. A black glass ceramic hob with four cooking zones, four steel knobs on a black glass fascia, an oven door with a tinted window and a storage drawer below. The zones have their own material so they can be made to glow.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Pots and Pans Set
models.description: Kitchen cookware set: a 22 cm stainless stock pot with lid, a 16 cm saucepan and a 28 cm black non-stick frying pan. Brushed steel with spun rings and a black grip on the pan. Each piece is its own node, so the set can be placed on a hob or shelf.

models.name: Cooler Box
models.description: A 50 litre cooler box, about 0.7 m long and 0.44 m tall, with a sea-blue body and a white lid. Rugged moulded plastic, slightly sun-faded and scuffed, with sand dusting the base.

models.name: Cooling Tower
models.description: Hyperboloid concrete cooling tower 110 m tall and about 80 m across at the base. Rain-streaked shell with a thick rim, red aviation lights, and an open base of diagonal column pairs showing the cooling fill and the water basin inside.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Copper Alembic Still
models.description: A small copper alembic still whose spout runs down into a glass receiver of glowing blue distillate.

models.name: Reef Coral Set
models.description: Four reef corals 0.4 to 1.2 m tall or wide, as separate pieces: a brain coral dome, a branching staghorn coral, a purple sea fan and a flat table coral. Healthy, saturated reef colours with pale growing tips and rims.

models.name: Cordless Drill
models.description: A cordless drill about 25 cm tall standing on its battery, with a twist bit in its keyless chuck. Orange and charcoal plastic, a black rubber grip and no markings; the chuck turns.

models.name: Corn Row
models.description: A 4 m row of green field corn about 2.4 m tall. Tasselled stalks carry husked cobs with silks among long arching leaves, and rows join end to end without a seam.

models.name: Corn Stalk Bundle
models.description: An upright bundle of seven dry corn stalks about 1.9 m tall, tied with twine, with curled brown leaves and tassels. The stalks sway in the wind above the tie.

models.name: Corner Flag
models.description: Football corner flag, 1.5 m tall, on a small rubber base. A flexible white post with a rounded top and a red and yellow checked flag hanging in soft folds, in a spring socket on a 22 cm black base.

models.name: Corner Shop Block
models.description: Three-storey brick corner building, 18 x 18 m and 13.5 m tall to the chimney pots, with a chamfered corner shop door. Shopfronts with blank fascias and striped awnings wrap both street faces, under flats with stone-dressed sash windows, small iron balconies, a cornice and lit windows.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Fabric Corner Sofa
models.description: L-shaped corner sofa, 2.8 m by 1.9 m with a 0.43 m seat, upholstered in warm grey woven fabric. Piped seat and back cushions softly creased from use, loose rust velvet and oatmeal herringbone scatter cushions, on slim tapered oak legs.

models.name: Corrugated Sheet Barricade Fence
models.description: An improvised fence of rusted corrugated metal sheets wired to posts and braces, about 4.2 m wide and 2.4 m tall. Patched, dented and streaked with rust.

models.name: Covered Drain Channel 2 m
models.description: Concrete drain channel 2 m long and about 0.4 m wide with a cast iron grate cover, for street edges and sidewalks. Pieces run end to end.

models.name: Covered Freight Wagon
models.description: A 16.5 m covered freight wagon with sliding side doors in weathered oxide red. It rides on two freight bogies and shows rust, grime and brake dust. Standard gauge; the wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Covered Wooden Bridge
models.description: A 24 m covered timber truss bridge for one lane, on rock-faced stone abutments. Weathered red board-and-batten siding with small windows, an open strip under the eaves, a mossy shingle gable roof and a plank deck with running boards. The road runs through it from end to end.

models.name: Cow Parsley
models.description: Flowering clump of cow parsley, about 1.1 m tall: finely divided leaves low down, branching hollow stems and flat white umbels of tiny flowers.

models.name: Cracked Marble Bench
models.description: A 1.9 m marble bench with a cracked seat slab on scrolled supports, its broken corner lying on the ground in front. The stone is weathered with lichen and dust.

models.name: Crate of Apples
models.description: A slatted wooden crate 62 cm long heaped with red and yellow apples.

models.name: Cratered Stony Asteroid
models.description: Stony asteroid about 9 m across, a lumpy body covered in craters of every size. Dark, dusty grey rock, centred on its origin.

models.name: Cream Boucle Cushion
models.description: A square cushion in cream boucle, about 50 cm across. The curly looped weave reads soft and nubby, and the full shape has a shallow dent where it was leaned on.

models.name: Cream Dome Kettle
models.description: A cream enamel dome kettle on a power base, about 25 cm tall. Rounded body with a chrome band and lid knob, a rising spout and a handle arching over the back.

models.name: Cream Two-Slice Toaster
models.description: A cream enamel two slice toaster with rounded ends, about 30 cm long. Chrome slot surrounds, a lever and a browning knob on the front, matching the dome kettle.

models.name: Creeping Ivy
models.description: Common ivy creeping over the ground in a spread about 1 m across, a few centimetres high. Glossy, dark green leaves with three to five pointed lobes and pale veins rise on curved stalks from trailing runners, with a few bronze winter leaves and small light ones at the tips.

models.name: Crew Capsule
models.description: Original blunt-cone crew capsule, about 4 m across, stacked on its service module with a main engine. The charred heat shield and scorch-streaked backshell show a flown spacecraft, with round windows, a side hatch, a docking port, RCS thrusters and radiator panels.

models.name: Crimson Hanging Banner
models.description: A blank crimson wool banner with a gold border, hanging 2.9 m below its brass hook ring. Its origin is the hook, so it hangs from a wall or beam.

models.name: Crimson Runner Rug
models.description: A woven runner rug 1.3 m wide and 5 m long in crimson with a patterned border, its length running front to back.

models.name: Kitchen Crockery Set
models.description: Kitchen table set on a 0.6 m footprint: a speckled blue enamel coffee pot, three enamel mugs, a stack of six stoneware plates and a pine bread board with a crusty loaf. Each piece is its own node, so the set can be rearranged.

models.name: Croissant
models.description: A butter croissant, about 13 cm tip to tip and 3.5 cm tall. Rolled, laminated layers shine under a soft egg wash glaze, darker on the crests.

models.name: Cross Screwdriver
models.description: A 20 cm cross head screwdriver with a fluted yellow handle and black rubber grip inserts, lying flat. The chrome shaft ends in a four point tip.

models.name: Cruiser Motorcycle
models.description: Generic long, low V-twin cruiser motorcycle, 2.4 m long. Deep teal with cream tank panels, a polished air-cooled engine with deep fins, wide pulled-back bars, a solo sprung saddle, laced wire wheels and twin staggered pipes.

models.name: Crusty Bread Loaf
models.description: Crusty loaf of bread about 24 cm long with a golden brown crust. Fits on a bread board or a bakery shelf.

models.name: Crypt Altar with Candles
models.description: A grey limestone altar with a carved front, about 1.9 m wide and 1.2 m high, with melted candle stubs on its top. Worn and stained.

models.name: Crypt Burial Niches
models.description: A wall block of two stone burial niches, one above the other, holding bound shrouded bodies, about 2.5 m wide and 2.4 m high. Grey limestone, worn and dusty.

models.name: Crypt Set
models.description: Crypt furnishings in grey limestone: a 2.4 m sarcophagus carved with a blind arcade and a gabled lid that slides off, an altar with a carved front and melted candle stubs, a block of two burial niches holding bound shrouds, and a coffin lid leaning on a wall.

models.name: Office Cubicle Pod
models.description: Pod of four office desks inside charcoal fabric screens, about 3 x 3 m with the chairs. White desks with monitors, keyboards, desk lamps, white drawer pedestals and black mesh task chairs. The blank monitor screens are separate meshes, ready for an image or video.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Painted Cabin Cupboard
models.description: Painted wooden cupboard, 1.0 x 0.45 m and 1.8 m tall, in a Nordic cabin style. Soft blue-grey paint rubbed through to the wood on the edges, a cove cornice, two fielded-panel doors with oiled pine knobs and two shelves inside.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Castle Wall Kit
models.description: Crenellated castle curtain wall pieces, 2.6 m thick with a wall walk at 11 m: straight, stairs, corner, step up, step down and end caps. Weathered coursed stone, arrow slits, a corbelled corner turret and stone stairs. Pieces chain end to end with the merlons facing out.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Curve Warning Sign
models.description: Triangular 900 mm warning sign for a right-hand bend, on a galvanized post. Red border and black bend symbol on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back. Mirror it on X for a left-hand bend.

models.name: Cushion-Cut Sapphire
models.description: Cushion-cut blue sapphire about 3 cm across with real flat facets and a clear refractive material whose colour deepens through the thicker parts of the stone.

models.name: Cyan Crystal Shard
models.description: A single glowing cyan crystal shard 23 cm long, pointed at both ends and standing upright. Its light seems to come from a core inside the translucent stone.

models.name: Cyclist
models.description: Woman in cycling kit: close-fitting jersey, black bib shorts, cycling helmet and trainers (no bicycle). Rigged with a 56-bone humanoid skeleton and four looping animations (idle, walk, wave, look_around). Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z.

models.name: Dairy Cow
models.description: Black and white dairy cow, 1.45 m at the shoulder and 2.4 m long, polled, with yellow ear tags. A bony dairy frame with sharp hips, ribs and a large pink udder, ragged patches, short glossy hair and muddy legs. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1.1 m/s walking and 2.6 m/s trotting.
models.changes: Rebuilt anatomy (hip and pin bones, ribs, udder, dewlap, long bony face), ragged patches, dirt, short hair, eyes and ear tags.

models.name: Dandelion Patch
models.description: Patch of dandelion rosettes about 40 cm across, with three yellow flowers, two seed clocks and a bud on stalks up to 30 cm. Toothed leaves lie in flat rosettes around the origin; flower stalks and heads carry wind data for sway.

models.name: Street Data Terminal
models.description: A slim public terminal with a tilted screen of glowing charts on a pedestal. Use it as an info point, ticket machine or hacking spot.

models.name: Fallen Dead Branches
models.description: Small pile of fallen dead spruce and birch branches about 1.5 m across, with dry twigs and a few brown needles. Origin on the ground at the centre of the pile.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Dead Spruce Snag
models.description: Standing dead spruce, about 12 m tall, with a snapped jagged top. Grey bark falls away in patches from silver weathered wood; bare drooping branches, many broken short, carry dead twigs and pale beard lichen that sway in the wind.

models.name: Dead Thornbush
models.description: A dead, leafless African thornbush about 1.6 m tall. Its bare, thorny zigzag stems are bleached silver grey by the sun.

models.name: Delineator Post
models.description: White plastic roadside delineator post, 1.0 m above ground, trapezoid cross-section with a sloped top, black band, a rectangular retroreflector facing traffic (+Z) and two round reflectors on the back. Origin at ground level at the center of the traffic face.

models.name: Delivery Scooter
models.description: Small 125 cc delivery scooter, 1.8 m long. White with a dark floor, a tall clear windshield, a single seat and a large blank red delivery box on a flat rear carrier, its lid hinged at the back. Dusty from daily rounds.

models.name: High-Roof Delivery Van
models.description: Generic high-roof panel van, 5.95 m long, 2.02 m wide and 2.55 m tall. Plain white with black bumpers, a short sloped bonnet, a sliding side door, twin rear doors and windowless cargo sides. Wheels and steering wheel turn.

models.name: Delta-Wing Fighter
models.description: Original single-engine canard delta fighter jet, about 16 m long with its nose probe and a 10.1 m wingspan. Two-tone light grey with a darker radome and light service wear, a cranked delta wing blended into the body, a dorsal spine, close-coupled canards and a bubble canopy.

models.name: Dented Tin Can
models.description: A sealed tin can about 10 cm tall with a plain red label and a dented side, scuffed and water stained.

models.name: Derelict Passenger Coach
models.description: A derelict 20 m passenger rail coach in faded green and cream, rusting, with smashed windows and a saloon of torn seats and hanging ceiling panels. Standard gauge: the rear bogie stands on the rail kit's rails, the front one has dropped off them.

models.name: Desktop Monitor
models.description: A 27-inch widescreen monitor, 61 cm wide and 47 cm tall, on a height and tilt adjustable stand. Thin black bezels, a charcoal textured back with vents, an aluminium neck with a cable pass-through and a graphite base, with two cables trailing back; the blank screen is ready for an image or video.

models.name: Diesel Locomotive
models.description: A 20 m road-switcher diesel locomotive with a full-width cab, a long engine hood and walkways, riding on two three-axle bogies. Deep green with yellow railings, hazard-striped buffer beams and light road grime. Standard gauge; its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Digging Fork
models.description: A four tine digging fork about 1.35 m long lying flat, with an ash handle and a D grip. Rusty steel tines with soil on their points.

models.name: Digital Camera
models.description: An interchangeable lens digital camera with a standard zoom lens, 13 cm wide, its woven strap lying in a loop behind it. Dark grey body with a pebbled grip; the blank rear display is ready for an image or video.

models.name: Dining Chair
models.description: Oak dining chair with a woven seat, 0.8 m tall with a 0.45 m seat height. The back legs and top rail are one steam bent round member, with a curved back slat, turned front legs and a natural paper cord seat woven in four triangles.

models.name: Dining Table
models.description: Solid oak dining table for six, 1.8 m long, 0.9 m wide and 0.75 m tall. Four square legs, a top of glued light oak boards with soft edges, a natural linen runner draped over both ends and a clear glass bottle vase holding three stems of eucalyptus.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Dirt Bike
models.description: Generic 250 cc motocross bike, 2.15 m long and tall on long-travel forks. White plastics with violet shrouds, blank number plates, knobby tyres and a two-stroke expansion-chamber exhaust, with mud grime low down.

models.name: DJ Booth
models.description: Club DJ booth, 2 m wide and 1 m tall, with two turntables, a two-channel mixer and a laptop on a stand. A black perforated metal front with brushed rails and a blue light strip, monitor speakers on tripod stands at both ends and headphones on the desk.

models.name: Dog Walker
models.description: Older man out for a walk in a waxed-look jacket, flat-front trousers, brown leather shoes and a cap (the dog is not included). Rigged with a 56-bone humanoid skeleton and four looping animations (idle, walk, wave, look_around). Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z.

models.name: Dome Pendant Lamp
models.description: Dome pendant lamp about 0.4 m across on a fabric cord with a 0.75 m drop: a matt sage spun shade, white inside, over a glowing globe bulb. Made for 2.6 m rooms.

models.name: Christmas Door Wreath
models.description: Christmas door wreath, 45 cm across, hanging from a short red ribbon loop. Spruce sprigs and glossy lingonberry twigs with pine cones, red berries and a red satin bow. It hangs from the origin, so place that on a nail or hook.

models.name: Doric Entablature Beam
models.description: A 3 m section of a Doric marble entablature, about 2 m tall: a plain architrave, a frieze of triglyphs and metopes and a projecting cornice. It spans between two columns on a 3 m bay.

models.name: Doric Entablature Corner
models.description: An L-shaped corner of a Doric marble entablature, about 2 m tall, with one 3 m bay along each side. Triglyphs meet at the corner under the cornice.

models.name: Double Bed
models.description: Upholstered double bed, 2.1 m long and 1.6 m wide, in a plain modern style. A grey fabric base and channel-padded headboard, white sheets and duvet turned back under two pillows, and a folded oat knit throw across the foot.

models.name: Double-Door Office Safe
models.description: A classic green double door office safe, 1.5 m tall and 0.79 m wide, standing open. Gold coach lining, a brass plaque, a chrome combination dial and a brass handle, with shelves, a locker and a drawer inside.

models.name: Double Traffic Mirror Post
models.description: Pair of orange 60 cm convex traffic mirrors on a T arm atop a steel post about 3.7 m tall. Sun-faded paint with grime streaks, hooded frames and dusty stainless mirror faces.

models.name: Draped Torso Fragment
models.description: A headless, armless draped marble figure on a rough base, about 1.2 m tall. The folds of its robe and its belt are worn soft by weather.

models.name: Dried Flowers in Jug
models.description: A small sand glazed stoneware jug about 22 cm tall holding a loose bunch of dried stems: poppy pods, fluffy grass heads, yellow button flowers and seed spikes.

models.name: Drink Crate Stack
models.description: Plastic beer and soft drink crates with bottles, stacked up to 1.2 m, and a two-wheel hand trolley, as five separate pieces. Scuffed yellow, red, blue and green lattice crates with brown and green glass bottles under blank labels. The trolley wheels spin.

models.name: Drink Vending Terminal
models.description: A dark vending machine with a lit recess of canned drinks on shelves and a small touch screen. Neon edge strips and street grime finish it.

models.name: Dark Blue Drink Vending Machine
models.description: Street drink vending machine 1 m wide and 1.83 m tall in dark blue with a cream ring, a lit window of blank drink dummies, glowing buttons and a pickup flap. Paint scratched and rusting.

models.name: Red Drink Vending Machine
models.description: Street drink vending machine 1 m wide and 1.83 m tall in red with white diagonal stripes, a lit window of blank drink dummies, glowing buttons and a pickup flap. Scratched and stickered.

models.name: White Drink Vending Machine
models.description: Street drink vending machine 1 m wide and 1.83 m tall in white with a blue wave, a lit window of blank drink dummies, glowing buttons, a coin slot and a pickup flap. Scratched and rusting at the foot.

models.name: Drip Coffee Maker
models.description: A black drip coffee maker about 33 cm tall with a brushed steel brew head. A glass carafe of coffee stands on its warming plate.

models.name: Drop Tower
models.description: A 60 m square steel drop tower with a ring of 16 outward-facing seats with over-shoulder restraints. White panelled shaft lined with chasing bulbs, a red machine house with a warning beacon, splayed legs on a wide concrete base, and a boarding deck with stairs and a fenced queue.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Drum Kit
models.description: Five-piece rock drum kit in wine red sparkle wrap with chrome hardware, about 2 m wide. A 22 inch bass drum with a blank black front head, two rack toms, a floor tom and a snare, plus a hi-hat, crash and ride on stands, a kick pedal and a padded throne.

models.name: Dry Corn Row
models.description: A 4 m row of dry field corn about 2.5 m tall, ready for harvest. Pale stalks and curled leaves carry ears with the husks peeled back, and rows join end to end without a seam.

models.name: Duckweed Patch
models.description: A floating mat of duckweed about 2 m across with a ragged edge and a few small islands drifting off it. Tiny round bright green fronds sit just above the water line.

models.name: Dumbbell Rack
models.description: Two-tier black steel dumbbell rack, 1.4 m long, holding six pairs of rubber hex dumbbells from 5 to 17.5 kg. The sloped trays are lined with rubber and the dumbbells have knurled chrome handles; each dumbbell can be lifted off on its own.

models.name: Articulated Dump Truck
models.description: Generic six-wheel articulated dump truck, about 9.5 m long, 2.9 m wide and 3.4 m tall to the cab roof. Golden yellow with dark grey running gear, a tipping body with a canopy over the hitch, big lugged earthmover tyres and a glazed cab, dusty from hauling on site.

models.name: Wheeled Dumpster
models.description: Green steel wheeled dumpster, 1.3 m wide, 1.0 m deep and 1.3 m tall, on four swivel casters. A split plastic lid in two halves that open separately, dented corners, faded hazard stripes and grime runs.

models.name: Dune Buggy
models.description: Generic two-seat tube-frame sand buggy, 3.8 m long, with a full roll cage and an exposed engine at the back. Bright orange tubes dusted with sand, long-travel suspension, paddle rear tyres, bucket seats with harnesses and a tall whip flag.

models.name: Dungeon Oak Beam Ceiling
models.description: Ceiling tile 4 by 4 m of heavy oak beams and boards, about 0.4 m deep. It sits on top of 4 m dungeon walls on the 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Groin Vault Ceiling
models.description: Groined stone vault 4 by 4 m and about 2.4 m tall in rough limestone. It sits on top of 4 m dungeon walls on the 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Cell Bar Front
models.description: A front wall of iron bars for a dungeon cell, about 3.4 m wide and 4 m tall, with a barred door that swings open. Black rust-streaked iron; fits between walls on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Cell Set
models.description: Dungeon cell dressing: a 4 m wide iron-bar cell front with a barred door, wall shackles on chains, a straw pallet bed, a wooden bucket, a broken stool and loose straw. Black rust-streaked iron and old grey oak; the front fits between 4 m grid walls.

models.name: Dungeon Dart Trap Plate
models.description: Iron wall plate about 1 m wide pierced with dart holes, mounted on a dungeon wall. Black rust-streaked iron.

models.name: Cracked Dungeon Flagstone Floor
models.description: Floor tile 4 by 4 m of worn limestone flagstones, some broken and cracked, on a 0.3 m slab. Snaps to the dungeon 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Floor with Drain Grate
models.description: Floor tile 4 by 4 m of worn limestone flagstones with an iron drain grate set in the middle. Snaps to the dungeon 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Flagstone Floor
models.description: Floor tile 4 by 4 m of worn limestone flagstones on a 0.3 m slab. Snaps to the dungeon 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Floor and Ceiling Kit
models.description: Modular dungeon floors and ceilings on a 4 m grid: worn limestone flagstones (plain, cracked, with a drain grate), a groined stone vault, an oak beam ceiling, a 4 m pillar, a stair rising 4 m over 8 m between walls, a pit edge and a lunette fill. Ceilings sit on 4 m walls.

models.name: Dungeon Hanging Cage
models.description: Iron gibbet cage on a chain hanging from a 4 m dungeon ceiling, about 3.4 m from mount to base. Black rust-streaked iron; the cage swings.

models.name: Dungeon Oak Door
models.description: Heavy oak door for a round-arched dungeon opening, with black iron strap hinges, studs, a ring pull and a barred peep window. It swings on its hinge side and fits the arched wall of the dungeon wall kit.

models.name: Dungeon Pendulum Blade
models.description: Crescent iron blade on a chain, about 2.9 m from ceiling mount to edge, that swings from a 4 m dungeon ceiling. Black rust-streaked iron.

models.name: Dungeon Pit Edge
models.description: Flagstone floor tile 4 by 4 m ending in a kerbed stone lip over a 4 m drop. Snaps to the dungeon 4 m grid to frame pits and lower levels.

models.name: Dungeon Portcullis
models.description: Iron portcullis, 2 x 3 m with spiked feet, in a dressed limestone arch frame. The grille slides up into the frame head to clear the opening. It fits the arched wall of the dungeon wall kit.

models.name: Dungeon Spike Trap
models.description: Floor spike trap about 2.3 m square: a grated iron plate in a limestone frame with iron spikes that rise 0.4 m through the grate. Black rust-streaked iron.

models.name: Dungeon Stone Pillar
models.description: Freestanding limestone pillar 4 m tall and about 0.9 m wide, sized to carry the dungeon vaults. Rough-cut grey stone with damp stains.

models.name: Dungeon Stone Stairs
models.description: Limestone stair rising 4 m over an 8 m run between two side walls, 4 m wide. Joins one dungeon floor level to the next on the 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Trap Set
models.description: Dungeon traps in black rust-streaked iron and grey limestone: a 2 x 2 m floor spike trap with a grated plate, a crescent pendulum blade on a chain, a wall plate of dart holes and a hanging iron cage. The spikes rise 0.4 m through the grate; blade and cage hang from a 4 m ceiling.

models.name: Dungeon Vault Lunette
models.description: Half-moon stone infill about 4 m wide and 2 m tall that closes the arch where a vault meets a wall. Rough-cut limestone matching the dungeon walls.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Archway
models.description: Dungeon wall 4 m long and 4 m tall with a 2 by 3 m arched opening to walk through, in rough-cut grey limestone. Snaps to the 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Inner Corner
models.description: Inner corner piece for dungeon walls, 4 m tall, with an engaged stone shaft in the concave angle where two walls meet in an L. Rough-cut grey limestone.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Outer Corner
models.description: Quoined outer corner piece for dungeon walls, 4 m tall, with long-and-short stones wrapping the convex angle where two walls meet in an L. Rough-cut grey limestone.

models.name: Dungeon Wall End Cap
models.description: Quoined stone pier 4 m tall that closes the open end of a 0.6 m dungeon wall. Rough-cut grey limestone.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Half
models.description: Half-length dungeon wall 2 m long, 4 m tall and 0.6 m thick in rough-cut grey limestone with damp stains. Fills half a 4 m grid bay.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Kit
models.description: Modular dungeon walls on a 4 m grid, 4 m tall and 0.6 m thick, in rough-cut grey limestone. Straight, half, niche and 2 x 3 m arched opening walls plus quoined corners, shafted corners, a T junction and an end cap, with damp stains and moss low down.

models.name: Dungeon Wall with Niche
models.description: Dungeon wall 4 m long and 4 m tall with an arched niche set into its face, in rough-cut grey limestone with damp stains and moss. Snaps to the 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Shackles
models.description: A pair of iron wall shackles hanging on chains from rings set in the wall, about 0.8 m wide and 0.9 m tall. Black, rust-streaked iron.

models.name: Dungeon Wall Straight
models.description: Straight dungeon wall 4 m long, 4 m tall and 0.6 m thick in rough-cut grey limestone, with damp stains and moss low down. Snaps to the dungeon 4 m grid.

models.name: Dungeon Wall T-Junction
models.description: Junction piece 4 m tall where three dungeon walls meet in a T, with engaged stone shafts in both angles. Rough-cut grey limestone.

models.name: Dutch Hoe
models.description: A Dutch push hoe about 1.5 m long, lying flat. Ash handle and a flat steel blade worn bright at the edge and rusty behind it.

models.name: Earth-Filled Barrier Block
models.description: Earth-filled defensive barrier block about 1 m square and 1.5 m tall: a welded wire mesh box with a bulging fabric liner and a rounded fill of earth on top.

models.name: Electric Grand Tourer
models.description: Original long-hood electric grand tourer coupe, 4.68 m long. A short Kamm tail with a full-width light band and a diffuser, slim projector headlamps and a simple cabin. The active rear wing is modelled deployed and stows 0.105 m down.

models.name: Electric Guitar and Amp
models.description: Solid-body electric guitar on a folding stand beside a 62 cm tube combo amp, joined by a coiled cable. The double-cutaway guitar has a sunburst finish, a maple neck and two humbuckers; the amp has black tolex, woven grille cloth and a chrome control panel with a red pilot light.

models.name: Electric Kick Scooter
models.description: Folding electric kick scooter, 1.1 m long and 1.15 m tall. Graphite deck with ribbed grip and amber side lights, a front hub motor, rear disc brake, a display between the grips, orange fold lever and hook, and a side stand.

models.name: Elephant Ear Plant
models.description: An elephant ear plant about 1.6 m tall for jungle floors and riverbanks. Huge arrow-shaped leaves with pale veins hang tip down from tall upright stalks.

models.name: Elevated Expressway 30-Degree Curve
models.description: A curved span of urban elevated expressway turning 30 degrees, about 64 m long. Painted steel girders on single concrete T piers, four lanes on an 18 m deck 10 m above the ground.

models.name: Elevated Expressway Kit
models.description: Urban elevated expressway kit, four lanes on an 18 m deck 10 m above the ground. A 30 m straight, a 30 degree curve, a 150 m single-lane ramp down to the ground and a straight with tall clear sound barriers and lamp posts, on painted steel girders and single concrete T piers.

models.name: Elevated Expressway Ramp
models.description: A 150 m single-lane ramp that runs from the expressway deck 10 m up down to the ground, about 8.5 m wide, on concrete piers. Fits beside the straight and curved spans.

models.name: Elevated Expressway with Sound Barriers
models.description: A straight 30 m span of four-lane elevated expressway with tall clear sound barriers and lamp posts along both edges; the lamps glow at night. On steel girders and concrete T piers, 10 m up.

models.name: Elevated Expressway Straight
models.description: A straight 30 m span of urban elevated expressway. Painted steel girders on single concrete T piers, four lanes on an 18 m deck 10 m above the ground. Joins the other expressway pieces end to end.

models.name: Elevated Railway End Ramp
models.description: Walled embankment 60 m long that brings two tracks down from the viaduct to the ground, with an abutment face, pilasters every 10 m and catenary portals. Weathered concrete.

models.name: Elevated Railway Kit
models.description: A concrete elevated railway viaduct kit on a 20 m module carrying two tracks 6.6 m up: a plain span, a span with shops under its arches and a 60 m ramp down to the ground. Weathered concrete, catenary portals and wires, roll shutters and lit blank signs. Spans chain end to end.

models.name: Elevated Railway Span
models.description: Concrete rigid-frame railway viaduct span 20 m long carrying two tracks 6.6 m up, with flat arches, parapets and a catenary portal with wires. Weathered concrete; spans chain end to end.

models.name: Elevated Railway Span with Shops
models.description: Viaduct span 20 m long carrying two tracks, with small shops built into its arches: roll shutters, glass fronts, lit blank sign bands, awnings and lanterns. Chains with the plain spans and glows at night.

models.name: Tower of Empty Drink Crates
models.description: Four empty plastic lattice drink crates in yellow, green, red and blue, stacked about 1.2 m tall. Scuffed and dirty from use.

models.name: Empty Mall Bench
models.description: A 1.8 m mall bench with timber slats on dark grey cast frames, with a backrest and arms.

models.name: Empty Mall Ceiling
models.description: A 6 m square cell of white plasterboard mall ceiling with four glowing round downlights. It hangs 4.5 m above its origin, so it takes the same position as the floor cell below it.

models.name: Empty Mall Escalator
models.description: A stopped mall escalator 1.6 m wide and 11.5 m long that rises 5 m. Ribbed steps, glass balustrades with black handrails, and a rope barrier across the bottom: it is out of use.

models.name: Empty Mall Floor
models.description: A 6 m square cell of polished concourse floor for an empty shopping mall. Large terrazzo-like tiles worn dull along the walking lines, with a dark border band on two edges so laid cells show a border line every 6 m.

models.name: Empty Mall Planter
models.description: A 2.4 m square tiled mall planter with a dusty fake palm about 2.5 m tall. Stone capping, dark soil and low shrubs browning at the tips.

models.name: Empty Mall Shop Front
models.description: A 6 m wide shuttered mall shop front, 4.7 m tall, with a blank sign box over a galvanised roller shutter. The shutter stands a little open on a dark, empty shop 2 m deep.

models.name: Empty Mall Skylight Ceiling
models.description: A 6 m square mall ceiling cell with a glazed pyramid skylight over a 3.6 m light well. Aluminium glazing bars, a white well lining and four downlights at the corners; it hangs 4.5 m above its origin.

models.name: Empty Mall Wall
models.description: A 6 m wide, 4.7 m tall mall wall clad in pale stone panels with a dark stone skirting. Its top hides above the 4.5 m ceiling, and the back is plain dark grey.

models.name: Empty Statue Plinth
models.description: A moulded marble statue plinth 1.2 m tall on a 0.95 m square footing, empty with lead dowel sockets on top. The stone is weathered, chipped and streaked.

models.name: Enamel Tin Cup
models.description: An enamel camp mug about 7 cm tall with a rolled rim and a riveted strap handle, chipped to bare dark steel in places.

models.name: Energy Cell
models.description: Sci-fi power cell, 25 cm tall: a glowing cyan core in a glass sleeve, held between two machined end caps by a four-bar cage and a centre clamp ring. Dark anodised metal worn bright on the chamfers, hazard stripe bands, a contact post and cable ports.

models.name: Engine Hoist and Stand
models.description: Folding engine crane, 1.8 m tall, holding a generic inline four-cylinder engine on a rotating engine stand. Safety orange steel with a hand-pumped ram, chain and load leveller, and a grimy cast iron block with a black ribbed cam cover and a rusty exhaust manifold.

models.name: Granite Erratic Boulder
models.description: Angular glacial erratic of grey granite, about 2.5 m long and 1.3 m high, with sharp fracture faces, spalled corners and open joint cracks, lichen and moss on its top. Origin at ground level; about 0.25 m sits below the ground line.

models.name: Escalator Pair
models.description: A pair of 1 m step escalators side by side, rising one 5 m level at 30 degrees, about 3.5 m wide and 15 m long. Clear glass balustrades with black handrails, brushed stainless decking and cladding, cleated steps with yellow edges and green comb lights. It rises toward the back.

models.name: Espresso Cup
models.description: A small white porcelain espresso cup, 6 cm tall, holding a shot of espresso with tiger striped crema.

models.name: Espresso Machine
models.description: Two group commercial espresso machine, 75 cm wide and 53 cm tall, for cafe counters. Brushed steel body with chrome group heads, walnut handled portafilters, steam wands, two pressure gauges and a railed cup warmer on top.

models.name: Espresso Tamper
models.description: A barista tamper with a 58 mm flat steel base and a turned walnut handle, 11 cm tall.

models.name: Family Estate Car
models.description: Generic family estate car, 4.70 m long and 1.85 m wide, in grey-blue metallic paint. A boxy body with a long flat roof, roof rails, a near-vertical tailgate, an upright glasshouse and 17 inch wheels. The wheels turn.

models.name: European Beech
models.description: Mature forest beech, about 25 m tall, with a tall straight trunk of smooth silver-grey bark, root buttresses sinking into the ground and a dense, layered crown of flat leaf sprays.

models.name: Tracked Excavator
models.description: Generic 20 tonne tracked excavator, about 9.5 m long with the arm out and 3 m tall to the cab roof. Amber yellow upper body on a dark crawler undercarriage, glazed cab with a full interior, toothed digging bucket and the dust and scuffs of daily site work.

models.name: Exercise Mat and Medicine Ball
models.description: A 1.8 m foam exercise mat rolled out flat, a second mat rolled up beside it and a 30 cm rubber medicine ball. Slate and teal mats with a fine embossed grip and pressed patches where hands and feet go; the ball is pebbled black rubber with moulded seams.

models.name: Explosive Barrel
models.description: Explosive 200 litre steel drum in sun-faded satin red, 0.58 m across and 0.88 m tall, with a yellow and black hazard band and a flame-in-a-diamond warning sign. Battered and dented, with dust in the hoops and rust at the rims and in deep scratches.

models.name: Extension Ladder
models.description: A two section aluminium extension ladder about 3.6 m long, lying flat on the ground. Rung locks, guide brackets and swivel feet, with scuffs and paint splatter.

models.name: F-Clamp
models.description: A 30 cm steel F clamp lying on its side, opened wide. Yellow painted jaws, a rusty bar and a wooden screw handle.

models.name: Office Facade Module
models.description: Modular office curtain wall, 12 m wide and 16 m tall (four storeys), 0.4 m deep. Dark steel fins and mullions frame glossy dark glass and spandrel bands, with a few warmly lit offices. Modules stack side by side and on top of each other on a 12 m by 4 m grid.

models.name: Stone Facade Module
models.description: Modular limestone facade, 12 m wide and 16 m tall (four storeys), 0.4 m deep. Punched sash windows sit in deep reveals between sill courses under a stepped cornice, with soot streaks, a few lit rooms and a black zig-zag fire escape on one bay. Modules stack on a 12 m by 4 m grid.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Factory Hall
models.description: Steel frame production hall, 24 x 40 m and 11 m to the eaves, open at one end, with a travelling double girder bridge crane. Grey cladding, rooflight strips, high bay lamps and a grey epoxy floor with green walkways and yellow and white markings, worn by daily use.

models.name: Fallen Doric Column
models.description: A Doric marble column fallen in a line of four fluted drums, about 7 m long, with its capital tumbled at the end. Chips and dry grass lie along the fall.

models.name: Fallen Spruce Log
models.description: Fallen spruce trunk, about 6 m long and 0.4 m thick, lying on the forest floor. One end sawn with growth rings, the other snapped into splinters. Bark partly peeled to grey weathered wood with beetle galleries, dead branch stubs and moss.

models.name: Fallen Marble Head
models.description: A weathered marble head about 0.4 m long lying on its side, broken at the neck with a chipped nose and a split crown.

models.name: Family Minivan
models.description: Seven seat family minivan, 5.1 m long and 1.99 m wide, in pale silver with a clear coat. Sliding rear doors on visible rails, roof rails, layered lamps, a tailgate spoiler and 17 inch alloys. Fabric seats in three rows. Wheels, steering wheel, doors, sliding doors, tailgate and bonnet move.

models.name: Family Sedan
models.description: Generic mid-size four-door family sedan, 4.85 m long and 1.84 m wide, in dark blue-grey metallic paint. A smooth modern body with a sloping roofline, slim lights, 18 inch alloy wheels and a full cabin seen through tinted glass. The doors, bonnet and boot open.

models.name: Fan Snow Gun
models.description: Orange fan snow gun on a towed two wheel carriage, about 2.4 m tall with its barrel tilted up. A ring of spray nozzles circles the fan, with a control box, beacon and hoses below. The barrel tilts on its yoke.

models.name: Farm Tractor
models.description: Generic mid-size farm tractor, 4.3 m long and 3.0 m tall to the exhaust, with a glazed cab. Plain green bodywork on a grey cast chassis, big lugged rear tyres and small front ones, front weights and a three-point hitch, lightly dusty from field work.

models.name: Ferris Wheel
models.description: Steel ferris wheel about 40 m tall with 24 open gondolas in red, blue and yellow. White trussed rims lined with bulbs, lattice towers, a plank boarding platform and a ticket booth. Each gondola hangs from its own pivot: counter-rotate it to keep it level as the wheel turns.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Ferro Rod Fire Steel
models.description: A ferro rod fire starter about 13 cm long, with an orange plastic handle, a dark rod and a steel striker on a cord. Scraping it throws sparks to light a campfire.

models.name: Fieldstone House Plinth 2 m
models.description: Grey fieldstone plinth strip 2 m long and about 0.6 m tall that the red wooden house walls stand on. Runs along the 2 m grid under 0.2 m walls.

models.name: Fieldstone House Plinth Corner
models.description: Grey fieldstone corner block about 0.6 m tall that closes the plinth at an outer corner of the red wooden house.

models.name: Fire Engine
models.description: Generic three-axle fire engine with a turntable ladder, about 10.5 m long, 2.5 m wide and 3.6 m tall. Red crew cab and locker body with aluminium roller shutters, a four-section ladder stowed over the cab, hose reels at the rear and blue warning lights, with light road grime.

models.name: Fire Extinguisher
models.description: Red 6 kg dry powder fire extinguisher, 55 cm tall. A scuffed enamelled steel cylinder with a printed instruction label, a brass valve with a pressure gauge, a steel carry handle and squeeze lever, a safety pin with a pull ring, and a rubber hose clipped to the side.

models.name: Fire Hydrant
models.description: Red cast-iron pillar fire hydrant, 0.82 m tall, on a bolted ground flange. Two side outlets with caps on short chains and a larger front outlet, under a domed bonnet with an operating nut. Paint chipped at the bonnet and caps, rust at the foot.

models.name: Fire Station
models.description: Brick fire station, 28 x 20 m, with a 16 m hose drying tower and three tall bay doors sized for a full size fire engine. Red sectional doors between stone piers under a gabled hall, a two storey crew quarters wing with lit windows, and a concrete apron with yellow keep clear hatching.

models.name: Firewood Stack
models.description: Stack of split birch and spruce firewood, 2.3 m wide and 1.4 m high, under a slanted board roof. 40 cm pieces packed between round end posts, their sawn ends showing growth rings, checks and white birch or scaly spruce bark. Grey weathered roof boards.

models.name: First Aid Kit
models.description: Hard-shell first aid case, 30 x 20 x 10 cm, in green moulded plastic with a white cross, clip latches and a fold-down carry handle. Scuffed and grimy from use; the lid opens on its rear hinge to a white tray with bandage rolls, dressing packets and scissors.

models.name: Fishing Landing Net
models.description: A landing net lying flat, about 1 m long, with a round aluminium hoop, a mesh bag and a straight handle with a rubber grip.

models.name: Fishing Trawler
models.description: Steel stern trawler 28 m long and 8.4 m wide, with the wheelhouse forward on a shelter deck. Dark green hull over red antifouling, an orange stern gantry with trawl doors, a net drum, folding outrigger booms and a rust streaked, hard worked deck. Floats with the waterline at the origin.

models.name: Fishmonger's Table
models.description: A plank table 1.9 m long laid with rows of fresh fish and a cleaver, the fishmonger's stall on market day.

models.name: Flanged Mace
models.description: A 60 cm iron flanged mace with seven pointed forged flanges on a riveted socket. The haft has turned rings, a leather wrapped grip and a ball butt with a leather wrist loop; hammer marks and dark forge scale cover the iron.

models.name: Flat-Bottomed Boat
models.description: Small weathered wooden flat-bottomed boat, about 3.5 m long, of the kind used on swamps and shallow rivers. Plank sides, a bench seat and worn paint.

models.name: Flat Quartzite River Pebble
models.description: Flat, pale quartzite river pebble about 30 cm long and 9 cm thick with a thin white quartz vein. Smooth and dry, a good skimming shape.

models.name: Flat Screwdriver
models.description: A 25 cm flat blade screwdriver with a fluted red handle and black rubber grip inserts, lying flat. The chrome shaft is a little rusty near the tip.

models.name: Flatbed Rail Wagon
models.description: A 12 m four-axle flat rail wagon in faded, rusty oxide red with a weathered timber deck, buffers and screw couplings, riding on two swivelling freight bogies. Standard gauge; its wheels stand at rail level, so set it on top of the rails.

models.name: Flatweave Kilim Rug
models.description: A 1.4 x 2.0 m flatweave kilim with bold stepped diamonds and banded borders in terracotta, ochre and indigo. Tight weft weave with small slits along the colour steps, tasselled ends and a few soft ripples.

models.name: Circuit Floodlight Mast
models.description: Circuit floodlight mast, 25 m of tapered galvanized steel on a concrete plinth. Twelve LED floods in three rows sit on a head frame and aim down at the track in front, with a maintenance platform and a caged ladder behind them. The floods are built lit and switch as one group.

models.name: Floor and Ceiling Kit
models.description: Floor and ceiling tiles for interiors, 2 x 2 m on 0.2 m slabs. Oiled oak floorboards, large grey porcelain tiles, wool loop carpet, warm white plaster ceilings, one with a round flush light that can glow, and an oak floor with a 1 x 2 m stair opening. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Floor Drop Safe
models.description: A squat charcoal drop safe, 0.64 m wide and 0.62 m tall, bolted to the floor. A deposit hopper drawer above a door with a keypad and an L handle; the door opens on a hinge.

models.name: Floor Lamp
models.description: Arc floor lamp, 1.6 m tall with a reach of about 1 m. A round white marble base, a brushed steel pole that arcs over and a 40 cm linen drum shade. The bulb glows and can be switched off by changing its material.

models.name: Fluted Doric Column Drum
models.description: A single fluted marble column drum, about 1 m tall and 0.95 m across, as a loose block. Its arrises are chipped and its faces weathered, with dry grass at its foot.

models.name: Fly Agaric Mushrooms
models.description: Cluster of three fly agaric mushrooms up to 18 cm tall: a young button, an open cap and an old flat cap, red with white warts. Origin on the ground at the centre of the cluster.

models.name: Foam Block Barrier
models.description: Race circuit foam barrier, a 4.0 m section of four blocks, 1.2 m tall and 1.0 m deep. Rounded modules in alternating blue and white fabric covers, linked by dark flaps and black ratchet straps, with lifting loops on top. No text. Sections tile every 4 m.

models.name: Foam Box of Herbs
models.description: A white foam fish box reused as a planter, full of leafy greens and herbs, about 0.6 m long and 0.4 m tall. The box is grubby and chipped, a typical city alley vegetable patch.

models.name: Foam Box of Spring Onions
models.description: A white foam fish box reused as a planter, full of tall spring onions, about 0.7 m long and 0.6 m tall. The box is grubby and chipped, a typical city alley vegetable patch.

models.name: Folded Towel Stack
models.description: A neat stack of folded terry towels in light grey and teal, about 34 x 25 cm and 14 cm tall. Soft, slightly rumpled fabric, for a shelf or bathroom stool.

models.name: Folded Wool Throw
models.description: A checked wool throw folded into a soft stack about 62 by 42 cm and 6 cm high. Oatmeal brushed wool with a rust and charcoal windowpane check, its layers a little out of line.

models.name: Folding Guitar Stand
models.description: Folding guitar stand about 0.8 m tall, a black steel A-frame with padded cradle arms and a neck yoke on top.

models.name: Folding Pruning Saw
models.description: A folding pruning saw lying open, about 45 cm long, with a curved toothed steel blade. The orange handle has a black rubber grip, and the teeth rake back for cutting on the pull.

models.name: Folding Steel Bollard
models.description: A removable steel post about 1 m tall on a hinged base plate, so it can be folded flat to let vehicles through. Painted steel with wear.

models.name: Food Stall Cart
models.description: Wheeled street food stall, 2.3 m long, with a red cloth canopy, a charcoal grill counter and a wooden customer counter with four stools. A big paper lantern hangs at the corner and a plain indigo cloth banner runs along the front; lantern, bulb and embers glow at night.

models.name: Food Stall Stool
models.description: Round vinyl-topped stool about 0.5 m tall on chrome legs, for sitting at a street food counter.

models.name: Football
models.description: Size 5 football (soccer ball), 22 cm across, in the classic 32-panel pattern of white hexagons and black pentagons. Stitched polyurethane panels, slightly domed, with sunk seams, light scuffs and grass marks. Origin on the ground under the ball; the centre of the ball is 0.11 m above it.

models.name: Football Goal
models.description: Full-size football goal, 7.32 x 2.44 m inside and 2 m deep, with a sagging white net. White 12 cm round posts and crossbar, a ground frame and bent back supports, and a knotted mesh net pegged into the grass.

models.name: Football Pitch
models.description: Full-size football pitch, 105 x 68 m, with 3 m of run-off. Mown grass stripes with all the standard 12 cm white markings to the laws of the game. Goals and corner flags are separate models.

models.name: Forestry Forwarder
models.description: Generic articulated eight-wheel forest forwarder, about 10 m long, for hauling cut logs out of the woods. Yellow bodywork caked in mud low down, steel tracks over the bogie wheels, a glazed cab up front and a loader crane folded over the empty bunk.

models.name: Forged Iron Dungeon Key
models.description: A 14 cm forged iron key with a quatrefoil bow and a warded bit, dark and worn. A classic pickup for dungeon doors and gates.

models.name: Forklift
models.description: Counterbalance forklift for 2.5 t loads, about 3.7 m long with the forks, 1.2 m wide and 2.2 m tall. Yellow body with a dark counterweight, overhead guard, two stage mast and a gas bottle on the back, worn from daily warehouse work. Forks fit a standard pallet.

models.name: Open-Wheel Formula Car
models.description: Modern open-wheel single-seater race car, 5.5 m long, 2.0 m wide and 0.95 m tall. A generic design in a deep blue, white and light blue livery, with multi-element wings, sidepods, a halo, a seated driver and 18 inch slicks. Wheels, steering wheel and the rear wing flap move.

models.name: Four-Lane City Road Section
models.description: Flat 16 x 12 m section of four-lane city road with a centre line, dashed lane lines, edge lines and concrete gutters with iron grates. Worn asphalt. Tiles end to end and joins the scramble crossing arms.

models.name: Four-Lane Road With Refuge Island
models.description: Four-lane city road section about 16 m wide and 19 m long with a raised kerbed refuge island down the middle and lit keep-left bollards. Worn asphalt and granite kerbs. Tiles with the plain road on the 6 m module.

models.name: Four-Seat Restaurant Table
models.description: A four seat restaurant table, 120 by 75 cm and 76 cm tall. A honey oak print laminate top with a black edge, worn pale along the edges, stands on a black cast iron X base.

models.name: Framed Abstract Print
models.description: A large framed abstract print about 68 by 88 cm: overlapping circles over soft hills in terracotta, ochre, navy and sage. Thin black frame, a wide white mat with a bevelled window, and glass.

models.name: Framed Arches Print
models.description: A small framed print of stacked rainbow arches and a sun in warm pastels, about 42 by 52 cm. Light oak frame with a white mat and glass.

models.name: Framed Botanical Print
models.description: A vintage style botanical print of a nodding bellflower with its roots, in sepia ink and watercolour on cream paper, 40 by 50 cm. A bevel cut mat and glass sit in a thin brass frame.

models.name: Framed Mountain Photo
models.description: A framed photograph of an invented alpine lake at dusk, about 43 by 29 cm: hazy ridges, dark pines and their reflection in still water. Slim walnut frame with no mat, behind glass.

models.name: Framed Seascape Photo
models.description: A small framed photograph of an invented grey sea under a big sky, with a low headland and surf on a pale beach, about 24 by 30 cm. Slim black frame with a white mat and glass.

models.name: Covered Freight Wagon
models.description: A 16.5 m covered freight wagon with sliding side doors in weathered oxide red, coupled to a 12.7 m grey tank wagon with a dome, walkway and ladders. Both ride on freight bogies and show rust, grime and brake dust. Standard gauge; the wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Frontier Boardwalk Section
models.description: Raised timber boardwalk 4 m long and about 2.7 m deep with weathered planks. Sections tile end to end along a frontier street.

models.name: Frontier Hitching Rail
models.description: Weathered timber hitching rail about 2.8 m long and 1.1 m tall for tying up horses outside a saloon or store.

models.name: Frontier Notice Board
models.description: Weathered timber notice board about 1.9 m wide and 2.4 m tall, pinned with blank papers. Stands on a frontier town street.

models.name: Frontier Saloon
models.description: Two-storey false-front frontier saloon, 10 x 16 m with its covered boardwalk. Sun-faded ochre clapboard, oxblood trim, a railed balcony, tall sash windows, swinging half doors and a tin roof. Inside are a bar with a mirrored back bar, round tables and chairs and a stair to the upper floor.

models.name: Stone Well with Windlass
models.description: Stone well about 2.5 m across and 2.5 m tall with a timber frame and a windlass that turns. For a frontier town square or a farmyard.

models.name: Frontier Street Set
models.description: Set of frontier town street pieces: a hitching rail, a plank water trough, a 4 m boardwalk section, a 9 m windpump, a notice board with blank papers, a stone well with a windlass and a spare cart wheel. Weathered timber, galvanized iron and stone. The boardwalk tiles end to end along its length.

models.name: Spare Wagon Wheel
models.description: Spare wooden wagon wheel about 1.2 m across with an iron tyre, set up on its own. Weathered timber for a frontier street or wheelwright yard.

models.name: Frontier Plank Water Trough
models.description: Plank water trough about 2 m long and 0.7 m tall in weathered timber. Stands by a hitching rail on a frontier street.

models.name: Frontier Windpump
models.description: Windpump about 9.3 m tall with a galvanized iron rotor and tail vane on a tall tower. The head turns into the wind and the rotor spins.

models.name: Fuel Station Canopy
models.description: Unbranded fuel station canopy, 16 x 10 m and 5.85 m tall, over two pump islands. A flat white canopy with a grey fascia and lit soffit, four generic dispensers with blank screens and hanging hoses, yellow crash bars and a blank sign pylon with no digits or logos.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Aircraft Fuel Truck
models.description: Generic three-axle aircraft refuelling truck, about 9 m long, 2.6 m wide and 3.7 m tall with the platform down. A white elliptical tank on a grey chassis with piping, a rear equipment bay with a hose reel and a lift platform for over-wing fuelling, lightly weathered from apron use.

models.name: Fume Hood
models.description: Laboratory fume cupboard, 1.5 m wide and 2.9 m to the top of its duct, with a sliding glass sash over a black epoxy work surface. White steel body with a slotted rear baffle, gas cocks, an airflow panel and a ventilated base cabinet.

models.name: Sailing Galleon
models.description: Three-masted galleon about 44 m long with a tall carved stern castle, a forecastle and a beakhead. Dark oiled planking with red and ochre bands, two tiers of guns, weathered square sails and full rigging. Sails come set and furled: hide the set you do not need.

models.name: Gallery Bench
models.description: A gallery bench 1.6 m long with a dark leather cushion on a black board and a brushed steel frame. The seat sits at 48 cm, and a rolled welt runs around the cushion top.

models.name: Gallery Corner Pier
models.description: A square white plaster pier 0.3 m wide and 4 m tall that joins gallery walls at corners and along runs. A dark shadow gap rings its base.

models.name: Gallery Doorway Wall
models.description: A white plaster gallery partition 3.7 m long and 4 m tall with a wide 2 by 3 m opening. Plain plaster jambs, a shadow gap at the floor and an aluminium picture rail on each side of the opening.

models.name: Gallery Oak Floor Tile
models.description: A 4 by 4 m floor tile of wide pale oak planks in a matte lacquer, 8 cm thick. The planks run across the tile with random butt joints and tile seamlessly in both directions.

models.name: Gallery Skylight Ceiling
models.description: A 4 by 4 m gallery ceiling module with a frosted 2.4 m laylight in a deep plaster well. Two black tracks carry three spotlights each, aimed at the walls.

models.name: Gallery Wall
models.description: A white plaster gallery partition 3.7 m long, 0.2 m thick and 4 m tall. Both faces have a dark shadow gap at the floor and a slim aluminium picture rail near the top.

models.name: Galvanized Bucket with Trout
models.description: A galvanized steel bucket about 30 cm tall, filled with water, with a caught rainbow trout inside, its tail over the rim. The wire bail with a wooden grip has dropped to one side.

models.name: Home Game Console
models.description: A low home game console, 28 by 24 cm and 7 cm tall. A frost white shell wraps a dark core, with a glossy black front, a light strip, side vent slots and ports at the back.

models.name: Wireless Game Controller
models.description: A white wireless game controller, about 16 cm wide, resting on its grips. Sculpted grips carry two thumbsticks, a d-pad, four face buttons, bumpers and triggers.

models.name: Gaming Mouse and Pad
models.description: A black right-handed gaming mouse, 12.6 cm long, on a 45 x 40 cm cloth desk pad. Split primary buttons, a ribbed scroll wheel, two thumb buttons, a rubber grip band and a thin cyan light strip; the braided cable runs off the stitched edge of the pad.

models.name: Wooden Garage
models.description: Single wooden garage, 3.6 x 6 m, with a wide up-and-over door. Red ochre board-and-batten cladding, a black standing-seam gable roof, white trims, six-pane side windows and a concrete footing and apron. The door opens onto a dark interior.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Garbage Truck
models.description: Generic three-axle rear-loader garbage truck, about 9.8 m long, 2.5 m wide and 3.6 m tall. Municipal orange cab and rounded compaction body with a tipping tailgate, a packer blade in the hopper, bin lifts, riding steps and amber beacons, grimy from daily rounds.

models.name: Garden Spade
models.description: A garden spade about 1.4 m long lying flat, with an ash handle and a D grip. The steel blade is chipped, rusty and caked with soil at the tip.

models.name: Gas Storage Tanks
models.description: Pair of 16 m spherical pressure tanks on steel legs, in white paint with welded plate seams and light weathering. Each has a stair winding up to a railed top platform with relief valves, a bridge joins the tops, and valved pipework runs between them on a concrete pad.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Castle Gatehouse
models.description: Twin-tower stone castle gatehouse about 18 m tall and 21 m wide, with a vaulted gate passage. A timber portcullis, a chained drawbridge and a machicolation guard the arch, and a winch room over the passage holds the windlasses. Set it over a ditch or moat so the bridge spans it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Cut Gemstones
models.description: Five cut gemstones, 2 to 4 cm across: an oval ruby, a step-cut emerald, a cushion sapphire, a pear amethyst and a round brilliant diamond. Real flat facets and clear refractive materials whose colour deepens through the thicker parts of each stone.

models.name: General Store
models.description: One-and-a-half-storey false-front general store, 8 x 12 m with its porch. Faded teal clapboard and cream trim, two big display windows, a glazed door and a shed-roofed porch over the boardwalk with crates and barrels. Inside are a long counter and wall shelves stocked with tins, boxes and jars.

models.name: Geometric Abstract Painting
models.description: An invented geometric abstract painting, 97 cm square, in a silver leaf frame. A yellow circle, a blue half disc, a red triangle and black lines sit on white.

models.name: Giant Corner LED Screen
models.description: Curved LED screen 12 m long and 8 m tall that wraps around a building corner, with thin black bezels and steel brackets. The face has plain 0-1 UVs for your own video or images.

models.name: Giant Landscape LED Screen
models.description: Wall-mounted landscape LED screen 12 m wide and 8 m tall, with thin black bezels and steel brackets. Shows an abstract colour pattern; the face has plain 0-1 UVs for your own video or images.

models.name: Giant Portrait LED Screen
models.description: Wall-mounted portrait LED screen 6 m wide and 12 m tall, with thin black bezels and steel brackets. Shows an abstract colour pattern; the face has plain 0-1 UVs for your own video or images.

models.name: Giant Puffball
models.description: A giant puffball mushroom 30 cm across, a slightly flattened white ball with a suede like skin. Faint cracks craze the top and a little soil clings to its base.

models.name: Checked Gift Box
models.description: Wrapped Christmas present about 28 cm square in checked paper with creased ends and a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Dotted Gift Box
models.description: Flat wrapped Christmas present about 46 by 35 cm and 19 cm tall in dotted paper with creased ends and a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Small Kraft Paper Gift Box
models.description: Small wrapped present, a 20 cm cube in brown kraft paper with creased ends and a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Tall Kraft Paper Gift Box
models.description: Tall wrapped present about 20 cm square and 47 cm tall in brown kraft paper with creased ends and a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Plain Red Gift Box
models.description: Low wrapped Christmas present about 33 by 27 cm and 15 cm tall in plain red paper with a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Gift Box Set
models.description: Six wrapped Christmas presents in a loose group about 1.1 m across, from a 15 cm cube to a 40 cm tall box. Striped, dotted, checked, plain red and kraft paper with creased ends and satin ribbon bows. Each present can be moved on its own.

models.name: Striped Gift Box
models.description: Wrapped Christmas present about 33 cm square in striped paper with creased ends and a satin ribbon bow.

models.name: Gingerbread House
models.description: A gingerbread cottage about 25 cm tall on a wooden board dusted with icing sugar. Browned panels are glued with piped royal icing, the roof is deep in icing snow with drips and icicles, and gumdrops, peppermints and candy canes decorate it.

models.name: Ginkgo Tree
models.description: Street ginkgo tree in autumn, about 13 m tall, in a cast iron tree grate. A straight, furrowed grey trunk carries a tall, narrow crown of fan-shaped leaves turned bright butter yellow, with fallen leaves on the soil under the grate.

models.name: Glass Bus Shelter
models.description: Modern city bus shelter, 4 m wide, 1.5 m deep and 2.5 m high, with a cantilevered glass roof and an anthracite steel frame. Toughened glass walls with a frosted dot band, a wooden bench, a glowing blank light box, a route map frame, a timetable display and a litter bin, lightly weathered.

models.name: Glass Christmas Bauble
models.description: Mirrored glass Christmas bauble, 8 cm across, in deep red. Thin silvered glass under a glossy lacquer, with a crimped gold cap, a wire loop and a hook, and the faint hairline scratches of a well loved ornament.

models.name: Glass Door Fridge Row
models.description: A supermarket upright fridge row 3.75 m long and 2.1 m tall with five hinged glass doors. Stocked with unbranded bottled water, soft drinks, cans and juices on black shelves, with a white cabinet and LED bars that glow in the dark.

models.name: Glass Icicle Ornament
models.description: Clear glass icicle ornament, 12 cm long, twisted into five spiral flutes that taper to a fine frosted tip. It hangs from a small silver cap with a wire loop and a hook.

models.name: Glass Retort on Stand
models.description: A glass retort holding a glowing green liquid on an iron ring stand, its long neck reaching out to the side.

models.name: Glass Table Display Case
models.description: A museum table case, 1.6 by 0.8 m and 1.2 m tall: a glass hood with brass edges over a dark felt bed, on a dark oak stand with slim legs. The case is empty.

models.name: Glass Tower Crown
models.description: Roof crown for a 24 x 24 m glass and steel office tower, about 21 m tall with rooftop plant behind a glazed parapet and a tall mast. Caps the top storey.

models.name: Glass Tower Lobby Floor
models.description: Glazed 7.2 m tall ground floor for a 24 x 24 m glass and steel office tower, with a revolving door that turns and an entrance canopy. Office floors stack on top.

models.name: Glass Tower Office Floor
models.description: One 3.6 m storey of a glass and steel office tower, 24 x 24 m with a curtain wall of glazing and steel mullions. Stacks on the lobby or on itself to any height.

models.name: Glass Tower Plant Floor
models.description: Louvred 4.8 m plant floor for a 24 x 24 m glass and steel office tower, breaking up the curtain wall with a band of steel louvres. Stacks between office floors.

models.name: Glass Tower Terrace Floor
models.description: A 3.6 m office tower storey on the 24 x 24 m footprint with its glass line set back behind an open terrace. Stacks in the tower to step the facade.

models.name: Glazed Donut
models.description: A glazed ring donut, 9 cm across and 3 cm tall. A thin, glossy sugar glaze covers the golden fried dough, with the pale fried band round its middle.

models.name: Glitter Christmas Bauble
models.description: Matt midnight blue Christmas bauble, 8 cm across, with a band of fine gold glitter around its middle. Gold snowflakes are painted above and below the band, under a crimped gold cap with a wire loop and a hook.

models.name: Glowing Rune Stone
models.description: A grey hand-sized rune stone 14 cm tall with one carved sign that glows blue.

models.name: Goalie Leg Pads
models.description: A pair of white ice hockey goalie leg pads lying face up, each 85 cm tall and 28 cm wide. Stitched vertical channels, an outer edge roll, navy knee blocks on the inner edges and a thigh rise with a navy and red band.

models.name: Pallet of Gold Bars
models.description: A 0.8 m pine pallet stacked with five cross-laid layers of cast gold bars, about 0.32 m tall. Plain polished bars with no stamps or markings.

models.name: Gold Coin
models.description: Struck gold coin, 30 mm across, standing on its edge. A stylised sun on the face and a crown over laurel sprigs on the reverse, inside a raised rim with a reeded edge; polished bright gold on the high points and rim, toned darker in the recesses.

models.name: Gold Coin Pile
models.description: Heap of struck gold coins about 40 cm across, for treasure rooms and loot drops. Coins lie at every tilt over a low mound, a few stand on edge, three short stacks lean at its foot and strays are scattered round it; worn bright gold with dark grime between them.

models.name: Gold Cup Trophy
models.description: Gold cup trophy about 56 cm tall: a deep bowl with a rolled lip and handles on a knopped stem, standing on a black plinth. Plain, with no text.

models.name: Gold Funerary Mask
models.description: A hammered gold funerary mask on a black rod and block, 36 cm tall overall. The calm face has closed eyes, a long nose and thin lips, with grime in the hollows.

models.name: Golf 7-Iron
models.description: Golf 7-iron about 0.94 m long with a satin chrome cavity-back head on a chrome steel shaft and a black rubber grip. Lies flat on the ground.

models.name: Golf Stand Bag
models.description: Golf stand bag, 0.9 m long, leaning back on its two stand legs. Dark navy nylon with grey piping, a moulded black top cuff with club heads and a knitted driver cover showing, zipped front and side pockets, a padded double strap and a black base.

models.name: Golf Ball
models.description: Golf ball, 42.7 mm across, in glossy white. About 360 round dimples cover it in even spirals, broken by a thin smooth parting line around the middle, with faint grass and scuff marks.

models.name: Golf Ball Washer Post
models.description: Golf course ball washer on a dark green steel post about 1.25 m tall, with a plunger washer on top and a white terry towel hanging from a hook.

models.name: Golf Blade Putter
models.description: Black blade putter about 0.89 m long on a chrome steel shaft with a black rubber grip. Lies flat on the ground.

models.name: Golf Cart
models.description: Two-seat electric golf cart, 2.4 m long and 1.2 m wide, with a white moulded body. A canopy roof on black struts, a clear windshield, an ivory vinyl bench seat, a ribbed rubber floor and a bag rack with a strap at the back, on turf tyres and small silver wheels.

models.name: Golf Club Set
models.description: Three golf clubs lying side by side: a 1.15 m driver, a 0.94 m 7-iron and a 0.89 m putter. Chrome steel shafts and black rubber grips, a large driver head with a gloss black crown, a satin chrome cavity-back iron and a black blade putter.

models.name: Golf Driver
models.description: Golf driver about 1.15 m long with a large head and gloss black crown on a chrome steel shaft with a black rubber grip. Lies flat on the ground.

models.name: Golf Flagstick and Cup
models.description: Golf flagstick, 2.1 m tall, standing in a 108 mm hole cup. A white fibreglass stick with a plain yellow nylon flag lifted by a light breeze, set in a white plastic liner whose rim sits flush with the ground, so cut a matching hole in the green.

models.name: Gondola Cabin
models.description: Eight seat ski gondola cabin, 2.1 m long and 3.5 m tall to the grip. A rounded red shell with a band of tinted glass, a dark domed roof, two benches facing each other and ski racks on both ends.

models.name: Graduated Cylinder
models.description: A 100 ml glass graduated cylinder, 27 cm tall, on a blue hexagonal plastic foot. It is two thirds full of clear liquid, with white scale marks and a pouring spout at the rim.

models.name: Grain Silo Set
models.description: A pair of galvanized corrugated grain bins, 8 m across with cone roofs, on concrete pads. A bucket elevator in a lattice tower stands between them, with spouts to both roofs, a truck load-out spout, caged ladders, a top platform and a walkway to each roof peak.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Tipping Grain Trailer
models.description: Twin-axle tipping grain trailer, 8.4 m long and 2.9 m tall, with high pressed-steel sides. Blue-grey body on a black chassis, flotation tyres and a ring-eye drawbar at the height of the farm tractor's hitch, scuffed inside and dusty underneath.
