models.name: Grand Piano
models.description: Concert-style grand piano, 2.1 m long and 1.5 m wide, in gloss black lacquer with a padded bench. The lid is propped open on its stick to show the bronze iron frame and strings, and the fallboard is open over 88 keys.

models.name: Covered Grandstand
models.description: Twenty-metre section of a covered steel grandstand, 12 rows of blue seats rising to about 8 m. Concrete terraces on steel frames, a front walkway with a crowd railing, aisle stairs, a clad back wall and a sheet roof on cantilever beams. No people. Sections tile every 20 m.

models.name: Grandstand Crowd
models.description: Seated race crowd for ten metres of the covered grandstand, 21 seats across all 12 rows. Spectators in varied clothes and caps, a few standing, waving or holding up plain flags. Placed at the grandstand's own position it fills the middle of the stand.

models.name: Granite Boulder
models.description: Weathered roadside granite boulder, about 1.6 m across, with rounded joint faces, spalled corners and an open crack, lichen on its sides and moss on top. Origin at ground level; about 0.2 m sits below the ground line.

models.name: Granite Corestone
models.description: A rounded, egg-shaped granite boulder about 1 m tall, weathered smooth. Pinkish tan granite with dark patina and lichen, with a few tufts of dry grass at its foot.

models.name: Granite Kopje
models.description: A granite kopje about 11 m long and 5 m high: rounded, weathered boulders stacked on a low whaleback dome. Pinkish tan granite with dark patina, run-off streaks and orange and grey lichen, with clumps of dry grass at its foot.

models.name: Granite Mortar and Pestle
models.description: A granite mortar 16 cm across holding crushed green herbs, with its pestle resting in the bowl and leaning over the rim.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 1
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.8 m long and 0.3 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 2
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.65 m across and 0.25 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 3
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.8 m long and 0.3 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 4
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.9 m long and 0.3 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 5
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.6 m across and 0.25 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Pond Edge Stone 6
models.description: A low rounded granite boulder for edging a garden pond, about 0.55 m across and 0.2 m high. Grey weathered stone with soft worn edges and small flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite River Boulder
models.description: Smooth, water-worn river boulder about 1.2 m long and 0.6 m tall. Speckled grey granite, rounded by the current, dry all over.

models.name: Veined Granite River Stone
models.description: Small speckled granite river stone about 0.4 m across, crossed by a white quartz vein. The lower part is wet and darker below a soft water mark.

models.name: Granite Stepping Stone 1
models.description: A flat granite stepping stone for a garden path or pond crossing, about 0.55 m long and about 9 cm thick. Grey weathered stone with a worn, slightly domed top and a few flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Stepping Stone 2
models.description: A flat granite stepping stone for a garden path or pond crossing, about 0.5 m long and about 9 cm thick. Grey weathered stone with a worn, slightly domed top and a few flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Stepping Stone 3
models.description: A flat granite stepping stone for a garden path or pond crossing, about 0.5 m across and about 9 cm thick. Grey weathered stone with a worn, slightly domed top and a few flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Stepping Stone 4
models.description: A flat granite stepping stone for a garden path or pond crossing, about 0.5 m long and about 9 cm thick. Grey weathered stone with a worn, slightly domed top and a few flecks of moss.

models.name: Granite Stepping Stone 5
models.description: A flat granite stepping stone for a garden path or pond crossing, about 0.55 m long and about 9 cm thick. Grey weathered stone with a worn, slightly domed top and a few flecks of moss.

models.name: Wild Grass Clump
models.description: Tuft of mixed wild grasses, about 0.6 m tall: arching blades going from green to straw at the tips, with timothy, cock's-foot, meadow grass and Yorkshire fog seed heads.

models.name: Old Gravestone Set
models.description: Five weathered churchyard headstones, 0.2 to 1.2 m tall: round-top, pointed-top, cross, ledger and a leaning cracked slab. Granite and limestone with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front panels are blank and worn.

models.name: Grazed Grass Tussock
models.description: A short savanna grass tussock grazed down to about 25 cm, with blunt, bitten blade tips. Straw and grey blades, a few lying flat around the foot.

models.name: Great Hall Arched Doorway
models.description: A castle great hall wall, 4 m long and 6 m high, with a round-arched doorway 2.4 m wide and 3.6 m tall. The opening has a ring of voussoirs, dressed jambs and a deep stone soffit.

models.name: Great Hall Fireplace
models.description: A castle great hall wall with a big hooded stone fireplace, 4 m long and 6 m high. A chimney breast runs up to the wall head, and the sooty firebox holds iron andirons and half-burnt logs on a flagstone hearth.

models.name: Great Hall Flagstone Floor
models.description: A 4 by 4 m tile of worn limestone floor flags in random-width rows, for a castle great hall. It snaps to the same 4 m grid as the hall walls.

models.name: Great Hall Lancet Window Wall
models.description: A castle great hall wall, 4 m long and 6 m high, pierced by a tall pointed lancet window about 1.1 by 3 m. The window has a voussoir surround, deep stone reveals and leaded diamond panes on iron saddle bars.

models.name: Great Hall Oak Roof Bay
models.description: One 4 m bay of an open oak roof spanning 8 m, with an arch-braced collar truss on wall posts and stone corbels. Purlins, common rafters, wind braces and boarding sit under a split oak shingle covering, and bays chain end to end on 6 m walls.

models.name: Great Hall Round Pier
models.description: A round limestone pier for a castle great hall, 6 m tall, built of drums on a moulded base. It has a cushion capital and a square abacus 1.2 m across to carry beams or arches.

models.name: Great Hall Stone Wall
models.description: A plain castle great hall wall of dressed limestone ashlar, 4 m long, 6 m high and 0.6 m thick. A chamfered plinth and a string course run along the hall face, and the coursed ends interlock with the next piece on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Green Enamel Pendant Lamp
models.description: A green enamel dome pendant lamp with a glowing bulb, hanging 1 m on a cord from a brass ceiling canopy.

models.name: Green Plastic Watering Can
models.description: A green plastic watering can with a long spout, about 0.65 m long and 0.4 m tall. Sun-faded and scuffed from daily use outside a house.

models.name: Green Poison Potion
models.description: A squat onion-shaped bottle of glowing green poison, about 12 cm tall, under a black wax seal. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Grey Alder
models.description: Multi-stemmed grey alder, about 10 m tall: several smooth, pale grey stems from one base, an irregular, open crown of dull dark-green toothed leaves, small woody cones and catkins.

models.name: Greywacke River Pebble
models.description: Dark greywacke river pebble about 20 cm long, crossed by two white quartz veins. Its lower part is wet below a soft water mark.

models.name: Veined Greywacke River Stone
models.description: Rounded river stone about 0.8 m long in fine dark greywacke, crossed by a white quartz vein. Its lower half is wet and darker below a soft water mark.

models.name: Grocery Shelf Run
models.description: Double-sided supermarket gondola shelf, 2.5 m long, 1 m deep and 1.8 m tall, with an end cap, stocked with unbranded groceries. Light grey steel with perforated backs, blank price strips and scuffed kick plates; hide the stock node for an empty unit.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Guardrail End Terminal
models.description: Ramped end terminal for the W-beam guardrail, 3.8 m long. The rail bends down into the ground while flaring 0.3 m away from traffic, on one short sigma post. Place it at the start of a run, or mirrored on X at the far end.

models.name: Guardrail Section
models.description: Galvanized W-beam steel guardrail, one 4.0 m section on two sigma posts with spacers and bolted splice. Tiles end to end every 4.0 m along X; origin at ground level under the first post, traffic side faces +Z.

models.name: Half-Buried Granite Boulder
models.description: Low, flat granite boulder about 0.9 m across and 0.3 m high, half sunk into the forest floor, with moss on its broad weathered top and lichen on its flanks. Origin at ground level; about 0.25 m sits below the ground line.

models.name: Half-Buried Storage Jar
models.description: A large terracotta storage jar 1.3 m wide, sunk in the ground to its shoulders inside a collar of earth. Its rolled rim is notched where a piece broke away, and the jar is filled with earth.

models.name: Hand Saw
models.description: A 62 cm hand saw lying flat, with a closed wooden handle. The steel blade is scratched and spotted with rust along its teeth.

models.name: Handheld Game Console
models.description: A charcoal handheld game console, 25 cm wide, lying screen up. Thumbsticks, a d-pad and buttons flank a wide screen that is blank and ready for an image or video.

models.name: Handheld Torch
models.description: Handheld torch, about 55 cm long. A hewn wooden stick with an oil-soaked cloth head wound around its top and bound by two iron bands, charred black where it burns with embers glowing in the cracks.

models.name: Hanging Cable Loom
models.description: A loose tangle of cable loops hanging from a single wall hook. Adds untidy clutter to alleys, rooftops and back rooms.

models.name: Hanging Moss Drape
models.description: Hanging moss slung along a branch, about 1.2 m wide and 1.6 m deep: loops sag between holds and beards hang longest in the middle. Lay its top line along a bough; the origin is the middle of that line.

models.name: Long Hanging Moss
models.description: A long festoon of hanging moss about 3 m long, thick near its hold and trailing into loose wisps of different lengths. Fine, curly grey-green filaments; the origin is the hanging point.

models.name: Medium Hanging Moss
models.description: A festoon of hanging moss about 2 m long: several beards gathered at one hold, swelling a little and splitting into wispy tips. Fine, curly grey-green filaments; the origin is the hanging point.

models.name: Short Hanging Moss
models.description: A short festoon of hanging moss about 1 m long, gathered where it hangs and ending in loose wisps. Fine, curly grey-green filaments to hang from any branch; the origin is the hanging point.

models.name: Hanging Vine Curtain
models.description: A curtain of six leafy vine strands, 2.4 to 4 m long, falling from one point. Heart-shaped glossy leaves; hang it from a branch, ledge or ruined arch.

models.name: Harbour Container Crane
models.description: Ship-to-shore container gantry crane, about 51 m tall on rails 30 m apart, with a 50 m boom reaching out over the water. Pale blue-grey box girders, an A-frame with stays, a trolley with a glazed cab and a yellow spreader, weathered by sea air and daily port work.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Harbour Control Office
models.description: Three storey port operations building, 16 x 10 m and about 20 m tall to the radar, with a glazed control room on the roof. Pale grey steel cladding over a concrete ground floor with blue bands and ribbon windows, an external galvanised stair, roof plant and a lattice mast, weathered by salt air.

models.name: Hart's-Tongue Fern
models.description: Hart's-tongue fern about 0.3 m tall, a rosette of glossy, undivided, strap shaped fronds 0.3 to 0.5 m long with wavy edges. The undersides carry rows of rusty spore stripes, and a few fronds are browned or nibbled.

models.name: Five-Door Hatchback
models.description: Generic five-door hatchback, 4.10 m long and 1.80 m wide, in solid red paint. A compact body with a short hood, a raked tailgate with a roof spoiler and 16 inch wheels. Wheels and the left-hand-drive steering wheel turn.

models.name: Mining Haul Truck
models.description: Ultra class rigid mining haul truck, about 15.5 m long, 9 m wide and 7.5 m tall to the canopy. Faded yellow tipping body over a grey frame on six giant dusty tyres, with a diagonal stairway up to the deck, a glazed cab, radiator, lights and beacons.

models.name: Old Hay Barn
models.description: Large old Nordic timber barn, 18 x 10 m, on a high fieldstone base. Faded, chalky red board-and-batten cladding, worn white trims and a rusty tin roof that sags with age. An earth ramp leads up to wide double doors, one ajar onto a dark threshing floor.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Hazel Shrub
models.description: Multi-stemmed common hazel, about 4.5 m tall: straight grey-brown stems fanning out from one stool into an open crown of round, double-toothed, softly hairy leaves, with a few catkins and nuts.

models.name: Health Canister
models.description: Sci-fi health canister, 20 cm tall: a glass vial four fifths full of glowing green gel with a few bubbles, held between brushed steel end caps by three guard rails, with a ribbed rubber grip band round the middle and a valve nozzle on top.

models.name: Heather Clump
models.description: Flowering common heather (ling) clump about 40 cm tall: a woody, twisted base and dense dark green shoots topped with spikes of small purple flowers. Origin on the ground at the centre; carries _WIND data for vertex shader sway.

models.name: Heavy Bag Stand
models.description: A free standing heavy bag stand about 2.45 m tall with a black leather punching bag hanging from its arm on a chain. Black steel frame with weight plates on its feet; the bag swings.

models.name: Hedge Shears
models.description: A pair of hedge shears about 55 cm long lying flat, with long ash handles and rubber stops. The steel blades are scratched and spotted with rust.

models.name: Heliconia Clump
models.description: A clump of heliconia about 1.8 m tall. Long paddle leaves rise on upright shoots, with erect zigzag spikes of large red bracts tipped yellow.

models.name: High-Speed Train
models.description: A 39 m high-speed train set: a streamlined power car with a long sloping nose and a pantograph, coupled to one intermediate coach with a seated saloon. White with a red stripe and a dark window band. Standard gauge; its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Highway Double-Arm Street Light
models.description: Highway street light, 12 m tall, with two 2 m arms and flat LED luminaires whose lens grids glow. A galvanized octagonal column with a weld seam, access door and rust streaks stands on a bolted flange and concrete plinth, as on a dual carriageway central reserve.

models.name: Hiker
models.description: Woman on a day hike: two-tone outdoor jacket, walking trousers, leather hiking boots and a day pack. Rigged with a 56-bone humanoid skeleton and four looping animations (idle, walk, wave, look_around). Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z.

models.name: Hiking Backpack
models.description: A 60 litre top loading hiking pack about 0.85 m tall, standing on a rolled foam mat. Faded slate teal nylon over a charcoal base, a stuffed orange lid over the cinched grey collar, mesh pockets with a bottle, compression straps and a padded harness.

models.name: Hockey Puck
models.description: A black rubber ice hockey puck, 76 mm across and 25 mm thick, with a knurled edge and scuffed faces.

models.name: Hockey Skates
models.description: A pair of black ice hockey skates standing side by side, about 32 cm long. Each boot has white laces, a navy accent, a white blade holder and a steel runner.

models.name: Hologram Advert Pylon
models.description: A tall black pylon carrying a transparent hologram advert panel with an invented emblem and glyphs. Glows pink and cyan over plazas and pavements.

models.name: Hologram Arrow Projector
models.description: A low kerbside projector box throwing a tilted green arrow panel. Guides traffic and pedestrians toward entrances and lanes.

models.name: Hologram Blade Sign
models.description: A tall wall mounted sign whose glowing cyan glyph panel juts out between two projector arms. Made for shopfronts and narrow alleys in a near future city.

models.name: Hologram Glyph Cube
models.description: A violet cube of glowing glyph panels floating over a square pedestal, framed by a thin emitter ring above. A striking plaza or lobby centrepiece.

models.name: Hologram Pointer Post
models.description: A tall post with three glowing hologram pointers in cyan, amber and magenta aimed different ways. A wayfinding sign for crossroads and stations.

models.name: Round Hologram Sign
models.description: A round amber hologram emblem held in a ring rail on a forked pole, with glowing emitter pods at its sides. Works as a shop sign or a district marker.

models.name: Hologram Banner
models.description: A wide magenta hologram banner of invented glyphs and an emblem, projected between two poles. A bold street advert for plazas and market streets.

models.name: Hooded Crow
models.description: Hooded crow standing on the ground, 0.48 m long. Grey body with a black head, bib, wings, tail and bill. Animated idle (head turns and a small hop), peck and fly, a wing beat in place.

models.name: Hooped Powder Keg
models.description: Small oak gunpowder keg about 0.55 m tall bound with hoops. Weathered wood for a fort, a ship or a pirate hideout.

models.name: Horizontal Traffic Signal
models.description: East Asian style traffic signal, 6 m tall, with a slim horizontal three-lamp LED head on a 5 m cantilever arm. A galvanized pole with a blank blue name plate, a two-section pedestrian signal with figure lamps and a yellow push button box. Every lamp glows and can be switched; the model shows red.

models.name: Horse Chestnut
models.description: Mature horse chestnut in flower, about 20 m tall with a broad crown about 15 m across. Large leaves of five to seven leaflets cover heavy limbs that sweep low, dark scaly bark covers the trunk and upright white flower candles stand at the shoot tips.

models.name: Hose Reel
models.description: A green garden hose reel on a tubular steel stand, about 47 cm tall, wound with hose and turned by a crank. The free end runs to the ground with a brass coupling and a nozzle.

models.name: Hospital Building
models.description: Six storey hospital block, 50 x 25 m and 25 m tall, with a rooftop helipad. White precast bands and rows of lit windows over a dark glazed ground floor, blue grey stair cores, an emergency entrance under a deep ambulance canopy, and a lit helipad deck with a windsock beside the plant room.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Hospital Corridor Corner
models.description: Hospital corridor corner module 4 by 4 m with a 3.6 m storey, pale walls over sage wall protection, handrails, speckled vinyl and a tiled ceiling with LED panels.

models.name: Hospital Corridor End with Double Doors
models.description: Hospital corridor end module 4 m long closed by swing double doors with porthole windows that open. Pale walls over sage wall protection, handrails and speckled vinyl.

models.name: Hospital Corridor Kit
models.description: Hospital corridor modules, 4 m long with a 3.6 m storey: straight, corner, tee and an end with swing double doors. Pale walls over sage wall protection, crash rails with handrails, speckled vinyl and a tiled ceiling with LED panels.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Hospital Corridor Straight
models.description: Straight hospital corridor module 4 m long with a 3.6 m storey and a side door that opens. Pale walls over sage wall protection, crash rails with handrails, speckled vinyl and a tiled ceiling with LED panels.

models.name: Hospital Corridor T-Junction
models.description: Hospital corridor module 4 by 4 m where three corridors meet in a T, with a 3.6 m storey, sage wall protection, handrails, speckled vinyl and LED ceiling panels.

models.name: Hospital Ward
models.description: Four-bed hospital ward, 8 x 6 m with a 3.6 m storey and a window wall. Curtained bays on ceiling tracks, adjustable beds, wall-arm patient monitors, bedside cabinets, visitor chairs and a clinical hand-wash basin, clean and in daily use.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Street Food Cart
models.description: Stainless steel street food cart, 1.8 m long, on two rubber wheels with a fold-out stand and push handle. Steam-tray lids, a griddle and condiment bottles on the counter under a red and cream striped umbrella. Plain panels, no text.

models.name: Hot Plate Stirrer
models.description: A magnetic hot plate stirrer, 20 x 32 cm, with a white ceramic top, two control knobs and an amber display. A stir bar rests on the plate.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Ceiling
models.description: A 2.4 m square cell of painted hotel corridor ceiling with a smoke detector and a sprinkler head. It hangs 2.6 m above its origin, so it takes the same position as the floor below.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Door Wall
models.description: A 2.4 m hotel corridor wall with a guest room door that opens onto a dark room. Hardwood door and architrave, brass levers, a viewer, a card lock and a blank number plate.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Floor
models.description: A 2.4 m square cell of patterned red hotel carpet, worn along the middle. The pattern repeats every cell, so laid cells run on without seams.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Ice Machine Alcove
models.description: A 2.4 m hotel corridor wall with a tiled alcove holding a steel ice machine. The recess is 0.9 m deep with a vinyl floor, a flush ceiling light and steel corner guards.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Lift Lobby
models.description: A 4.8 m hotel corridor wall with two lifts in brushed steel frames and a call panel between them. The centre opening doors slide apart onto dark cars, under lit direction lamps.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Wall
models.description: A 2.4 m wide, 2.6 m tall hotel corridor wall. Cream panelled wainscot to a dado rail, faded ornamental wallpaper above and a moulded cornice at the ceiling.

models.name: Hotel Corridor Wall Lamp
models.description: A warm hotel corridor wall lamp about 30 cm tall: a brass back plate and swan neck arm under a cream fabric drum shade with a glowing bulb.

models.name: House Corner Kit
models.description: Corner posts and stone plinth for the modular red wooden house, 2.8 m posts and 0.4 m strips. White corner boards hide the wall ends at outer and inner corners, over a grey fieldstone plinth with corner blocks. Pieces snap on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: House Floor Kit
models.description: Pine floors and a straight stair for the modular red wooden house, in 2 x 2 m and 2 x 4 m pieces. A plain floor, a floor with a stair opening and a one-storey stair with a white rail, over pale painted ceiling boards. Pieces snap on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: House Porch Kit
models.description: Front porch for the modular red wooden house: a 2 x 2 m deck with two steps, a lean-to roof and a railing. Grey weathered boards on a red skirt, a dark tin roof on two white posts and a 2 m white rail. Pieces snap on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: House Roof Kit
models.description: Gable roof for the modular red wooden house, 40 degrees over a 4 m deep house in 2 m sections. Dark grey concrete tiles, white barge boards and eave frieze, a red board gable wall and a white plastered chimney. Pieces snap on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: House Wall Kit
models.description: Modular walls for a red Nordic wooden house, 2 m and 1 m wide and 2.8 m tall. Red board-and-batten outside, pale painted panelling inside, white-framed two-pane windows with glass and a green panel door. Pieces snap on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Housing Corner Pier
models.description: A concrete corner pier 0.45 m wide and 3 m tall that closes the end of a facade run. A rain pipe on brackets and a riser of cables run down its face.

models.name: Housing Facade AC Wall
models.description: A storey high concrete facade section 6 m wide crowded with seven AC units and their pipe runs. A small barred window, a meter box and a rain pipe complete the services wall.

models.name: Housing Facade Balcony Bay
models.description: A storey high teal facade section 6 m wide with a cantilevered balcony 1.35 m deep. Laundry hangs on a line over a railing with privacy panels, a potted plant and an AC unit.

models.name: Housing Facade Caged Window Bay
models.description: A storey high concrete facade section 6 m wide with a steel window cage standing out from the wall under a rusty sheet roof. Boxes and a plant sit inside the cage, beside two small windows.

models.name: Housing Facade Shop Front
models.description: A ground floor concrete facade section 6 m wide with a small shop behind a half open roller shutter. A glowing sign, a blade sign, an awning with a neon strip and a side door finish it.

models.name: Housing Facade External Stair
models.description: A storey high teal facade section 6 m wide with a steel switchback stair climbing its face from a landing at a door. Stacked sections form one continuous external stair.

models.name: Housing Facade Window Bay
models.description: A storey high precast concrete facade section 6 m wide with two steel framed windows, one lit behind blinds. An AC unit on brackets, a rain pipe and sagging cables crowd the wall.

models.name: Housing Roof Parapet
models.description: A 6 m concrete roof parapet 1.2 m tall with a strip of roof deck behind it. A white water tank on a rusty stand, an antenna mast, a satellite dish and a vent stack sit on the deck.

models.name: Hover Car
models.description: Four-seat city hover car, 4.6 m long, riding on four ducted thruster pods instead of wheels. Pearl white faceted wedge body over a graphite skirt, a dark glass canopy, a full-width lamp strip at the nose, a red light bar at the tail and glowing cyan pods.

models.name: Ice Hockey Rink
models.description: Regulation ice hockey rink, 200 x 85 ft (61 x 26 m) with 28 ft corners. Glossy scratched ice with red and blue lines, faceoff circles and creases, white boards with a yellow kick plate and blue top cap, glass on aluminium stanchions, two goals and two team benches.

models.name: Plate of Iced Christmas Cookies
models.description: A 25 cm glazed plate piled with eight iced Christmas cookies: stars, trees and snowmen. Glossy flood icing, piped lines and sprinkles sit on matt baked dough, with a few crumbs on the plate.

models.name: Iced Cinnamon Roll
models.description: A cinnamon roll, 10 cm across and 4.6 cm tall. A dark cinnamon swirl spirals through the soft golden dough under a zigzag drizzle of glossy white icing.

models.name: Impasto Abstract Canvas
models.description: An unframed abstract painting on a 120 by 90 cm gallery wrap canvas, 4 cm deep. Bold fields of ultramarine, orange, ochre and white are laid on thick with a palette knife, and the paint wraps round the sides.

models.name: Indoor Pool Hall
models.description: A public 25 m pool hall with five lanes, lane ropes, starting blocks, ladders and backstroke flags, ringed by tiled decks under a white steel roof. A tall glazed wall floods the hall with light; a tiled viewing bench and a lifeguard chair face the water.

models.name: Industrial Exosuit Loader
models.description: Original open-frame industrial power loader about 3 m tall, with an exposed seat inside a tubular roll cage. Safety-yellow paint worn to bare steel, two heavy hydraulic arms with clamp claws, stubby legs on flat feet, warning stripes, work lights and a beacon.

models.name: Inflatable Beach Ball
models.description: Inflatable vinyl beach ball about 38 cm across in sun-faded red, yellow, blue and white panels.

models.name: Interior Arch Wall 2 m
models.description: Plastered interior wall 2 m long and 2.8 m tall with an open segmental arch, warm white paint and white skirting. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Interior Door Wall 2 m
models.description: Plastered interior wall 2 m long and 2.8 m tall with a white three-panel door and steel lever handles. The door swings open. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Interior Fixtures Set
models.description: Interior fixtures for homes: a white panel radiator with valve and pipes, a dome pendant lamp and a brass wall sconce that glow, a socket, a smoke detector, a roller blind, linen curtains on a rod, a framed abstract print and an oak coat hook rail. Sized for the house kit windows and 2.6 m rooms.

models.name: Interior Partition Wall 1 m
models.description: Plastered interior partition 1 m long and 2.8 m tall, in warm white paint with white skirting. A half-length filler for the 2 m house kit grid.

models.name: Interior Partition Wall 2 m
models.description: Plastered interior partition 2 m long, 2.8 m tall and 0.12 m thick, in warm white paint with white skirting on both faces. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Interior Staircase
models.description: Straight timber staircase for a house interior, rising one 2.8 m storey in a 1 x 4 m footprint. Oiled oak treads on white painted strings and risers, square balusters, newel posts and an oak handrail, an oak wall rail, plus a 2 m landing balustrade. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Interior Wall Corner Post
models.description: Plastered post 0.12 m square and 2.8 m tall that closes the corner where two interior partitions meet on the 2 m grid.

models.name: Interior Wall Kit
models.description: Modular interior walls, 0.1 m plastered partitions 2.8 m tall in 2 m and 1 m pieces. Warm white painted plaster with white skirting, a three-panel door with steel lever handles, a segmental arch, a corner post and plaster linings for outer house walls. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Ionic Offering Stand
models.description: A small marble Ionic column on a square plinth, about 1.1 m tall, carrying a shallow offering dish. The stone is weathered and chipped.

models.name: Small Iron Brazier
models.description: A small iron brazier of glowing coals 14 cm tall on three legs, sized to stand on a workbench.

models.name: Iron Naval Cannon
models.description: Cast-iron naval gun on a stepped four-truck ship carriage with a quoin and breeching rope, about 2.5 m long. Rusty iron and weathered oak; the barrel and trucks move.

models.name: Italian Cypress
models.description: Italian cypress, a narrow column about 18 m tall, with a younger 8 m tree beside it. Dense, dark green scale foliage hugs the trunk from the ground to the pointed top, with a few round woody cones.

models.name: Mature Italian Cypress
models.description: Mature Italian cypress, a narrow column about 18 m tall and under 4 m wide. Dense, dark green scale foliage hugs the trunk from the ground to the pointed top, with a few round woody cones.

models.name: Young Italian Cypress
models.description: Young Italian cypress about 8.5 m tall and under 3 m wide, a slim column of dense, dark green scale foliage from the ground to a pointed top.

models.name: Izakaya Front
models.description: Small two-storey pub on a narrow lot, 5 m wide, 9 m deep and 6.4 m tall. Red paper lanterns hang from a corrugated canopy over sliding lattice doors and a bamboo blind, with beer crates, a crate table and stools outside, and a lit vertical blank sign on the flat above.

models.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
models.description: Carved orange pumpkin lantern with a candle inside, about 31 cm across and 30 cm tall. Triangle eyes and nose and a toothy grin, glowing warm orange from inside so it reads in the dark. The stem lid rests askew and can be lifted; the flame can be hidden.

models.name: Moon Jellyfish
models.description: Moon jellyfish with a 35 cm translucent bell. Four lilac rings show through the clear bell, four frilled oral arms hang below and a fringe of fine tentacles trails behind. The pulse clip swims in place, bell first (up).

models.name: Olive Steel Jerry Can
models.description: 20 litre steel jerry can, 0.47 m tall, 0.345 m wide and 0.165 m thick. Welded pressed halves with an X-shaped emboss, three handles and a cam-lever spout. Worn olive paint with bare steel on the edges and rust in the chips.

models.name: Red Steel Jerry Can
models.description: Red 20 litre steel fuel can, 0.47 m tall, 0.345 m wide and 0.165 m thick. The same shape as the Steel Jerry Can, with an X-shaped emboss, three handles and a cam-lever spout. Worn red paint with bare steel on the edges and rust in the chips.

models.name: Passenger Boarding Bridge
models.description: Passenger boarding bridge about 29 m long from rotunda to cab, with a 3.15 m floor height for narrowbody doors. Grey glazed tunnels telescope over each other, a swivelling cab with a black bellows canopy meets the aircraft, and a lifting drive leg on two wheels carries the outer tunnel.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Straw Yule Goat
models.description: Straw Yule goat, 1.2 m tall to the tips of its long curved horns. Golden straw bundles that fray at the muzzle, ears, beard, tail and feet, bound with red ribbon bands that spiral up the horns.

models.name: Junction Box Cluster
models.description: A cluster of small electrical boxes and a meter joined by conduits on a wall. Lit status lights and worn paint suit busy backstreets.

models.name: Street Junction Cabinet
models.description: A painted steel junction cabinet with a hinged door, vents and small status lights. Scuffed paint and grime give it years of street use.

models.name: Jungle Stepped Temple
models.description: Ruined stepped stone pyramid, 24 x 24 m at the base and 18 m tall, with a steep central stair and a small shrine on top. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, black water streaks, carved panels and roots draping over the terraces; two corners have collapsed into rubble.

models.name: Jungle Temple Altar
models.description: A carved stone temple altar with a shallow bowl in its top, about 1.8 m wide and 1.1 m high. Weathered grey-green stone with moss in the carvings.

models.name: Jungle Temple Interior Set
models.description: Set of carved stone temple chamber fittings: an altar with a shallow bowl, a 1 x 1 m pressure-plate floor tile, a 2.8 m puzzle wall with a 2 m disc in three turning rings, two wall braziers with glowing embers and a sarcophagus with a sliding lid.

models.name: Jungle Temple Pressure Plate
models.description: A 1 x 1 m carved stone plate set in a floor tile about 1.5 m square, which sinks when stepped on to trigger a trap or puzzle. Weathered temple stone.

models.name: Jungle Temple Puzzle Wall
models.description: A 2.8 m carved stone temple wall with a 2 m disc of three rings that turn to solve a puzzle, flanked by two wall braziers of glowing embers. Weathered grey-green stone.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Column
models.description: A standing square stone column of a jungle temple, about 5.1 m tall on a 1.3 m base. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines.

models.name: Broken Jungle Temple Ruin Column
models.description: The snapped lower half of a square temple column, about 2.8 m tall on a 1.3 m base. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines.

models.name: Fallen Jungle Temple Ruin Column
models.description: A toppled temple column lying in broken pieces on the ground, about 6 m long and 0.9 m high. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Doorway
models.description: A temple wall piece with a doorway under a heavy stone lintel, 4 m wide and 3.7 m high. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines. Fits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Kit
models.description: Modular jungle temple ruin kit on a 2 m grid: walls, a broken wall, a lintel doorway, columns intact, broken and fallen, steps, a raised platform and a rubble pile. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Platform
models.description: A raised square stone platform, 4 x 4 m and 1.2 m high, for altars or walls to stand on. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines. Fits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Rubble Pile
models.description: A heap of tumbled cut stone blocks from a collapsed temple, about 3.6 m across and 1.8 m high. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Steps
models.description: A flight of worn stone steps, 4 m wide, rising 1.2 m to the height of the ruin platform. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines. Fits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Jungle Temple Ruin Wall
models.description: A straight stone wall of a jungle temple ruin, 4 m long, 3.6 m high and 1.2 m thick. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines. Snaps to the other ruin pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Broken Jungle Temple Ruin Wall
models.description: A collapsed section of jungle temple wall, 4 m long and up to 3.7 m high, with fallen blocks at its foot. Weathered grey-green limestone with moss, water streaks and vines. Fits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Jungle Temple Sarcophagus
models.description: A carved stone sarcophagus about 2.4 m long with a heavy lid that slides off. Weathered grey-green temple stone with moss in the carving.

models.name: Common Juniper
models.description: Common juniper about 2 m tall: an irregular, dense column of prickly blue-green needles in whorls of three, on several stems with stringy, peeling red-brown bark and a few blue-black berries.

models.name: Karaoke Building
models.description: Five-storey karaoke and entertainment building, 9 m wide and 19 m tall, with a mirrored glass front framed in LED strips and a lit blank sign tower rising past the roof. Coloured rooms glow behind some panes over a bright glass lobby with an entrance canopy; tiled sides and a plain back.

models.name: Kei Van
models.description: Tiny boxy mini van, 3.40 m long, 1.48 m wide and 1.89 m tall. Off-white with black resin bumpers, a stub nose under a tall windscreen, sliding side doors with windows and a black tubular roof rack.

models.name: Giant Kelp
models.description: Giant kelp about 6 m tall: four thin stipes rising from one tangled holdfast. Long, ruffled golden-brown blades on small gas bladders hang off every stipe and splay in all directions, and the tops bend over into a trailing canopy. It sways in the current.

models.name: 12 kg Kettlebell
models.description: A cast iron kettlebell of 12 kg, 26 cm tall. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and a handle worn smooth by hands.

models.name: 16 kg Kettlebell
models.description: A cast iron kettlebell of 16 kg, 28 cm tall. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and a handle worn smooth by hands.

models.name: 20 kg Kettlebell
models.description: A cast iron kettlebell of 20 kg, 30 cm tall. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and a handle worn smooth by hands.

models.name: 24 kg Kettlebell
models.description: A cast iron kettlebell of 24 kg, 31 cm tall. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and a handle worn smooth by hands.

models.name: 8 kg Kettlebell
models.description: A cast iron kettlebell of 8 kg, 24 cm tall. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and a handle worn smooth by hands.

models.name: Kettlebell Set
models.description: Five cast iron kettlebells from 8 to 24 kg, 24 to 31 cm tall, standing in a row. Matte black coating with casting pits, a few chips to bare iron and handles worn smooth by hands; each kettlebell can be picked up on its own.

models.name: Key Set
models.description: Three keys for locked doors and gates: a 14 cm forged iron dungeon key with a quatrefoil bow and a warded bit, a 7 cm brass door key on a steel split ring and an 86 x 54 mm access card with a printed photo, a gold chip and a small green light.

models.name: Kicksled
models.description: Nordic kicksled, 1.8 m long with a handlebar at about 0.93 m. A red tubular steel frame, a varnished wooden seat and backrest, rubber grips and flat steel runners that curl up at the front. Lightly chipped paint and polished runner soles.

models.name: Kilometer Post
models.description: Small roadside kilometer marker, a white timber post 0.85 m tall. A low pyramid top and blank white enamel number plates with a thin black border on both sides, so a distance can be added. Grimy, flaking paint, road splash and algae on the back.

models.name: Kitchen Base Unit with Door
models.description: Modern kitchen base cabinet 0.6 m wide and 0.9 m to the worktop, with a matt white slab door that opens, a steel bar handle and a solid oak worktop. Lines up side by side with matching units.

models.name: Kitchen Base Unit with Drawers
models.description: Modern kitchen base cabinet 0.6 m wide and 0.9 m tall with three matt white drawers that pull out, steel bar handles and a solid oak worktop. Lines up with matching units.

models.name: Kitchen Sink Base Unit
models.description: Modern kitchen sink cabinet 1.2 m wide with two matt white doors that open, a solid oak worktop, an inset steel sink with a drainer and a mixer tap. Lines up with matching units.

models.name: Kitchen Base Units
models.description: Three modern kitchen base units, 0.9 m to the worktop: a 0.6 m door unit, a 0.6 m unit with three drawers and a 1.2 m sink unit. Matt white slab fronts, steel bar handles and a solid oak worktop; the sink unit has an inset steel sink with a drainer and a mixer tap. Units line up side by side.

models.name: Pine Kitchen Table
models.description: Pine kitchen table, 1.2 x 0.8 m and 0.75 m high, in a simple Nordic cabin style. A worn, oiled five-board top with scratches, dents and darker stains, on four turned legs joined by aprons.

models.name: Kitchen Wall Cabinets
models.description: Two 0.6 m kitchen wall cabinets and a 0.6 m open oak shelf unit, 0.72 m tall and 0.34 m deep, made to hang with their underside at 1.45 m. Matt white slab doors with steel bar handles match the base units; the shelf holds glass storage jars, plates and mugs.

models.name: Kite Shield
models.description: A 1.0 m Norman kite shield of curved planks under a leather facing, painted in red and ochre halves with an iron rim and boss. The back carries leather arm straps and a cushion, and the face shows sword cuts, flaked paint and a dented rim.

models.name: Knightly Longsword
models.description: A 1.2 m hand and a half longsword with a stiff diamond section blade and a short shallow fuller. It has a straight forged cross guard, a dark leather grip over raised risers and a chamfered wheel pommel, with polished steel, bright honed edges and light pitting by the guard.

models.name: Knobbed Conch Shell
models.description: Knobbed conch shell about 15 cm long with a spiral spire and natural shell patterning on a wet, clean surface.

models.name: Kohaku Koi
models.description: A single koi carp about 0.6 m long, its body bent mid-stroke. Kohaku pattern: pearly white scales with bold red patches along the back.

models.name: Koi Pond Set
models.description: Garden koi pond kit for a 4 m pond, with stones, a bridge and fish. Granite edge boulders and flat stepping stones, a 2.6 m arched wooden bridge with vermilion rails and four koi in classic patterns. Each piece is its own node; the water surface is not included.

models.name: Korean Apartment Tower
models.description: 20-storey apartment tower slab of four flats per floor, 42 x 12 m and 63 m tall to its stepped rooftop crown. White painted walls carry full glazed balconies and louvred AC rooms, a large blank panel fills each end wall and a canopy marks the ground-floor lobby. Copies line up into a complex.

models.name: Korean Villa Block
models.description: 4-storey red-brick multi-family house, 12 x 11 m and 15 m tall to its rooftop tank. Three floors of flats with barred windows, AC units and gas pipes stand on concrete pilotis over open parking, with a rooftop of green paint, a water tank, storage jars and garden pots.

models.name: Lab Bench End Panel
models.description: A white end panel, 0.88 m high and 0.72 m deep, that closes the open end of a run of laboratory wall benches.

models.name: Lab Chest Freezer
models.description: A white laboratory chest freezer, 1.1 m wide and 0.91 m tall, with a lift-up lid, a thermostat dial and a wire basket inside.

models.name: Lab Drawer Bench
models.description: A 1.2 m wall bench for a laboratory, 0.9 m high with a black epoxy worktop on grey steel frames. Under it hang three drawers and a cupboard; modules join side by side at 1.2 m.

models.name: Lab Island Bench
models.description: A double sided laboratory island bench, 1.2 x 1.5 m, with black epoxy worktops either side of a service spine of sockets and gas taps. Two reagent shelves rise to 1.95 m.

models.name: Lab Sink Bench
models.description: A 1.2 m laboratory sink bench, 0.9 m high, with a black epoxy bowl, a gooseneck tap and a drying pegboard. Two doors close the cupboard under the sink.

models.name: Laden Wooden Handcart
models.description: A two-wheeled wooden handcart 2.3 m long, loaded with three burlap sacks and a coil of rope.

models.name: Lady Fern
models.description: Lady fern about 0.8 m tall, a shuttlecock of finely divided, lacy, bright green fronds on reddish stalks. The fronds arch out at the tips, with a yellowing frond, a few damaged ones and old brown frond bases at the crown.

models.name: Lake Landscape Painting
models.description: An invented romantic landscape painting, 1.8 by 1.4 m, in a carved gilt frame with shell corners. A path leads past dark trees to a lake under misty blue mountains.

models.name: Lance Snow Gun
models.description: Snowmaking lance, 7.6 m long, leaning out from a hinged base beside its hydrant on a concrete pad. A steel bipod holds it mid way and a nozzle head tops it.

models.name: Sci-Fi Landing Pad
models.description: Original raised hexagonal sci-fi landing pad, 30 m across the corners and 1.5 m high. Grey steel deck plates with yellow landing markings, blue rim lights, red corner beacons, a stair with railings, a swinging fuel arm and a small control kiosk.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Laptop
models.description: A 14-inch silver aluminium laptop, 31 x 22 cm and 16 mm thick closed, shown open. Bead-blasted shell with a bright cut lid edge, black keys with light legends, a glass trackpad, speaker perforation and USB-C ports; the blank screen is ready for an image or video.

models.name: Large Mountain Canvas
models.description: A panoramic painting of mountain ranges at sunrise, 150 by 60 cm, in soft layered blues and pinks. The canvas floats in a thin oak frame with a shadow gap around it.

models.name: Large Red Paper Lantern
models.description: One big red paper lantern about 1.3 m tall and 0.8 m wide, hanging from a cord. Ribbed paper with black lacquered rims and a blank face, lit from inside at night.

models.name: Latte Glass
models.description: A tall glass of layered caffe latte, 11 cm tall, with milk, coffee and foam bands and a rosetta poured on top.

models.name: Lattice TV Tower
models.description: A 250 m steel lattice broadcast tower painted in orange and white warning bands. Its legs curve out to a 60 m square base; a two-storey glazed observation deck wraps the shaft at 116 m, with an equipment platform at 195 m, an antenna mast and red aircraft warning lights.

models.name: Two-Stage Launch Rocket
models.description: Original two-stage medium-lift launch rocket, about 60 m tall with two strap-on side boosters. White with dark insulation bands, a riveted interstage, an ogive payload fairing that splits in two halves and a cluster of sooty engine bells.

models.name: Launch Tower and Pad
models.description: Red oxide steel launch tower about 66 m tall with a lightning mast, on a stepped concrete pad with a scorched flame trench. Work platforms, an elevator shaft, stairs, piping and a swing arm with a covered crew walkway; a 60 m rocket placed at the origin stands on the launch table.

models.name: Laundry Basket
models.description: Laundry basket, 57 x 40 cm and 31 cm tall, in light grey woven-look plastic with hand holes at both ends. It is heaped with laundry: a green towel, a mustard sweater, a white pinstriped shirt, socks and jeans with one leg hanging over the front rim.
models.changes: The laundry is now a heap of separate garments that sits inside the basket, with one jeans leg hanging over the front rim.

models.name: Lavender Clump
models.description: A lavender clump about 80 cm tall and 1 m across. Slender purple flower spikes fan out on long stems above a cushion of grey-green shoots.

models.name: Lawn Grass Tufts
models.description: Short, bright mown-lawn grass tufts 5 to 12 cm tall, spread over a 1 x 1 m square. Blades are cut straight across with pale tips. Place on top of a lawn ground material; copies on a 1 m grid join edge to edge.

models.name: Leaning Cracked Gravestone
models.description: An old slab headstone tilting in the ground with a chipped corner and cracks across its face, about 1 m tall. Weathered, with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front is blank and worn.

models.name: Leaning Oak Floor Mirror
models.description: A tall oak framed floor mirror, 60 cm wide and 1.7 m tall, leaning back against the wall. The moulded frame has a soft rounded face.

models.name: Leaning Stone Coffin Lid
models.description: A carved limestone coffin lid about 2 m long, standing on end and leaning against a wall. Grey stone, worn and chipped.

models.name: Leather Banquette Bench
models.description: A 1.4 m cafe banquette bench in oxblood leather with a channel tufted back on a walnut plinth. It stands against a wall facing the tables.

models.name: Leather Work Gloves
models.description: A pair of tan leather work gloves lying palm down, about 26 cm long. Puffy, slightly curled fingers with dark stitched seams and stiff blue canvas safety cuffs.

models.name: Lemon
models.description: A lemon lying on its side, 8.6 cm long and 6 cm thick. Its pointed ends and pitted, waxy yellow peel catch the light.

models.name: Level Crossing Gate
models.description: An East Asian railway level crossing with a 5.5 m yellow and black striped barrier arm on a grey drive box. The warning post carries two pairs of red flashing lamps, a lit direction arrow box, a striped crossbuck and an alarm speaker. The arm swings up and the lamps glow.

models.name: Liana Loop
models.description: A woody liana slung in a deep loop about 3.6 m deep between two points 1.1 m apart. Two corky strands twist like rope and carry leafy shoots; the second end is along +x at the same height.

models.name: Library Oak Bookcase
models.description: A tall oak bookcase 1.5 m wide and 3 m high, with six shelves in two bays packed with worn leather bindings. A few books lean or lie in stacks, and a moulded cornice caps the top.

models.name: Library Reading Lectern
models.description: A turned oak reading lectern about 1.3 m high on three splayed feet, its sloped desk holding a large open book. A ledge along the low edge keeps the book from sliding.

models.name: Library Rolling Ladder
models.description: An oak library ladder hooked over a 3 m brass rail, with wheels at its foot. The rail sits 2.6 m up on wall brackets, made to run along the front of two tall bookcases.

models.name: Library Scroll Rack
models.description: An oak rack of pigeonholes 1.2 m wide and 1.75 m high, every cell piled with rolled parchment scrolls. It stands against a wall in a library or a scribe's room.

models.name: Lifeguard Tower
models.description: A raised wooden lifeguard hut on braced stilts, about 4 m tall with a long ramp at the back. Sun-faded yellow clapboard with white trim, a red metal roof over a railed lookout porch and an orange ring buoy on the side. The porch faces the sea.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Chairlift Tower Pad
models.description: Red quilted safety pad, 2.4 m tall, strapped round a 0.5 m steel lift column on a concrete footing. Snow lies on top of the pad and in a drift round its base.

models.name: Light Aircraft
models.description: Four-seat high-wing single-engine light aircraft, about 8 m long with an 11 m wingspan. White with a maroon side stripe and spinner, braced wings, a two-blade propeller and fixed tricycle gear with wheel fairings.

models.name: Light Helicopter
models.description: Five-seat single-engine light helicopter, 9.8 m long with a 10.4 m three-blade main rotor. White over navy with a large glazed cabin, skid gear and a furnished cockpit. Rotors spin and all four cabin doors open.

models.name: Lighthouse
models.description: Coastal lighthouse about 30 m tall with an attached keeper's cottage, on a rocky outcrop. A tapering white-rendered tower on a granite plinth, a corbelled gallery with an iron railing, a black glazed lantern around a rotating lens, and a slate-roofed cottage.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Flat Limestone Boulder
models.description: Low, broad limestone boulder about 2 m across and 1.2 m tall with a shallow pan on top. Pale grey with rain-cut runnels, dark streaks, lichen and moss at the foot.

models.name: Large Limestone Boulder
models.description: Pale grey weathered limestone boulder about 3 m long and 1.5 m tall, blocky with rounded edges. Rain-cut flutes and runnels, dark run-off streaks, lichen spots and moss at the foot.

models.name: Medium Limestone Boulder
models.description: Pale grey limestone boulder about 1.5 m across and 0.8 m tall, blocky with rounded edges. Rain-cut flutes, run-off streaks, lichen spots and moss at the foot.

models.name: Limestone Boulder Set
models.description: Set of five pale grey weathered limestone boulders from 0.5 to 3 m across. Blocky shapes with rounded edges, rain-cut solution flutes and runnels down the sides, shallow pans on top, dark run-off streaks, lichen spots and moss at the foot.

models.name: Small Limestone Boulder
models.description: Small pale grey limestone boulder about 1 m across and 0.6 m tall with rounded edges, runnels, lichen spots and moss at the foot.

models.name: Small Limestone Rock
models.description: Pale grey limestone rock about 0.5 m across and 0.3 m tall with rounded edges, lichen spots and a little moss. Good for scattering around larger boulders.

models.name: Closed Linen Curtains
models.description: A pair of grey green linen curtains drawn closed on a black iron pole, about 2 m wide and 2.4 m tall. The heavier close weave falls to the floor in deep, uneven rounded folds.

models.name: Linen Curtains on Rod
models.description: Two pleated linen curtain panels drawn to the sides of a 1 m window, on a 2.1 m steel rod with ball finials and two brackets. About 2.5 m tall, for 2.6 m rooms.

models.name: Loaded Ski Rack
models.description: A galvanised steel ski rack, 1.65 m wide, holding two pairs of skis, a snowboard and a pair of poles. The skis lean in slots along the top bar.

models.name: Loading Dock
models.description: Truck loading dock bay, a 6 m wide wall section over a 1.2 m high concrete dock, made for a semi trailer to back onto. A hydraulic dock leveller, rubber bumpers, a dark fabric dock shelter, a swing arm dock light and a red and green traffic light, with yellow wheel guides on the apron.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Lockback Folding Knife
models.description: A lock-back folding knife lying open, about 20 cm long, with a steel blade and walnut handle scales between brass bolsters. The blade shows scratches from use.

models.name: Locker Room Bench
models.description: A 1.16 m changing room bench: three hardwood slats on steel pedestals with a round bar shoe shelf underneath.

models.name: Locker Room Coat Rail Bench
models.description: A 1.16 m double sided changing room bench with a coat rail 1.8 m high: hardwood slats and back rails on a steel spine, chrome coat hooks on both sides and a hat shelf on top.

models.name: Locker Room Drain Floor
models.description: A 1.2 m square cell of wet grey mosaic floor falling gently to a square steel drain grate in the middle. It lays in with the plain floor cells.

models.name: Locker Room Floor
models.description: A 1.2 m square cell of wet grey mosaic changing room floor. Small square tiles, dark grout and grit in the corners; laid cells join without seams.

models.name: Locker Room Shower Bay
models.description: A 1.2 m tiled shower bay with its own back wall: a sunken mosaic tray with a drain, bullnosed tiled side partitions and a chrome shower head, mixer and soap shelf.

models.name: Tall Locker Row
models.description: A 1.2 m row of four tall green steel lockers, 1.86 m to the sloping top. Full height louvred doors that open, with a hat shelf and coat rail inside; one door stands ajar.

models.name: Two-Tier Locker Row
models.description: A 1.2 m row of eight tired green steel lockers in two tiers, 1.86 m tall to the sloping top. Louvred doors that open, chrome handles and a dark plinth; two doors hang ajar.

models.name: Locker Room Wall
models.description: A 1.2 m wide, 2.7 m tall changing room wall tiled on both faces. Cream tiles with a green band at the base and at shoulder height, grubby with age.

models.name: Locker Room Wash Trough
models.description: A 1.2 m tiled wall with a stainless steel wash trough on brackets, three swan neck taps and a framed mirror strip above.

models.name: Spruce Log Pile
models.description: Roadside pile of 20 spruce logs, 4 to 5 m long and 15 to 35 cm thick, on two cross logs. Sawn ends show growth rings, saw marks, drying checks and a few painted spray marks. Scaly bark, scraped off in strips on some logs.

models.name: Lombardy Poplar
models.description: Lombardy poplar, a narrow flame-shaped column about 25 m tall and under 5 m wide. Steep branches hug the fluted, deeply furrowed trunk from near the ground to a pointed top, dense with glossy triangular leaves.

models.name: Long Hanging Vine
models.description: A leafy jungle vine about 10 m long that hangs from its top, with a side shoot halfway down. Heart-shaped glossy leaves line it all the way to a curled growing tip.

models.name: Wool Carpet Floor Panel
models.description: A 2 x 2 m interior floor panel of soft wool loop carpet on a 0.2 m slab, for bedrooms and living rooms. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Loose Straw Patch
models.description: Loose tufts of dirty straw scattered over about 2.3 x 1.9 m of floor, for a cell or stable. Pale yellow and grey stalks.

models.name: Louvred Wall Vent
models.description: A wide aluminium vent box with slanted louvres, a dark mesh behind them and a drip lip. Dirty, streaked and dented by weather.

models.name: Low Plastic Stool
models.description: A low round plastic stool, about 0.43 m tall, the kind stacked by the dozen at street food stalls.

models.name: Low Termite Mound
models.description: A low, rounded termite mound of red savanna clay, about 1 m tall and 2 m across. A broken chimney with an open vent and a small spur rise from its dusty dome.

models.name: Lunar Lander
models.description: Original four-legged crewed lunar lander, about 7 m tall and 8.5 m across the footpads. A crinkled gold-foil descent stage carries a faceted grey crew cabin with angled windows, a front hatch over a porch and ladder, side tanks, RCS thrusters and a dish antenna.

models.name: Lupine Clump
models.description: Wild garden lupine clump with six flower spikes 60 to 100 cm tall, five purple-blue and one pink, over a mound of palmate leaves. Origin on the ground at the centre of the crown; stems, spikes and leaves carry wind data for sway and leaf flutter.

models.name: Lying Amphora
models.description: A terracotta transport amphora about 1 m long, lying on its side on the ground. The clay shows firing clouds, a pale slip and lime crust.

models.name: Lying Book Stack
models.description: A stack of five books lying flat and slightly askew, about 25 cm across and 15 cm high. Cloth hardcovers and paperbacks with cream page edges, for a table or a shelf.

models.name: Mahogany Bar Counter
models.description: A 1.2 m pub bar counter module in dark mahogany with its top 1.07 m high. The customer side has raised panels, a bullnose top and a brass foot rail; the staff side has a stainless sink, drainboard and shelf. Modules butt end to end on a 1.2 m grid.

models.name: Mahogany Bar Counter End
models.description: A quarter round end for the mahogany pub bar counter, 1.07 m tall. Curved panelled front, bullnose top and a brass foot rail with a domed end cap. It closes the right end of a counter run.

models.name: Rural Mailbox
models.description: Rural roadside mailbox on a wooden post, the box bottom 1.03 m above the ground. A tunnel-shaped box of dark green sheet steel with a drop-down front door, on a square sawn post with a brace. Faded, chipped paint with rust runs and a few dents.

models.name: Nordic Mailbox Row
models.description: Three Nordic rural mailboxes side by side on a board, 1.0 m above the ground. Boxy sheet-steel bodies with slanted roofs, hinged lids and blank white name plates: one galvanized, one dark green and one red, faded and chipped with rust runs and road dust.

models.name: Main Battle Tank
models.description: Generic modern main battle tank, about 9.5 m long with the gun forward and 3.7 m wide. Matte olive drab with an angular armoured turret, a long 120 mm-class gun and side skirts over seven road wheels a side, sun-faded on top and caked with dust and mud low down.

models.name: Male Fern
models.description: Male fern about 1 m tall, a robust clump of dark green, stiff, finely toothed fronds on stalks shaggy with brown scales. Two scaly fiddleheads are uncurling at the centre, and dead fronds lie around the base.

models.name: Mangrove Tree
models.description: Red mangrove about 9 m tall, lifted on a tangle of arching stilt roots. The crooked grey trunk stands on roots that branch as they reach out to the mud, thin aerial roots drop from the limbs, and a broad crown of thick, glossy dark leaves clusters at the shoot tips.

models.name: Manhole and Drain Set
models.description: Cast iron manhole covers, a gully grating and a covered drain channel for city streets, 0.7 m covers and a 2 m channel, as six flat pieces. Two covers carry a raised blossom and wave pattern, one with worn paint in the recesses; the rest are anti-slip castings and concrete lids.

models.name: Manta Ray
models.description: Reef manta ray with a 4 m wingspan. Black back with blurred white shoulder patches, white belly with a few dark spots, rolled cephalic fins beside a wide mouth and a thin whip tail. The clips swim in place.

models.name: Marble Altar
models.description: A weathered marble altar about 1.2 m long and 1.2 m tall, with scroll bolsters along its top and a heap of ash on its hearth. A garland relief with ribbons and a rosette runs across the front panel.

models.name: Marble Bistro Table
models.description: A round bistro table 60 cm across and 75 cm tall, with a white marble top on a black cast iron column and base.

models.name: Marble High Bistro Table
models.description: A bar height round bistro table, 60 cm across and 1.05 m tall, with a white marble top, a cast iron base and a brass foot ring.

models.name: Marble Stylobate Section
models.description: A 3 m section of a weathered marble temple base with three 0.3 m steps, 0.9 m high. The step blocks are chipped and slightly shifted, with dry grass in the joints. Sections chain end to end on a 3 m column bay.

models.name: Marble Torso Sculpture
models.description: A classical style marble torso fragment on an iron rod, set on a white marble pedestal, about 1.9 m tall overall.

models.name: Marigold Edging Row
models.description: A 1.1 m edging row of orange marigolds about 27 cm tall. Ruffled orange and yellow blooms sit on dark, finely cut foliage.

models.name: Christmas Market Stall
models.description: Wooden Christmas market stall, 3 m wide, 2 m deep and 2.8 m tall, with snow on its roof. A dark stained board hut with a wide sales window, a fold-down counter, empty shelves and a spruce garland with warm white lights that read lit at night.

models.name: Marshal Post
models.description: Race circuit marshal post, a 2 x 2 m galvanised platform 1.0 m up, 3.5 m tall. A railing, back stair and sloping roof over a chequer plate deck with an extinguisher, a broom and a flag box, plus an LED signal panel that can show any colour. Place it behind a barrier.

models.name: Meadow Grass Patch
models.description: Dense 1 x 1 m patch of mixed meadow grass, 40 to 70 cm tall, with a few seed heads and some dry blades. Every blade grows from inside the 1 m square around the origin, so copies placed on a 1 m grid join edge to edge; the longest blades lean up to about 45 cm into the neighbouring tiles.

models.name: Mechanical Keyboard
models.description: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard, 36 x 13.6 cm, in a grey aluminium case with a coiled cable. Sculpted cream and grey keycaps with dished tops, printed legends and one orange escape key; the black braided coil runs back to a metal aviator connector.

models.name: Medieval Crossbow
models.description: A 0.9 m medieval crossbow with a worn walnut tiller and a steel prod lashed on with a cord bridle. The twisted string is drawn into a bone nut, with an iron foot stirrup in front and a long trigger lever beneath.

models.name: Medieval Tavern
models.description: Two-storey medieval inn about 14 x 9 m: a stone ground floor under a jettied timber-framed upper storey and a steep wooden shingle roof with two chimneys. A porch with benches and barrels shades the door under a carved tankard sign, and the taproom inside, with its hearth, tables and bar, is walkable.

models.name: Meeting Room
models.description: Glass-walled office meeting room, 6 x 4 m with a 3 m ceiling. Two glass partitions with a swinging glass door, two painted walls, a long oak table with eight chairs, a wall screen over a credenza, a whiteboard and lit ceiling panels. The blank screen is a separate mesh, ready for an image or video.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Galvanized Bucket
models.description: Galvanized steel bucket with a wire bail handle, 0.30 m tall and 0.32 m across the rim. Spangled zinc with dull oxide, scratches and dents, including a squashed rim. Inside a water line, white rust and dried mud. The handle hangs down over the front.

models.name: Metro Hanging Sign Frame
models.description: Blank station sign frame about 2.5 m wide hung from the vault on drop rods, about 2.8 m from top to bottom. Ready for your own station name or direction graphics.

models.name: Metro Platform Back Wall
models.description: Back wall module 6 m long and 3.2 m tall in cream tiles over dark skirting, with a green tiled frieze, a cornice and a conduit. Chains along the platform with the other 6 m modules.

models.name: Metro Platform Bench
models.description: Station bench 2 m long with wooden slats on a painted metal frame. Lightly worn from use.

models.name: Metro Platform Column
models.description: Square platform column about 0.6 m wide and 4.6 m tall for a metro station. Finished to match the cream tiled station walls.

models.name: Metro Platform End with Stairs
models.description: Platform end module with an end wall, an opening for the track and a stair passage rising 2.8 m, about 7.3 m deep and 7.1 m tall. Cream tiles with a green frieze, closing a run of platform modules.

models.name: Metro Platform Kit
models.description: A kit of 6 m modules for an underground metro platform under a cream-tiled barrel vault with a green frieze. Platform with a tactile edge strip, walls, vault, track trough, lamp run, column, bench, bin, blank sign frames and a platform end with stairs up. Modules chain along the platform.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Metro Platform Lamp Run
models.description: Run of platform lamps 6 m long that hangs from the vault, with glowing light fittings. Chains module by module along the platform.

models.name: Metro Platform Litter Bin
models.description: Freestanding metal litter bin about 0.9 m tall for a station platform. Lightly scuffed from use.

models.name: Metro Platform Section
models.description: Platform module 6 m long and about 4 m deep with a stone floor, a tactile edge strip and granite coping with a yellow line over an under-platform recess. Modules chain end to end along the platform.

models.name: Metro Platform Vault
models.description: Barrel vault module 6 m long spanning 8 m, about 7.7 m tall, lined in cream tiles. Sits over the platform and track modules and chains along the station.

models.name: Metro Track Trough
models.description: Track trough module 6 m long with slab track, running rails and a third rail, plus the far wall in cream tiles with blank poster frames. Chains with the platform modules.

models.name: Metro Train Car
models.description: An 18 m stainless-steel metro car with a driving cab at one end and four double sliding doors on each side. Fluted silver sides, a dark window band, bench seats along the walls, grab poles and lit ceiling strips inside. Standard gauge; its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Metro Tunnel Kit
models.description: Three 10 m pieces of a 5.7 m bored metro tunnel: straight, curve left and curve right, lined with precast concrete rings. Slab track with a covered third rail, a raised walkway with a handrail, cable runs, a red fire main and wall lamps. Pieces chain end to end along the track.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Metro Wall Sign Frame
models.description: Blank wall-mounted station sign frame about 3.1 m wide and 0.65 m tall. Ready for your own station name graphics.

models.name: Microphone and Stand Set
models.description: Microphone set: vocal mics on a tripod boom stand and a round-base stand, plus a floor wedge monitor. A studio condenser mic in a shock mount with a pop filter hangs from a spring arm clamped to a small desk.

models.name: Micropipette Stand
models.description: A carousel stand holding five micropipettes, 38 cm tall, with colour coded plunger buttons in blue, yellow, red and green.

models.name: Military Guard Tower
models.description: Military guard tower about 9 m tall with a separate barrier gate and guard hut. Olive steel legs and timber carry a sandbagged lookout cabin under a corrugated roof with a searchlight, reached by a caged ladder, with razor wire coiled round the base.

models.name: Military Transport Plane
models.description: Original four-engine turboprop military transport, about 30 m long with a 38 m wingspan, in grey with light grime and exhaust soot. A high wing with six-blade propellers, an upswept tail with a rear loading ramp, main gear in fuselage side fairings and a glazed flight deck.

models.name: Military Utility Vehicle
models.description: Generic armoured 4x4 light utility vehicle, about 4.9 m long and 2.3 m wide. Desert tan with flat armour plates, small thick windows, four doors, a roof ring mount without a weapon and big off-road tyres, dusty from the sills down. The cab has a full interior.

models.name: Minimal Line Art Print
models.description: A minimal print of a face drawn in one continuous black line over a terracotta circle, on off white paper, 50 by 70 cm. Slim black frame with a white bevel cut mat and glass.

models.name: Hydraulic Mining Shovel
models.description: Hydraulic front shovel on crawlers for open pit mining, about 20 m long and 11 m tall parked, reaching about 20 m high at full lift. Weathered white house and boom on grey crawlers, with walkways, a raised cab and a toothed bottom dump bucket, dusty from loading ore.

models.name: Mixed Tenant Block
models.description: 6-storey corner building of small bars and offices, 11 x 10 m and 27 m tall to the rooftop billboard. Mosaic-tiled fronts meet at a chamfered corner stacked with blank lit sign boxes, above bar fronts, a narrow lift lobby and steel balconies, with a water tank and billboard frame on the roof.

models.name: Mobile Crane
models.description: Generic four-axle all-terrain mobile crane, about 12.4 m long, 2.7 m wide and 3.9 m tall in travel position. Yellow telescopic boom and slewing upper on a dark grey carrier, with outriggers, two cabs and a hook block, worn from road travel and site lifts.

models.name: Bull Moose
models.description: Adult bull moose, 2.0 m at the shoulder and 2.9 m long, with palmate antlers. Dark brown coat, pale grey-brown legs, humped withers, overhanging muzzle and bell. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1.5 m/s walking and 4 m/s trotting.

models.name: Moose Warning Sign
models.description: Nordic moose warning sign, a 90 cm triangle on a 2.3 m galvanized post. Red border, yellow reflective field and a black moose silhouette, no text, on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back.

models.name: Moss Tufts
models.description: Set of five low, lumpy moss cushions from 10 to 35 cm across, as one model. Dense fine shoots in slightly varied greens with a few browned spots, for tucking onto rocks, roots, walls and roof edges.

models.name: Mossy Granite Rocks
models.description: Group of three weathered granite stones, about 25, 45 and 70 cm across, with moss cushions on top and lichen on the sides. One mesh with the origin on the ground at the centre of the group; the stones sit a few centimetres into the ground.

models.name: Motor Scooter
models.description: Generic 125 cc city scooter, 1.8 m long. Coral red with cream trim, a rounded leg-shield apron, flat ribbed floorboard, two-up seat, 12-inch wheels and a top box whose lid opens, with light everyday wear.

models.name: Motorhome
models.description: Class A motorhome, 11 m long and 3.9 m tall, with a big split windscreen and rear dual wheels. Cream fiberglass with a charcoal and copper swept stripe, a door-side roll-up awning and a simple lived-in interior, light road grime.

models.name: Mountain Horizon Ring
models.description: 360-degree ring of distant mountains for the horizon, built for a 2 km radius. Three silhouette layers (forested near ranges, snowy middle peaks, pale far peaks) with baked aerial perspective and lighting. Rotate it so its baked sun matches the scene's.

models.name: Mountain Bicycle
models.description: Full suspension mountain bicycle with 29 inch knobbly tyres, 1.9 m long. Orange frame with an air shock, gold fork stanchions, disc brakes, a single ring drivetrain with a real chain, a wide riser bar and flat pedals, lightly dusty from the trail.

models.name: Mountain Hare
models.description: Mountain hare in its grey-brown summer coat, 0.55 m long. Long black-tipped ears, big hind feet and a white tail, sitting upright at rest. The hop plays in place: move it at 4 m/s.

models.name: Alpine Mountain Peak
models.description: Mid-distance alpine peak, about 3.2 km across and 720 m high, for the view beyond the trees. Eroded ridges and gullies, scree fans, rock bands, a snowcap and forested lower slopes. Meant to be seen from 1 to 5 km.

models.name: Forested Mountain Ridge
models.description: Mid-distance mountain ridge, about 4 km long, 1.9 km deep and 440 m high. A rocky crest with several summits, eroded spurs and gullies, scree, and forest over the lower two thirds. Meant to be seen from 1 to 5 km.

models.name: Multideck Dairy Chiller
models.description: An open supermarket multideck chiller 3.75 m long and 2.05 m tall, with five stepped decks of unbranded milk, cartons, yogurts and butter. White end panels, a black interior and LED strips under every shelf and the canopy that glow in the dark.

models.name: Muscle Car
models.description: Generic late 1960s V8 muscle car fastback, 4.75 m long and 1.90 m wide, in deep red with twin white stripes. A wide body with a long bonnet and scoop, a sloping fastback roof, chrome bumpers and dark five-spoke wheels.

models.name: Museum Arch Bay Wall
models.description: A pale limestone museum wall bay 6 m wide and 8 m tall with a round arch 3.6 m wide. Half pilasters at each end, a moulded architrave and a dentil cornice run through so bays join into a continuous arcade.

models.name: Museum Coffered Vault
models.description: A coffered barrel vault module 6 m long and 5.4 m wide in pale plaster, with a gilded rosette in every coffer. Modules join end to end into a continuous vaulted ceiling.

models.name: Museum Fluted Column
models.description: A free standing fluted marble column 8 m tall on a square limestone plinth. It carries a plain block at the top to meet a cornice or vault springing.

models.name: Museum Grand Stair
models.description: A 6 m wide marble grand stair rising 3 m in 18 steps between limestone cheek walls. Vase balusters carry a rounded marble handrail between newel pedestals topped with finials.

models.name: Museum Info Lectern
models.description: A black information stand about 1.1 m tall, with a blank 60 by 42 cm panel sloped toward the reader on a slim post and floor plate.

models.name: Museum Marble Floor Tile
models.description: A 6 by 6 m polished white marble floor tile with small dark green diamond inlays, 10 cm thick. The pattern repeats every 3 m, so tiles join without a seam.

models.name: Twin-Jet Airliner
