models.description: Modern single-aisle twin-jet airliner, about 38 m long with a 35 m wingspan. White with a plain grey belly, a dark blue cheatline and tail, swept wings with blended winglets and two underwing turbofans. Shipped with the gear down.

models.name: Neon Alley Bar Front with Green Tile
models.description: A 5 m two-storey front of two small bars, about 6 m tall and 1.4 m deep, one with a green tiled ground floor and one in timber, under a pale plaster upper floor with AC units and ducts. Lanterns, noren curtains and blank signs glow at night. Lines up on the alley's 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Bar Front with Plaster Upper Floor
models.description: A 5 m two-storey front of two small bars, about 6 m tall and 1.4 m deep, with timber and tile ground floors, sliding lattice doors and a tin pent roof under a stained plaster upper floor. Lanterns, noren curtains and blank signs glow at night. Lines up on the alley's 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Bar Front, Plaster and Tin
models.description: A 5 m two-storey front of two small bars, about 5.7 m wide with its end trim, 6 m tall and 1.4 m deep. Red timber and tile ground floors, one plaster and one corrugated tin upper floor. Lanterns, noren curtains and blank signs glow at night. Lines up on the alley's 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Bar Front with Tin Upper Floor
models.description: A 5 m two-storey front of two small bars, about 6 m tall and 1.4 m deep, with red and plain timber ground floors, sliding lattice doors and a corrugated tin upper floor with crates and meters. Lanterns, noren curtains and blank signs glow at night. Lines up on the alley's 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Covered End
models.description: A 5 m covered end for a narrow drinking alley: translucent corrugated roofing on beams bracketed to the walls, with tube lights, a lantern string and a lit blank gate sign at the open end. About 5.2 m wide.

models.name: Neon Alley Floor
models.description: A 5 x 2.6 m concrete floor slab for a narrow drinking alley, with a steel grated drain down the middle. Stained and worn; tiles along the alley on its 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Floor with Access Cover
models.description: A 5 x 2.6 m concrete floor slab for a narrow drinking alley, with a grated drain down the middle and a square cast-iron access cover beside it. Stained and worn; tiles on the 5 m module.

models.name: Neon Alley Kit
models.description: Narrow drinking-alley kit on a 5 m module: four two-storey bar fronts, two alley floor pieces and a covered end with a lit gate sign. Timber, tile and stained plaster with tin pent roofs, red lanterns, noren curtains, meters, ducts and blank lit signs that glow at night.

models.name: Nested Shopping Trolley Row
models.description: Row of five wire shopping trolleys nested into each other, about 2.1 m long. Chrome tube frames and mesh baskets with red grips and bumpers on grey casters.

models.name: Stinging Nettle Clump
models.description: Clump of stinging nettles 60 to 90 cm tall, about 50 cm across. Upright stems carry pairs of dark green, coarsely toothed heart-shaped leaves, with drooping green flower tassels in the upper leaf joints and a few yellowing, nibbled leaves low down.

models.name: Newsstand Kiosk
models.description: Dark green steel newsstand kiosk, 3.0 x 1.5 m and 2.5 m tall, with its roll-up shutter half open. Racks of plain magazines inside and on the side walls, newspaper stacks on the counter and a lit blank fascia strip under the roof edge.

models.name: Nightstand
models.description: Bedside table in light oak, 0.48 m wide and 0.52 m tall, in a plain modern style. A box on four slim tapered legs with one drawer and a short black bar pull above a small open shelf.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: No Entry Sign
models.description: Round no-entry sign, 64 cm across, on a 2.3 m galvanized post. Red reflective disc with a white bar and a thin white edge, on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back.

models.name: No Overtaking Sign
models.description: Round no overtaking sign, 60 cm across, on a 2.6 m galvanized post. A red ring on white reflective sheeting with a red and a black car seen from behind, an aluminium blank with a rolled edge and riveted rails on the back.

models.name: No Parking Sign
models.description: Round no parking sign, 60 cm across, on a 2.6 m galvanized post. A blue disc with a red ring and one red diagonal bar, weathered, with torn sticker residue on the face.

models.name: Non-step City Bus
models.description: Two-axle low-floor city bus, 11.0 m long, 2.49 m wide and 3.05 m tall, built for left-side kerbs. Cream with a dark green skirt and a lime stripe, a blank lit destination panel front, side and rear, and three doors: a folding front door and two sliding doors.

models.name: Non-Stick Frying Pan
models.description: Black non-stick frying pan 28 cm across with a steel handle and a black grip, about 46 cm long overall.

models.name: Robot Noodle Kiosk
models.description: A red street food kiosk where a robot arm cooks noodles behind an open counter with stools. Lit glyph signs, paper lanterns, a rooftop tank and wet, grimy paint.

models.name: Noodle Shop
models.description: Narrow two-storey noodle shop, 4.6 m wide, 10 m deep and 6.5 m tall. A dark timber front with a lattice window, curtained sliding door, ticket machine nook and a tiled pent roof under lit blank signs; the counter and stools glow inside, with a tiled flat above.

models.name: Nordic House Wall
models.description: Wall piece for a red Nordic wooden house, 2 m wide and 2.8 m tall: red board-and-batten outside and pale painted panelling inside. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Nordic House Door Wall
models.description: Wall piece 2 m wide and 2.8 m tall with a green panel door that opens, red board-and-batten outside and pale panelling inside. Snaps on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Nordic House Half Wall
models.description: Narrow wall piece 1 m wide and 2.8 m tall for a red Nordic wooden house, red board-and-batten outside and pale panelling inside. Fills half a 2 m grid bay.

models.name: Nordic House Window Wall
models.description: Wall piece 2 m wide and 2.8 m tall with a white-framed two-pane glazed window, red board-and-batten outside and pale panelling inside. Snaps on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Norway Spruce
models.description: Mature roadside Norway spruce, about 20 m tall, with drooping branchlets and needle spray cards.

models.name: Nursery Pots with Seedlings
models.description: Three small black plastic nursery pots with young seedlings, together about 0.3 m across and 0.25 m tall. Dusty plastic and dark soil, for a doorstep or plant shelf.

models.name: Nutcracker Soldier
models.description: A traditional turned and painted wooden nutcracker soldier, 38 cm tall. Glossy red tunic with gold frogging, black shako, white fur hair and beard, rosy cheeks and a sword at his side, with small paint chips showing pale wood.

models.name: Oak Coat Hook Rail
models.description: Oak coat hook rail 0.9 m long with five black double hooks, for hallways and entrances.

models.name: Oak Floor Panel with Stair Opening
models.description: A 2 x 2 m oiled oak floor panel on a 0.2 m slab with a 1 x 2 m opening for a stairwell. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Oak-Framed Abstract Print
models.description: Abstract art print in a thin oak frame with a white mount, 50 x 70 cm, for hanging on a living room or bedroom wall.

models.name: Oak Interior Staircase
models.description: Straight house staircase rising one 2.8 m storey in a 1 by 4 m footprint, with oiled oak treads on white painted strings and risers, square balusters, newel posts and an oak handrail. Snaps to a 2 m grid.

models.name: Oak Kitchen Open Shelf
models.description: Open solid oak shelf unit 0.6 m wide and 0.72 m tall for a kitchen wall, hung with its underside at 1.45 m. Holds four glass storage jars with oak lids, a stack of plates and two mugs.

models.name: Oak Landing Balustrade
models.description: Landing balustrade 2 m long and about 1.1 m tall with square white balusters, newel posts and an oak handrail. Guards a stair opening on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Oak Plank Bench
models.description: A plain oak plank bench 3 m long and 46 cm high on two shaped trestle ends.

models.name: Oak Throne
models.description: A high-backed throne of polished oak 2.15 m tall with crimson cushions on the seat and back. Turned brass finials crown the back posts.

models.name: Oak Trestle Table
models.description: A long oak trestle table 3.4 m by 0.9 m and 76 cm high, with a linen runner down its length hanging over both ends.

models.name: Office Chair
models.description: Black office swivel chair with a mesh back, a padded seat at 49 cm and armrests, on a five-star base with twin-wheel castors. The whole seat turns on the base.

models.name: Office Desk
models.description: White office desk, 1.4 x 0.7 m and 74 cm high, on black steel frame legs. Set up with a monitor, a keyboard and mouse, a blue ceramic mug and a black desk lamp. The monitor's blank screen is a separate mesh, ready for an image or video.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Office Desk Phone
models.description: A charcoal office desk phone, 20 by 19 cm, with the handset in its cradle on a coiled cord. A sloped deck holds a keypad, function keys, a blank screen and a message light.

models.name: Office Floor Shell
models.description: Open-plan office floor, 24 x 16 m with a 3.6 m storey, wrapped in a glass curtain wall with a few blinds down. A central core holds two lifts with stainless doors, a stair door and two WC doors. Grey carpet tiles, a tiled lift lobby, round columns and a lit tile ceiling at 3 m.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Office Laser Printer
models.description: A light grey office laser printer, 40 by 36 cm and 24 cm tall. Two blank printed sheets lie in the sloped output tray above a paper cassette, beside a small control panel with a blank screen.

models.name: Office Tower
models.description: Modern 15-storey slab office tower, 46 x 24 m at the base and 71 m tall to the mast tip. Pale precast concrete bands with blue-grey ribbon windows wrap the corners of a 40 x 18 m slab over a glazed two-storey podium with a canopied entrance, rooftop plant and lit offices at night.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Off-Road 4x4
models.description: Generic two-door off-roader, 4.2 m long, with a boxy steel body on solid axles and chunky mud-terrain tyres. Sand-beige paint with mud thrown up the sides, steel bumpers with a winch, a snorkel and a roof rack with jerry cans.

models.name: Ogon Koi
models.description: A single koi carp about 0.6 m long, its body bent mid-stroke. Ogon colouring: one solid metallic gold from snout to tail.

models.name: Oiled Oak Floor Panel
models.description: A 2 x 2 m interior floor panel of oiled oak floorboards on a 0.2 m slab. Warm honey-toned boards with fine grain and light wear. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Old Oak Bucket
models.description: A small wooden bucket of grey oak staves bound with rusty iron hoops, about 0.5 m tall. Stained and worn, for a cell or a well.

models.name: Olive Tree
models.description: Old olive tree, about 6 m tall, with a massive, leaning trunk of pale grey bark, deeply fluted, twisted and split open where it is hollowing. Crooked limbs carry an open crown of small silver-green leaves and a few olives.

models.name: Open Book
models.description: An open hardcover book lying flat, about 31 by 23 cm, with one page lifting off the right side. The pages show blocks of unreadable text and curve down into the gutter.

models.name: Open Clam Shell
models.description: Open clam shell about 10 cm across, both halves lying hinged and flat, with growth rings outside and a pale, glossy inside.

models.name: Open Paint Tin
models.description: An open 2.5 litre paint tin about 17 cm across with a red label band, nearly full of blue paint, its lid leaning against it. Dried paint drips over the rim.

models.name: Open Parchment Scroll
models.description: An unrolled parchment scroll about 20 cm wide with both ends curled. The aged sheet carries lines of invented glyphs.

models.name: Open Spellbook
models.description: An open spellbook 38 cm across, lying flat. Its parchment pages carry invented glyphs and a star diagram, with a red ribbon marker, and the right half folds over to close the book.

models.name: Opened Can of Beans
models.description: A short tin can about 5 cm tall with a plain green label, opened with its jagged lid levered up and full of beans in sauce.

models.name: Operating Theatre
models.description: Operating theatre, 6 x 6 m with a 3.6 m storey, under a laminar-flow ceiling canopy. A surgical lamp on a ceiling arm over the operating table, an anaesthesia machine, instrument and equipment carts and a steel scrub trough, clean and ready for use.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Orange Half
models.description: Half of an orange, 7.7 cm across and 3.7 cm tall, cut face up. Juicy segments radiate from a pale core inside a white pith ring and a dimpled peel.

models.name: Orange Starfish
models.description: Five-armed orange starfish about 22 cm across, lying flat with a bumpy, wet surface. For scattering on seabeds and beaches.

models.name: Orange Tarp Street Tent
models.description: Orange tarp street bar tent, 4.2 x 3 m and 2.7 m tall, draped over a galvanized pipe frame. The cloth sags between the pipes, the side walls have clear vinyl windows and the front is rolled up and tied back.

models.name: Outdoor Back Stretcher
models.description: Park back stretcher about 1.8 m long and 1.1 m tall, a curved bench to lie back over. Blue and yellow powder-coated steel, bolted down, scuffed and chipped from use.

models.name: Outdoor Exercise Set
models.description: Four blue and yellow outdoor fitness machines, as found in East Asian parks. A waist twister, a leg swing, a back stretcher and a shoulder wheel in powder-coated steel, bolted to the ground, scuffed and chipped from use.

models.name: Outdoor Leg Swing
models.description: Park leg swing about 1.7 m tall with two pendulum foot swings hung from a frame with handles. Blue and yellow powder-coated steel, bolted down, scuffed and chipped.

models.name: Outdoor Shoulder Wheel
models.description: Park shoulder wheel about 1.9 m tall with two hand wheels that turn on a steel post. Blue and yellow powder-coated steel, bolted down, scuffed and chipped.

models.name: Outdoor Waist Twister
models.description: Park waist twister about 1.5 m tall: two turning foot discs beside a handle bar. Blue and yellow powder-coated steel bolted to the ground, scuffed and chipped from use.

models.name: Outhouse
models.description: Small Nordic outhouse, 1.2 x 1.4 m, with a heart cut out of the door. Red boards, white trims, a green tin shed roof, a tiny vent window and a fieldstone plinth. The door opens onto a dark interior with a plank seat.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Oval-Cut Ruby
models.description: Oval-cut ruby about 3 cm long with real flat facets and a clear red refractive material that deepens through the thicker parts of the stone.

models.name: Over-Ear Headphones
models.description: Closed-back over-ear headphones about 25 cm across, lying on their side on the desk. Matte black cups with brushed aluminium backs, soft fabric ear pads, silver yokes and steel sliders, and a stitched black leather headband, with a detachable cable coiled loosely beside them.

models.name: Overgrown Temple Gate
models.description: Overgrown stone temple gateway, 7 m tall and 8 m wide, with a corbelled arch and a heavy carved slab door that slides down into the floor. Massive weathered limestone blocks, carved relief panels, a stylised stone face above the arch, moss, roots and vines.

models.name: Overhead Power Line Span
models.description: Three bare aluminium conductors sagging 0.8 m over a 40 m span, with vibration dampers near both ends. It hangs from the wire points of the wooden transformer pole.

models.name: Overland Conveyor Incline
models.description: Inclined 12 m run of overland belt conveyor rising 2 m on graded steel trestles, troughed belt carrying ore, grated walkway with handrails, pull wire, cable tray and a light pole. Snaps to the straight run.

models.name: Overland Conveyor Straight
models.description: Straight 12 m run of overland belt conveyor on steel trestles, a troughed belt loaded with ore on idlers, a grated walkway with handrails, a pull wire, cable tray and a light pole. Faded paint and ore dust.

models.name: Padel Ball
models.description: Padel ball, 6.5 cm across, in optic yellow felt with a white curved rubber seam. Fuzzy felt with a soft sheen, light wear patches and a sunk seam. Origin on the ground under the ball; the centre of the ball is 0.0325 m above it.

models.name: Padel Court
models.description: Full padel court, 20 x 10 m, with its net and glass and mesh enclosure. Blue sand-filled turf with white lines, 3 m glass back walls topped with black mesh, glass and mesh side walls on a black steel frame, and one opening in each side wall.

models.name: Padel Racket
models.description: Padel racket, 45.5 cm long, lying flat. A bright orange teardrop head with a perforated face and a dark carbon rim, a white overgrip, a black butt cap, an open heart in the throat and a wrist strap in a loop.

models.name: Paint Bucket
models.description: A 10 litre white plastic paint bucket with a blue band, its lid on and a wire handle, about 30 cm across. Dried paint runs down its sides.

models.name: Paint Roller
models.description: A 23 cm paint roller with a wire frame and an orange plastic handle, its nap soaked in blue paint.

models.name: Paint Tray
models.description: A grey plastic paint roller tray about 40 cm long with a pool of blue paint in its well.

models.name: Painted Blossom Manhole Cover
models.description: Round cast iron manhole cover about 0.7 m across with a raised blossom and wave pattern and worn coloured paint in the recesses. Sits flush in the street.

models.name: Painted Terracotta Amphora
models.description: An ancient style two-handled terracotta amphora, 62 cm tall. Black glaze paints a frieze of long-necked birds, rays, zigzags and tongues on the red clay, worn and chipped with age.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Kit
models.description: Sharpened log palisade pieces on a 4 m module, 3.4 m tall: straight, corner, a gate with two log doors, a raised walkway with a ladder and a square log watchtower with a shingled roof. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails.

models.name: Pallet Crop Planter
models.description: A raised bed of pallet boards growing cabbages, leafy greens and beans on a stick trellis. A cut jerry can and a trowel sit beside it.

models.name: Pallet Racking
models.description: Three bay steel pallet rack, about 8.3 m long, 1.2 m deep and 5 m tall, with three beam levels. Blue slotted uprights, orange beams, galvanized wire decks and yellow and black end protectors, plus stretch wrapped carton loads on euro pallets as separate objects.

models.name: Paper Lantern String
models.description: Strings of red and white paper lanterns on a sagging cord, 3.6 to 4.8 m long, plus one big red lantern 1.3 m tall. Ribbed paper with black lacquered rims and plain blank faces, lit from inside at night. Each string ends in a hook and a ring so strings chain together.

models.name: Park Bench
models.description: Wooden park bench, 1.8 m long with the seat at 0.45 m. Five weathered seat slats and three back slats bolted to two black cast-iron side frames with armrests, joined by a steel tie bar.

models.name: Multi-Storey Car Park
models.description: Open concrete multi-storey car park, 40 x 30 m, with four parking levels up to a roof deck 9 m high. Precast spandrels wrap the decks, straight ramps stack in a walled strip, two green-clad stair cores stand at the back and an entry with lifting barriers sits at the front right.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Single-Space Parking Meter
models.description: Coin and card parking meter on a 1.2 m steel post, 1.6 m tall. A blue arched head with a dome window over a blank display sits on a grey coin vault with a round lock and a faded sticker. Paint is chipped at the edges and grimy at the foot.

models.name: Parking Pay Station
models.description: Kiosk ticket machine for a car park or street, 1.7 m tall on a concrete pad, with a small solar panel on top. Grey cabinet with a black front: a blank colour screen, keypad, card and coin slots, a pictogram panel and a ticket outlet, above a hinged service door.

models.name: Parking Sign
models.description: Square parking sign, 60 cm, on a 2.3 m galvanized post. Blue reflective field with a white edge and a bold white P, on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back.

models.name: Passenger Coach
models.description: A 26 m intercity passenger coach with a light grey body, a blue stripe and doors, a dark window band and a seated saloon inside, on two air-sprung bogies. Standard gauge; its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Pastoral Landscape Oil Painting
models.description: A pastoral landscape oil painting, 100 by 70 cm, in a carved dark walnut frame with a gilt inner slip. Rolling hills, a stand of trees and a stream lie under a big luminous sky.

models.name: Pastry Display Case
models.description: Countertop pastry display case, 0.9 m wide, with a curved glass front, holding golden croissants and muffins on two levels. Sized for a cafe or bakery counter.

models.name: Pear-Cut Amethyst
models.description: Pear-cut amethyst about 4 cm long with real flat facets and a clear purple refractive material that deepens through the thicker parts of the stone.

models.name: Pedestal Washbasin
models.description: A 0.55 m white glazed ceramic washbasin on a full pedestal, 0.85 m to the rim. It has a chrome single lever mixer tap, a pop-up waste and an overflow slot, with the chrome bottle trap tucked behind the pedestal.

models.name: Pedestrian Crossing Sign
models.description: Square pedestrian crossing sign, 60 cm wide, on a 2.6 m galvanized post. A white triangle with a walking figure over zebra stripes on a blue field, with a scrap of an old sticker in one corner.

models.name: Pedestrian Guardrail
models.description: Modular kerbside pedestrian railing in white painted steel pipe, 0.8 m tall: a 2 m straight panel, a corner and an end post, plus a white bollard with a red reflective band. Flat bars below and a row of rings above the mid rail, paint chipped to rust and grey with road spray.

models.name: Pedestrian Guardrail Corner
models.description: A corner post of kerbside pedestrian railing in white painted steel pipe, 0.8 m tall, with a 1 m return panel. The paint is chipped to rust and grey with road spray. It joins the matching straight panels.

models.name: Pedestrian Guardrail End Post
models.description: An end post that closes a run of kerbside pedestrian railing, in white painted steel pipe, 0.9 m tall. The paint is chipped to rust and grey with road spray.

models.name: Pedestrian Guardrail Straight
models.description: A 2 m straight panel of kerbside pedestrian railing in white painted steel pipe, 0.8 m tall, with flat bars below and a row of rings above the mid rail. The paint is chipped to rust and grey with road spray.

models.name: Pedestrian Overpass
models.description: Steel pedestrian footbridge over a four-lane city road, 22 m long with 4.6 m clearance. Pale green painted panels with blank blue sign boards, stairs with a mid landing at both ends on round columns, yellow stair nosings and LED lights under the deck that glow at night.

models.name: Pegboard
models.description: A 61 cm square hardboard pegboard panel with hooks and small parts bins. Brown board drilled on a 25 mm grid, scuffed and stained with grime.

models.name: Pencil Building
models.description: Narrow 9-storey multi-tenant city building, 6 m wide, 12 m deep and 35 m tall to the mast. A tiled front with one frosted window band per floor carries a stack of blank lit sign boxes, with a shop and lift lobby below and a steel fire stair with AC units down one side.

models.name: Pepperoni Pizza
models.description: A 30 cm pepperoni pizza on a round wooden serving board with a handle. The puffy crust is leopard charred and the melted cheese has browned blisters under cupped pepperoni and basil. One slice is cut and pulled out a little.

models.name: Persian-Style Wool Rug
models.description: A 2 x 3 m hand-knotted style wool rug with a central medallion, a field of small flowers and several border bands in deep red, navy and ivory. Knotted warp fringes at both ends, a short pile worn a little in the middle and one corner lifting.

models.name: Personal Watercraft
models.description: Sit-down personal watercraft 3.3 m long for a rider and a passenger. Bright yellow deck over a dark grey deep-V hull, a padded black seat, foam mats in the footwells, a small visor over the handlebars and a boarding platform with a fold-down step at the stern.

models.name: Petri Dish Stack
models.description: A stack of three empty glass petri dishes with their lids on, 9 cm across and 5 cm tall.

models.name: Pewter Goblet of Wine
models.description: A pewter goblet 18 cm tall on a knopped stem, filled with dark red wine.

models.name: Pewter Plate
models.description: A plain pewter dinner plate 26 cm across with a broad rim. Its origin is on its underside, ready to set on a table.

models.name: Photo ID Access Card
models.description: An 86 x 54 mm access card with a printed photo, a gold chip and a small green light. A keycard pickup for security doors.

models.name: Crew-Cab Pickup
models.description: Generic mid-size four-door pickup truck, 5.30 m long and 1.90 m wide, in plain white. A tall flat bonnet, crew cab, open load bed, step bumper, black fender flares and 17 inch all-terrain tires. Wheels, steering wheel and tailgate move.

models.name: Weathered Picnic Table
models.description: Wooden picnic table with attached benches, 1.8 m long and 1.5 m wide. Grey weathered boards on splayed A-frame legs, with drying checks, cupped boards, mildewed ends, cup rings and rusty nail and bolt heads.

models.name: Pig
models.description: Pink farm pig, 0.72 m at the shoulder and 1.5 m long. Sparse pale bristles over pink skin, upright ears, a flat snout, a curly tail and mud caked on the legs and belly. Walk plays in place: move it at 1 m/s.

models.name: Pine Bread Board
models.description: Pine cutting board about 43 by 33 cm with worn knife marks. A plain kitchen board for bread and cheese.

models.name: Pine Supply Crate
models.description: Pine supply crate about 60 cm on each side: pale planks in nailed, braced frames, black steel angle irons on the edges and red stencilled arrows and marks.

models.name: Broken Pine Supply Crate
models.description: The 60 cm pine supply crate pre-broken into 15 loose pieces that fit together, ready to fly apart. Splintered, freshly torn pine with black angle irons and red stencils.

models.name: Pink Iced Donut
models.description: A ring donut with pink icing, 9 cm across and 3 cm tall. The glossy icing has a rounded edge and short drips over the golden dough and its pale fried band.

models.name: Pintail Longboard
models.description: A pintail longboard 1 m long and 24 cm wide, standing on its wheels. Flat maple deck with black grip, wide black trucks with red bushings and soft orange wheels.

models.name: Black Piste Marker
models.description: Black piste marker pole, 2 m tall, with a fluorescent orange band near the top, standing in a small heap of snow.

models.name: Blue Piste Marker
models.description: Blue piste marker pole, 2 m tall, with a fluorescent orange band near the top, standing in a small heap of snow.

models.name: Red Piste Marker
models.description: Red piste marker pole, 2 m tall, with a fluorescent orange band near the top, standing in a small heap of snow.

models.name: Pit Crew Member
models.description: Pit crew mechanic, 1.8 m tall, in a fire-resistant overall, full-face helmet with a dark visor, gloves and shoes. The overall is deep blue with white panels to match the formula car. Rigged and animated; the walk clip is made for 1.3 m/s.

models.name: Pit Lane Gantry
models.description: Overhead pit box gantry, a 6 m steel arm at about 4.3 m on a post at the garage front. A dark arm with deep blue side plates carries an LED light bar, an air hose reel and looping cables, and a red and green release light hangs from its tip. The lamps can be switched separately.

models.name: Pit Garage Block
models.description: Modern pit building section, one 12 m garage bay, 15 m deep and 9 m tall. Grey composite panels, a roll-up door onto a lit garage with tool cabinets, a blank sign band and a glazed upper floor with a balcony over the pit lane. Bays tile every 12 m into a pit row.

models.name: Front Pit Jack
models.description: Front pit stop jack, 1.75 m long: a blue lever on two small wheels with a foam T-handle and a curved rubber-padded cradle. It rests with the handle on the ground and the cradle raised; raise the handle about 25 degrees to lower the cradle under a car's nose.

models.name: Pit Wall Section
models.description: Six-metre section of a concrete pit wall, 1.1 m high, with a roofed team stand. A painted wall with rubber marks, a steel grating deck with stairs, a desk with three stools and six blank monitors, under a flat canopy with a plain fascia. Sections tile every 6 m.

models.name: Pitcher Plant Clump
models.description: A clump of carnivorous pitcher plants about 0.7 m tall. Tall trumpet pitchers veined in red stand under hooded lids, with two nodding flowers on long stems.

models.name: Wood-Fired Pizza Oven
models.description: A restaurant wood-fired pizza oven, about 2.8 m tall to its flue cap. A brick dome sits on a brick base with a wood store and a stone landing. Soot blackens the arch over the mouth, the hearth holds ash and glowing embers, and a steel door hangs beside it.

models.name: Pizza Peel
models.description: A pizza peel, about 1.6 m long, standing upright on the end of its handle. A rounded aluminium blade with a greasy, scratched sheen on a long turned wooden handle.

models.name: Plane Tree
models.description: Mature street plane tree, about 22 m tall, with a tall, clear trunk of flaking bark mottled grey, olive and cream. Wide, slightly crooked limbs carry a broad, domed crown of large, maple-like leaves and bristly seed balls hanging on long stalks.

models.name: Six-Wheel Planetary Rover
models.description: A six-wheel science rover about 3 m long, on rocker-bogie suspension. A chamfered body with instrument boxes and cable runs on the deck, a camera mast, a folded arm with a tool turret, a finned power unit and a dish antenna; white and gold, coated in rusty dust.

models.name: Plank Plant Shelf
models.description: A low plant shelf made of a weathered grey plank laid on two concrete blocks, about 1.3 m long and 0.2 m high. Pots stand on it to keep them off the ground.

models.name: Plasma Pistol
models.description: Compact plasma pistol, about 24 cm long, an original sci-fi design. A layered off-white shell over a gunmetal frame with side plates and slanted vents, a stippled grip, glowing coil rings along an open barrel, a flared emitter, a segmented charge strip and a removable power cell.

models.name: Plasma Rifle
models.description: Bullpup plasma rifle, about 80 cm long. A layered composite shell over an alloy chassis with a cheek rest, rubber buttpad and louvred vents, a finned heat sink with glowing coils, a slotted emitter shroud, a side-mounted power cell, a holographic sight and an angled foregrip.

models.name: White Plaster Ceiling Panel
models.description: A flat 2 x 2 m interior ceiling panel in smooth warm white plaster. Sits 2.8 m up, on a 2 m grid with the house kits.

models.name: Plaster Ceiling Panel with Flush Light
models.description: A 2 x 2 m warm white plaster ceiling panel with a round flush ceiling light in the middle that can glow. Sits 2.8 m up, on a 2 m grid with the house kits.

models.name: Plaster Wall Lining 2 m
models.description: Thin plaster lining 2 m long and 2.8 m tall that gives the inside of an outer house wall a warm white finish with white skirting. Fits the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Plaster Window Lining 2 m
models.description: Plaster lining 2 m long and 2.8 m tall for the inside of an outer house wall with a window: plastered reveals, a windowsill and white skirting. Fits the house kit windows on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Plate Armour Stand
models.description: A wooden armour stand 1.6 m tall carrying a polished steel breastplate. The plate has a ridged front, riveted shoulder guards and stepped hip lames under a leather belt, with worn bright edges and dark seams.

models.name: Playground Rubber Safety Floor
models.description: An 8 x 6 m playground floor of square rubber safety tiles, mostly green with blue and red fall zones, inside a low concrete kerb. Worn and faded from sun and play.

models.name: Playground Seesaw
models.description: A two-seat seesaw about 3.1 m long on a green steel pivot post, with red seats, blue handles and a yellow beam that tilts. Powder-coated steel and plastic, sun-faded and scuffed, with rubber bump stops under each end.

models.name: Playground Slide Tower
models.description: A children's play tower with a pyramid roof, stairs, a ladder, a climbing wall and a wide slide, about 3.4 x 4.9 m and 3.6 m tall. Bright powder-coated steel and plastic in green, yellow and red, sun-faded and scuffed.

models.name: Two-Seat Playground Swing
models.description: A steel A-frame swing with two rubber seats on chains, about 3.9 m wide and 2.5 m tall. Green powder-coated legs and a yellow top beam, sun-faded and scuffed; each seat swings on its own.

models.name: Plaza Table and Chairs
models.description: Round red metal bistro table, 0.61 m across, with three folding chairs, as set out in pedestrian plazas. Powder-coated steel with perforated tops and seats, chipped at the edges and polished where people sit. Each chair can be moved on its own.

models.name: Reversible Plough
models.description: Five-furrow reversible mounted plough, 6.6 m long and 2.5 m wide, for a tractor's three-point hitch. Grey frame and headstock, polished mouldboards with soil on them, a rear depth wheel and a turnover shaft that swaps the working and the upper set of bodies.

models.name: Plywood Site Hoarding Panel
models.description: Painted plywood construction hoarding 2.4 m long and about 2.5 m tall, blank green boards on timber framing with braces behind, scuffs and mud splash. Pieces line up end to end.

models.name: Pedestrian Barricade Set
models.description: Two crowd control barriers for street events: a 2.4 m galvanized steel barrier on bridge feet with hooks for chaining, and a blue painted wooden sawhorse barrier with a plank on two leg stands. Both are plain, with chipped paint and street grime.

models.name: Police Patrol Car
models.description: Generic four-door police patrol saloon, 5.05 m long and 1.87 m wide. White paint with a plain blue and yellow block pattern along the sides, a blue roof light bar and a black push bar, with no text or crests.

models.name: Police Station
models.description: Two storey police station, 30 x 18 m and 8.7 m tall, with a secure garage and a drive-through sally port. Dark brick below light precast panels, a glazed entrance under a canopy flanked by blue lamps, roller shutters, a fenced yard with a sliding gate and a lattice antenna mast on the roof.

models.name: Grey Porcelain Tile Floor Panel
models.description: A 2 x 2 m interior floor panel of large grey porcelain tiles with thin grout lines, on a 0.2 m slab. For kitchens, halls and bathrooms. Snaps to the house kits on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Porcini Mushroom
models.description: A single porcini mushroom 15 cm tall with a bun shaped chestnut brown cap and a fat club stem. The cap has a soft greasy sheen and a pale rim, the stem a fine white net, with a little soil and two dry pine needles at its foot.

models.name: Dungeon Portcullis and Door
models.description: Iron portcullis, 2 x 3 m with spiked feet, in a dressed limestone arch frame, plus a heavy oak door for the same round-arched opening. The door has black iron strap hinges, studs, a ring pull and a barred peep window. Both fit the arched wall of the dungeon wall kit.

models.name: Potato Plant
models.description: Hilled potato mound about 85 cm long with leafy stems 60 cm tall. Small pale violet flowers top the stems and a few potatoes show at the soil.

models.name: Potted Alley Plants
models.description: Potted plants for the front of a city house, up to 0.9 m tall, as ten separate pieces. Pruned pines in glazed pots, foam boxes of spring onions and herbs, a red geranium, broad-leaf greenery, nursery pots, a plank shelf on blocks, stacked clay pots and a watering can.

models.name: Potted Aspidistra
models.description: A broad-leaf aspidistra in a dark weathered pot, about 0.9 m tall and 0.8 m across. Glossy dark green blades with a few dry brown leaves, for a house front or alley.

models.name: Potted Houseplant
models.description: Large leafy houseplant, 1.2 m tall, in a matt terracotta pot on a saucer. Glossy dark green split leaves on long arching stems, with a couple of young unsplit leaves. Carries wind data for gentle indoor sway.

models.name: Potted Poinsettia
models.description: A potted poinsettia, 45 cm tall, with a dome of deep red bracts over green lobed leaves and small yellow flower clusters at the centres. The pot is wrapped in crumpled gold foil.

models.name: Large Potted Pruned Pine
models.description: A cloud-pruned pine in a deep blue glazed pot, about 0.9 m tall and wide. A twisting trunk with flat pads of needles, the kind kept in front of city houses.

models.name: Small Potted Pruned Pine
models.description: A small cloud-pruned pine in a brown glazed pot, about 0.6 m tall. A bent trunk with flat pads of needles, sized for a plant shelf or doorstep.

models.name: Potted Red Geranium
models.description: A red flowering geranium in a terracotta pot, about 0.5 m tall. Bright red flower heads over round green leaves, for a doorstep, shelf or windowsill.

models.name: Pottery Stall
models.description: A market stall 1.9 m wide stacked with glazed jugs, jars and bowls in earthy greens, browns and blues.

models.name: High-Voltage Pylon
models.description: Galvanized lattice steel transmission tower 45 m tall with three cross-arms a side and an earth-wire peak. Glass disc insulator strings carry twin conductors, and a 60 m span of sagging cable to the next tower is included.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Power Rack
models.description: Black steel power rack, 2.3 m tall, with a loaded 2.2 m Olympic barbell on its J-hooks. Square uprights with hole rows, flat safety bars, a pull-up bar and storage horns holding spare plain black bumper plates.

models.name: Power Strip
models.description: A white five-socket power strip, 33 cm long, with a lit rocker switch. Its cable runs out to a plug.

models.name: Power Tool Battery
models.description: An 18 V slide battery pack for cordless tools, 11.5 cm long. Charcoal body with an orange top, rubber grip ribs and a four light charge gauge.

models.name: Pressed Steel Convector Radiator
models.description: Wall-hung convector radiator about 1.1 m wide and 0.75 m tall: a pressed steel panel with vertical channels in white enamel, a thermostatic valve and pipes to the floor, with dust settled on the top band.

models.name: Stone Pressure Plate
models.description: Ancient trap trigger: a 60 cm carved stone plate set flush in a patch of worn sandstone flags about 1.2 m across. The plate carries a notched ring seal with a dark gap round it; the flags have spalled arrises, mossy joints, and grass and earth at the ragged outer edge.

models.name: Large Prickly Pear Cactus
models.description: Large prickly pear clump about 1.2 m tall, spiny blue-green pads stacked on each other with red fruit along their edges.

models.name: Small Prickly Pear Cactus
models.description: Small prickly pear clump about 0.8 m tall, a few spiny blue-green pads with red fruit on the rims.

models.name: Prickly Pear Set
models.description: Four desert succulents, 0.6 to 1.2 m tall: a large and a small prickly pear clump, an agave rosette and a barrel cactus. Spiny blue-green pads with red fruit, glaucous toothed agave leaves, and a deep-ribbed barrel with hooked red spines and yellow fruit.

models.name: Primary Crusher Plant
models.description: Open pit primary crusher plant: a raised concrete tipping deck where haul trucks back up to a lined dump pocket, a rock breaker, an apron feeder into a jaw crusher with spinning flywheels, a control room, stairs and railings, and a conveyor stub carrying crushed ore out.

models.name: Produce Display
models.description: Supermarket produce stand, 2.4 m long and 1.2 m deep, with three tiers of tilted wooden crates of fruit and vegetables. Blank chalkboard price slates on every crate, a hanging spring scale with a pan and a roll of produce bags on a black top bar.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Propane Gas Cylinder
models.description: 11 kg steel propane cylinder, 0.30 m across and 0.58 m tall. A welded body on a foot ring, with a collar guard around a brass valve and black handwheel. Scuffed red paint with bare steel and rust on the edges, no markings.

models.name: Pruned Garden Pine
models.description: Cloud-pruned garden pine, about 3.5 m tall and 4.5 m wide. A dark, plated trunk twists and leans under flat, layered pads of dark green needle tufts, with the longest low limb held up by a weathered bamboo prop tied on with black rope.

models.name: Public Housing Slab
models.description: 5-storey 1960s-70s concrete public housing slab, 54 m long, 9 m deep and 15 m tall. Weathered painted concrete with balconies of washing and AC units along the front, open stair cores on the back, a blank painted number area on each end wall and a long, low flat-roofed silhouette.

models.name: Pump Oil Can
models.description: A red pump oil can about 12 cm across with a long brass spout and a thumb lever. Chipped paint, rust and oily grime.

models.name: Pump Shotgun
models.description: Pump-action shotgun, about 1.02 m long, an original generic design. Blued steel milled receiver and long barrel with a brass bead over a tubular magazine, a grooved walnut fore-end, a checkered semi-pistol-grip walnut stock with a recoil pad, and a loose red shotshell.

models.name: Pump Water Filter
models.description: A hand pump water filter about 22 cm tall, a blue cartridge between grey end caps with a T handle. Its intake hose loops across the ground to a float.

models.name: Pumpkin Pile
models.description: Harvest pile of nine pumpkins, squashes and gourds, about 1.1 m across and 0.3 m tall. Orange, white and slate-blue pumpkins with a red-orange squash, a dark green acorn squash, a striped squash and two gourds, all with ribbed skin and dried stems.

models.name: Purple Sea Fan
models.description: Flat purple sea fan about 0.95 m wide and tall, a fine lattice of branches spread in one plane to catch the current.

models.name: Aircraft Pushback Tug
models.description: Generic conventional aircraft pushback tug, about 6 m long, 2.9 m wide and 2.9 m tall to the raised cab roof. A low, heavy yellow body on four big tyres with a glazed cab, rubber bumpers and a tow bar for airliners, scuffed and dusty from daily apron work.

models.name: Quad Bike
models.description: Generic utility ATV (quad bike), 2.1 m long and 1.2 m wide. Olive green fenders over black steel front and rear racks, balloon tyres with chevron lugs, twin headlamps and a rear tow hitch, dusty from work.

models.name: Quad-Rotor Recon Drone
models.description: An original quad-rotor recon drone about 1 m across, with a gimbal camera under its body and landing skids. Olive-grey composite shell, dark carbon arms and navigation lights; the rotors and gimbal move.

models.name: Quadruped Robot
models.description: Original four-legged utility robot about 1.1 m long, standing about 0.6 m tall. Matte white body shell with dark grey panels and motor housings, a flat payload deck with mounting rails, a sensor head with camera lenses and a lidar puck, and rubber ball feet.

models.name: Quay Crane Rail Strip
models.description: Strip of crane rail 10 m long set flush in the concrete deck of a container quay. Lays along the quay straights to carry ship-to-shore cranes.

models.name: Quay Wall Inside Corner
models.description: Inside corner for a container port quay, about 12 by 12 m, turning the sheet pile wall and its concrete capping beam through a concave angle. Joins the 10 m straights.

models.name: Quay Wall Outside Corner
models.description: Outside corner for a container port quay, about 10.6 by 10.6 m, with the concrete capping beam, yellow edge line and fenders wrapping a convex angle. Joins the 10 m straights.

models.name: Quay Wall Kit
models.description: A kit of 10 m container port quay pieces: straights, inside and outside corners, a ladder recess, a slipway and a crane rail strip. Pale concrete capping beam with a yellow edge line over weathered steel sheet piles, chain-hung rubber fenders and tee bollards.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Quay Wall Ladder Recess
models.description: Quay section 10 m long with a steel ladder set into a recess in the sheet pile face, under the pale concrete capping beam. Chains with the other 10 m quay pieces.

models.name: Quay Slipway
models.description: Concrete slipway 10 m wide running 23 m down from the quay deck into the water. Weathered concrete that fits between the 10 m quay pieces.

models.name: Quay Wall Straight
models.description: Straight container port quay section 10 m long and about 7 m tall: a pale concrete capping beam with a yellow edge line over weathered steel sheet piles with chain-hung rubber fenders. Chains end to end.

models.name: Quay Wall Straight with Bollard
models.description: Straight quay section 10 m long with a tee mooring bollard on its concrete capping beam, over steel sheet piles with rubber fenders. Chains with the other 10 m quay pieces.

models.name: Race Marshal
models.description: Track marshal, 1.76 m tall, in a bright orange overall with reflective bands, a cap, gloves and work boots. Hands are empty so flags can be added separately. Rigged and animated; the walk clip is made for 1.3 m/s.

models.name: Race Tyre Stack
models.description: Pit-lane stack of four 18 inch slick race tyres on rims, 0.72 m across and 1.32 m tall. Three lie flat and one leans against them. Two wear black quilted tyre blankets with a power cable; the others show bare slick rubber and wheel covers. No markings.

models.name: Radio Mast Camp
models.description: A survivor radio post: a 14 m welded lattice mast held by three sets of guy wires to buried tyre anchors, crowned with whips and a home made beam aerial. A canvas ridge tent shelters the radio table, with a petrol generator on a pallet and cables hung in loops from the mast.

models.name: Rag Rug
models.description: Long woven rag rug, 2.0 x 0.7 m, lying slightly rumpled on the floor. Faded bands of denim blue, rose, cream and mixed hit-and-miss colours, with knotted cotton fringes at both ends.

models.name: Buffer Stop
models.description: Steel buffer stop at the end of an 8 m stub of standard-gauge track. A black frame built from old rail carries a red and white buffer beam with two sprung buffers and a red lamp that glows. Chains onto the end of the straight or curve track.

models.name: Railway Signal
models.description: A two-aspect railway colour light signal about 4.2 m tall on a galvanized lattice post. The black head on a white-bordered backboard shows a green lamp above a red one, both able to glow, with an access ladder and small platform at the back.

models.name: Rail Tank Wagon
models.description: A 12.7 m grey rail tank wagon with a dome, walkway and ladders. It rides on two freight bogies and shows rust, grime and brake dust. Standard gauge; the wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Railway Track, Curve
models.description: A 15 degree bend of standard-gauge railway track at 300 m radius, about 78.5 m long, on concrete sleepers in grey stone ballast. Chains end to end with the straight; it bends left, so lay it the other way round for a right-hand bend.

models.name: Railway Track, Straight
models.description: A 10 m straight of standard-gauge railway track on concrete sleepers in a grey stone ballast bed. Rusty rails with a bright running surface and clip fastenings. Pieces chain end to end with the curve and buffer stop.

models.name: Level Crossing Barrier
models.description: Railway level crossing barrier with a 6 m red and white arm on a grey drive housing. A post beside it carries twin red warning lamps on black backboards under a white St Andrew's cross. The arm swings up and the lamps glow.

models.name: Country Railway Station
models.description: An 18 x 7 m country railway station in red brick with a slate roof and a canopy on cast-iron columns. It has stone dressings, a ticket window, a waiting room with benches, hanging lanterns and a clock. Its forecourt sits at platform height and meets the back of the station platform.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Brick Viaduct Span
models.description: A 20 m span of single-track brick railway viaduct with one round arch, rail 13.5 m above the ground. Sooty red brick with stone string course and coping, iron downpipes and ballasted track at standard gauge. Spans chain end to end, two make a full pier between them.

models.name: Tarp Rain Collector
models.description: A tarp stretched between four guyed poles funnels rain into a drum below. A survivor's water supply for camps and rooftop settlements.

models.name: Rally Car
models.description: Generic compact hatchback rally car, 4.05 m long and 1.82 m wide, in plain white and blue with no sponsor text. It sits high on gravel wheels under wide arches, with a bank of four lamps on the bonnet and mud along its lower body.

models.name: Commercial Range Hood
models.description: A 3 m stainless steel wall canopy hood for a restaurant cooking line, 1.2 m deep with a duct stub on top. Inside, six baffle filters drain into a grease gutter beside sprinkler heads and lights, all browned by years of grease and heat.

models.name: Razor Wire on Pickets
models.description: Concertina coil of razor wire about 3.9 m long and 1.1 m tall held by steel pickets driven into the ground. A perimeter obstacle for field fortifications.

models.name: Reach Stacker
models.description: Heavy container reach stacker about 12.3 m long and 4.5 m tall with a 6.4 m wide spreader, stacking full boxes five high. Signal red body and telescopic boom over a dark grey chassis, twin front tyres, a raised cab and a yellow rotating spreader, with salt grime, rust streaks and scuffed paint.

models.name: Office Reception
models.description: Office reception set with a curved white counter about 4 m long. It has an oak ledge, a lowered accessible end and a slatted oak wall with a blank backlit plaque behind it. A waiting corner has two grey lounge sofas, a coffee table and planter boxes.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Recon Drone Set
models.description: Two original recon drones: a 1.2 m quad-rotor drone with a gimbal camera and landing skids, and a 0.6 m spherical hover sentry with a single glowing lens eye and stub fins. Olive-grey composite shells with dark carbon parts and navigation lights.

models.name: Recurve Bow
models.description: Recurve bow, about 1.3 m tip to tip, braced. A dark hardwood riser with a leather-wrapped grip and an arrow shelf, laminated limbs that curl forward at the tips, a waxed string, and a separate arrow with red fletching and a steel broadhead nocked on the rest.

models.name: Red and White Paper Lantern String
models.description: A sagging cord of alternating red and white paper lanterns, about 4.9 m long. Ribbed paper with black lacquered rims and blank faces, lit from inside at night. Ends in a hook and a ring so strings chain together.

models.name: Red Apple
models.description: A red apple, 7.7 cm across and 7.6 cm tall with its stem. Red blush streaks over a yellow green ground, freckled with pale lenticels under a soft waxy shine.

models.name: Falu Red Cottage
models.description: One-and-a-half storey Nordic country cottage, 9 x 6 m, on a fieldstone plinth. Red ochre board-and-batten cladding, white trims and six-pane windows, a cross gable over a small white porch with a green door, a dark tin roof and a white chimney. Exterior only.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Red Folding Bistro Chair
models.description: Red metal folding bistro chair about 0.87 m tall with a perforated seat and curved back. Powder-coated steel, chipped at the edges and polished where people sit.

models.name: Red Fox
models.description: Red fox, 0.40 m at the shoulder with a 0.7 m body and a 0.4 m bushy white-tipped tail. Orange-red coat, white chin and chest, black lower legs and black ear backs. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1 m/s walking and 2.5 m/s trotting.

models.name: Red Health Potion
models.description: A round-bellied fantasy potion bottle of glowing red brew, about 15 cm tall, stopped with cork and twine. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Red Oat Grass Clump
models.description: A knee high clump of seeding red oat grass, about 0.95 m tall. Rust red blades and nodding heads with dark, bent awns.

models.name: Red Paper Lantern String
models.description: A sagging cord of red paper lanterns, about 3.7 m long. Ribbed paper with black lacquered rims and blank faces, lit from inside at night. Ends in a hook and a ring so strings chain together.

models.name: Red Plaza Bistro Table
models.description: Round red metal bistro table 0.61 m across and 0.74 m tall with a perforated top. Powder-coated steel, chipped at the edges, as set out in pedestrian plazas.

models.name: Red Rose Bush
models.description: A garden rose bush about 90 cm tall and 1.3 m wide with deep red blooms. Each rose is built from individual cupped petals on thorny canes among small compound leaves.

models.name: Red Sand Spade
models.description: Red plastic toy spade about 33 cm long for digging on the beach. Sun-faded from summer use.

models.name: Red Sandstone Arch
models.description: A 26 m long sandstone fin pierced by a natural arch, about 16 m high. Layered red sandstone with ledged beds, vertical joints, dark desert varnish streaks and sand on the ledges.

models.name: Red Sandstone Fallen Slabs
models.description: A pile of broken sandstone slabs fallen from a cliff, about 7.5 m across and 3.3 m high. Layered red sandstone with ledged beds, vertical joints, dark desert varnish streaks and sand on the ledges.

models.name: Red Sandstone Hoodoo
models.description: A tall sandstone hoodoo spire with a flat cap rock and a shorter spire beside it, about 11 m high on a broad base. Layered red sandstone with ledged beds, vertical joints, dark desert varnish streaks and sand on the ledges.

models.name: Red Sandstone Mesa
models.description: A flat-topped desert mesa about 46 m wide, 35 m deep and 21 m high, with sheer cliff walls. Layered red sandstone with ledged beds, vertical joints, dark desert varnish streaks and sand on the ledges.

models.name: Red Viewing Steps
models.description: Freestanding bank of six wide seating steps, 8 m wide and 4.8 m tall, in translucent red glass lit from inside. Dark steel cladding on the sides and back, stainless nosings, a narrow walking stair at one end and a guard rail along the top; people sit on the steps to watch the square.

models.name: Red Wooden House Chimney
models.description: A tall square chimney in white plaster, about 5.7 m high, with a black metal cap and flashing where it passes through the roof. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Floor with Stairwell
models.description: A 2 x 4 m pine floor with an opening for a stair and a white rail round it, over pale painted ceiling boards. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Gable Wall
models.description: The triangular gable wall under a 40 degree roof, 4.4 m wide and 1.8 m high, in falu red vertical boards with a small white louvred vent. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Inner Corner
models.description: White corner boards 2.8 m tall that cover the wall ends at an inner corner of the red wooden house. Snaps to the house kit on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys.

models.name: Red Wooden House Outer Corner
models.description: White corner boards 2.8 m tall that cover the wall ends at an outer corner of the red wooden house. Snaps to the house kit on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys.

models.name: Red Wooden House Pine Floor
models.description: A 2 x 2 m storey floor of pine floorboards over pale painted ceiling boards, for the inside of a red wooden house. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Porch Deck
models.description: A 2 x 2 m front porch deck with two steps, grey weathered boards on a falu red skirt. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Porch Railing
models.description: A 2 m white painted wooden railing about 1 m high, for the edge of a porch deck. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Porch Roof
models.description: A lean-to porch roof of dark tin on two white posts, about 2.4 m wide and 2.9 m high, to stand over the porch deck. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Roof End
models.description: The end section of a 40 degree gable roof for a 4 m deep wooden house, overhanging the gable with white barge boards over dark grey concrete tiles. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Roof Section
models.description: A 2 m section of 40 degree gable roof for a 4 m deep wooden house, with dark grey concrete tiles, a rounded ridge and a white eave frieze. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Red Wooden House Stairs
models.description: A straight one-storey stair of pine treads with a white rail, about 3.6 m long and 1 m wide, rising 2.8 m. Fits the stairwell floor. Snaps on a 2 m grid with 2.8 m storeys and 0.2 m walls on the grid line.

models.name: Reef Fish
models.description: Reef fish, 20 cm long, with a deep yellow body, slanting blue stripes and a long dorsal fin. A dark band runs through the eye and the fins carry blue rims. Built to be used in schools; the clips swim in place.

models.name: Large Reef Rock
models.description: A large porous reef boulder about 1.9 m across and 1 m high. Pitted, holed grey limestone crusted with pink coralline algae, olive turf and small white barnacles, darker in the hollows.

models.name: Medium Reef Rock
models.description: A medium porous reef boulder about 1.2 m across and 0.7 m high. Pitted, holed grey limestone crusted with pink coralline algae, olive turf and small white barnacles, darker in the hollows.

models.name: Small Reef Rock
models.description: A small porous reef rock about 0.6 m across and 0.3 m high. Pitted, holed grey limestone crusted with pink coralline algae, olive turf and small white barnacles, darker in the hollows.

models.name: Reef Rocks
models.description: Three porous limestone reef boulders, 0.6 to 2 m across, as separate pieces. Pitted and holed grey stone crusted with pink coralline algae, olive turf and small white barnacles, wet and darker in the hollows.

models.name: Reef Shark
models.description: Grey reef shark, 1.8 m long. Grey back with a pale belly, dusky to black fin tips and a broad black edge on the tail. The clips swim in place.

models.name: Reefer Container Plug Rack
models.description: A steel gantry with stairs and walkways that holds power sockets for refrigerated containers, about 7.5 m long and 8.8 m tall. Grey galvanised steel with grime and cable runs, for a container yard.

models.name: Refinery Column Unit
models.description: Refinery process unit on a 44 x 30 m concrete pad, with two insulated distillation columns 42 m and 31 m tall wrapped in platforms and caged ladders. A pipe rack with air coolers, heat exchangers, pumps and a banded 46 m flare stack with a burning flame complete it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Fridge Freezer
models.description: Freestanding white fridge freezer, 1.85 m tall, 0.6 m wide and 0.66 m deep, with the fridge above and the freezer below. Plain gloss white doors with rounded edges and grey bar handles; inside are glass shelves, door bins, a crisper and freezer drawers.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Regional Turboprop
models.description: High-wing twin turboprop regional airliner, about 27 m long with a 27 m wingspan. White with a grey belly, a teal stripe and T-tail, six-blade propellers and gear in fairings along the lower fuselage. Shipped with the gear down.

models.name: Reindeer
models.description: Adult reindeer, 1.15 m at the shoulder and 1.7 m long, with large asymmetric antlers. Grey-brown coat with a pale shaggy neck mane, pale belly and rump, dark legs and broad hooves. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1.2 m/s walking and 3.2 m/s trotting.

models.name: Double Restaurant Booth
models.description: A back to back restaurant booth, 120 cm long and 120 cm deep, seating on both sides. Burgundy vinyl seats and channel tufted backs in a dark walnut shell with a cherry cap rail. Modules snap on a 1.2 m grid.

models.name: Single Restaurant Booth
models.description: A single sided restaurant booth, 120 cm long and 60 cm deep. Burgundy vinyl seat with a rolled front and a channel tufted back in a dark walnut shell with a cherry cap rail. Modules snap end to end on a 1.2 m grid.

models.name: Restaurant Chair
models.description: A restaurant side chair, about 86 cm tall. A black steel frame carries a burgundy vinyl seat pad and a cherry wood back panel.

models.name: Restaurant Host Stand
models.description: A restaurant host stand podium, about 1.1 m tall. Dark walnut laminate with a sloped charcoal top and two shelves behind holding a pair of menus.

models.name: Restaurant Server Station
models.description: A restaurant server side station, 120 cm wide and 1.65 m tall. Dark walnut laminate with a charcoal top, two doors and a drawer below and a hutch of cubbies with bins above.

models.name: Reusable Booster
models.description: Original reusable rocket first stage, about 45 m tall, standing on four deployed landing legs. Its white body is streaked with soot from landing, with a black interstage carrying four lattice grid fins and nine engine bells at the base.

models.name: Ribbed White Vase
models.description: A white ceramic vase about 25 cm tall and 21 cm wide, with soft vertical flutes round its rounded body. Matte glaze with a short flared lip.

models.name: Rigid Inflatable Boat
models.description: Rigid inflatable boat 9 m long with a dark grey deep-V hull, a grey tube collar and twin outboards. Handle lines on the tube, a centre console with a windscreen, two double jockey seats and a radar arch with a radome and lights; no markings.

models.name: River Embankment Kit
models.description: Stepped concrete city river embankment kit on a 20 m module, 6.6 m from river bed to street. A stained toe wall, a railed waterside ledge, sitting steps up to a paved path with trees in planters and benches, and a railed flood wall; one piece adds stairs into the water and up to the street.

models.name: River Stones
models.description: Set of eight smooth, water-worn river stones and pebbles from 0.1 to 1.2 m. Grey granite, dark greywacke, pale quartzite and sandstone, some crossed by white quartz veins, several with a wet, dark lower part below a soft water mark.

models.name: Forest Track Barrier
models.description: Closed swing barrier across a forest track, a 4.7 m steel boom 0.95 m above the ground. Painted in red and white bands, chalky, chipped and rusty, hinged on a galvanized post and padlocked to a second post 4.0 m away. White zinc corrosion and soil splash.

models.name: Road Bicycle
models.description: Aluminium road bicycle with a drop handlebar, 1.7 m long. Deep blue frame, black carbon fork, tan wall tyres on black rims, a double crankset with a real chain and rear derailleur, rim brakes and a bottle in its cage.

models.name: Blasted Road Cutting
models.description: Rock cutting beside a road, 30 m overall, with a steep blasted granite face up to 7 m high. Drill-hole traces, blocky breakouts and ledges, a gravel shoulder and ditch with fallen debris at the foot, and a grassy slope above that tapers into the hillside.

models.name: Road Roller
models.description: Generic tandem vibratory road roller, about 5.2 m long and 3.3 m tall to the beacon, with 1.7 m wide drums. Orange body over two smooth steel drums, an articulated frame, an edge cutter and an open canopy over the seat, with asphalt dust and scuffs from daily paving work.

models.name: Reflective Road Stud
models.description: Cat's eye road stud about 0.2 m long, set in a small asphalt repair patch. A worn rubber pad sits in a cast iron housing, with two glass reflectors facing each direction along the road.

models.name: Road Worker
models.description: Road worker in a hi-vis vest with reflective bands over a t-shirt, cargo work trousers with reflective shin bands, safety boots and a hard hat. Rigged with a 56-bone humanoid skeleton and four looping animations (idle, walk, wave, look_around). Origin on the ground between the feet, facing +Z.

models.name: Roadside Diner
models.description: Stainless-sided roadside diner, 18 x 8 m, with a long window band and a glazed entrance with steps. Fluted steel walls on a tiled base, a teal frieze with red and teal neon tubes, and booths, stools, a counter and a checker floor inside. No signs or text.

models.name: Roadside Motel
models.description: Two-storey L-shaped roadside motel, 40 m long, with room doors onto covered walkways and steel stairs. Cream painted block walls, a brown fascia, teal doors, wall AC units, ice machine nooks, warmly lit curtained windows and a tall blank cabinet sign on a pole.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Roadside Shrine
models.description: Tiny roadside shrine on a granite base, 1.2 m tall, with two small stone figures in red bibs as separate pieces. A weathered timber box with lattice doors under a green copper roof, a straw rope with paper streamers and offerings of evergreen sprigs, a flask, cups, rice and coins.

models.name: Roast Goose on Platter
models.description: A roast goose on an oval pewter platter 53 cm long, trussed and browned, with apples, onions and herbs round it.

models.name: Industrial Robot Arm
models.description: Six axis industrial robot arm about 2.5 m tall on a steel pedestal, inside a 4.8 x 4.8 m mesh safety fence cell. Deep teal arm with dark servo housings, clamped cable dress and a parallel gripper over a fixture table, with a controller cabinet, teach pendant and operator station outside the gate.

models.name: Mossy Granite Outcrop
models.description: Low bedrock outcrop of jointed granite gneiss, about 8.5 x 6 m and 2.3 m high. Stepped shelves and blocks split by joints, moss carpets on the tops and in the cracks, lichen on the sides and a damp, dirty foot. It sinks 0.5 m into any terrain.

models.name: Roe Deer
models.description: Roe deer buck, 0.75 m at the shoulder and 1.2 m long, with short three-tined antlers. Red-brown summer coat, pale rump patch, black nose, white chin and large ears. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1.2 m/s walking and 3 m/s trotting.

models.name: Rolled Parchment Map
models.description: A rolled parchment map about 35 cm long tied with a cord, its outer leaf sprung open on the ground.

models.name: Rolled Sleeping Bag
models.description: A deep red sleeping bag rolled tight and held by two black compression straps, about 45 cm long. The quilted baffles bulge between the straps.

models.name: Rolled Teal Exercise Mat
models.description: Teal foam exercise mat rolled up, about 0.63 m wide and 15 cm thick, with a fine embossed grip.

models.name: Roller Blind
models.description: A pale fabric roller blind, 1.2 m wide and about 1.25 m drop, in a white cassette with a bead chain at the side. Mounts at the top of a window opening.

models.name: Rondel Dagger
models.description: A 40 cm medieval rondel dagger with a stiff triangular thrusting blade. Iron discs form the guard and pommel, and the dark wooden grip is bound with a spiral of brass wire between brass ferrules.

models.name: Roof Prism Binoculars
models.description: A pair of olive rubber-armoured roof prism binoculars about 17 cm long, lying on their side. They have a central focus wheel, folding rubber eyecups and a short neck strap.

models.name: Rooftop Water Tower
models.description: Rooftop water tower, about 7.5 m tall: a 4.2 m wide wooden stave tank bound with rusty steel hoops under a conical board roof. It sits on timber joists over a braced steel stand on concrete footings, with an access ladder and safety cage on one side.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Rooftop Access Hatch
models.description: Roof access hatch about 1.3 m square on a raised curb, with a lid hinged at the back edge that opens. Painted steel with light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Air Handler
models.description: Packaged rooftop air handling unit on a curb, about 3.3 m long and 1.6 m tall, with fan grilles, louvred ends and a duct riser. Painted galvanized steel with light weathering, for flat city roofs.

models.name: Rooftop Cable Tray
models.description: Ladder-style cable tray about 4.3 m long on low supports, for running cables across a flat roof. Galvanized steel with light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Condenser Pair
models.description: Two split-system condensing units on a galvanized steel frame with pipe runs, about 2.8 m wide and 1.2 m tall. Painted casings with fan grilles and light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Exhaust Fan
models.description: Mushroom-shaped roof exhaust fan on a raised curb, about 1.2 m across and 1 m tall. Galvanized and painted steel with light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Guard Rail
models.description: Freestanding safety guard rail about 3.5 m long and 1.1 m tall on weighted feet, for roof edges. Galvanized steel tube with light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Lift Motor Room
models.description: Small clad lift motor room for a flat roof, about 3.4 by 3.3 m and 3.8 m tall, with a steel door, a louvre and a wall lamp. Painted steel cladding with light weathering.

models.name: Rooftop Props Set
models.description: Set of eleven rooftop props for city buildings: an air handler, condensers, a bolted steel water tank on legs, two satellite dishes, vent stacks, an exhaust fan, a lift motor room, a cable tray, an access hatch with an opening lid and a guard rail. Galvanized and painted steel with light weathering.

models.name: Large Rooftop Satellite Dish
models.description: Satellite dish 1.8 m across on a ballasted steel frame, about 2.4 m tall. Painted steel with light weathering, made to sit on a flat roof without fixings.

models.name: Small Rooftop Satellite Dish
models.description: Satellite dish 0.9 m across on a short mast with a ballasted base, about 1.4 m tall. Painted steel with light weathering, for flat roofs.

models.name: Rooftop Sign Frame
models.description: Rooftop sign on a steel lattice frame, 10 m wide and 5 m tall, for the edge of a city roof. A blank lit 10 x 3 m panel sits 2 m up on braced posts with raking back struts, over a service catwalk with flood lamps. The panel face has plain 0-1 UVs for your own artwork.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Rooftop Vent Stacks
models.description: Three galvanized vent pipes with rain cowls on a shared plinth, up to about 2.4 m tall. Light weathering, for flat city roofs.

models.name: Rooftop Water Tank
models.description: Bolted sectional steel water tank on a braced steel stand with a ladder, about 3.6 m long and 4.9 m tall. Galvanized panels with light weathering, a common sight on older city roofs.

models.name: Jungle Rope Bridge
models.description: Sagging rope-and-plank suspension bridge spanning 16 m, with two timber anchor posts at each end, hand ropes and vertical lacing. Weathered planks lashed to fibre ropes, with a few planks missing or broken and hanging.

models.name: Rotting Swamp Log
models.description: A rotting log about 3.2 m long, half sunk in the mud. It tapers from a swollen butt to a hollow top snapped off in splinters, bows along its length and carries moss, broken limb stubs and bracket fungi.

models.name: Round Baler
models.description: Trailed round baler, 4.2 m long and 2.4 m tall, that makes bales 1.2 m wide and 1.25 m across. Red side panels on a dark grey frame, a tined pickup at the front and a single axle, with one plain straw bale and one wrapped silage bale as separate pieces.

models.name: Round Bath Rug
models.description: A 60 cm round bath rug in soft sage grey pile with a rounded edge. Lies flat on a bathroom floor.

models.name: Round Bottom Flask
models.description: A round bottom glass flask, 17 cm tall, sitting in a cork ring with a little amber liquid inside.

models.name: Round Brass Mirror
models.description: A round wall mirror about 72 cm across, framed by a slim rolled rim of worn brushed brass.

models.name: Round Brilliant Diamond
models.description: Round brilliant-cut diamond about 2 cm across with real flat facets and a clear, colourless refractive material.

models.name: Round Concrete Bollard
models.description: A low round concrete bollard stump about 0.4 m wide and 0.55 m tall. Weathered grey concrete, for blocking vehicles from paths and squares.

models.name: Round Jute Rug
models.description: A 1.5 m round rug of braided natural jute coiled from the centre outward. Coarse golden brown fibres with stitched coils and a tapered outer end.

models.name: Round Shield
models.description: Round wooden shield, 0.8 m across, of seven butted planks with a steel boss and a rawhide rim. The front carries a weathered red and ochre whirl motif; behind the boss are a wooden handgrip and a leather arm strap.

models.name: Round Steel Street Table
models.description: A round steel table on a single pedestal, about 0.8 m across and 0.6 m tall, with a scuffed top and a heavy round foot, as set out under street food tents.

models.name: Round Tower
models.description: Round stone castle drum tower, 16 m to the eaves and 26 m to the finial, with a steep conical slate roof. Battered foot, tiers of arrow slits, a corbelled wall head, a roof dormer and plank doors with lanterns at wall-walk height on both sides, where castle walls join.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Round Velvet Cushion
models.description: A round ochre velvet cushion about 42 cm across, gathered into radial pleats around a covered button on each face. The pile catches light unevenly, as crushed velvet does.

models.name: Roundabout Ahead Sign
models.description: Triangular roundabout ahead warning sign, 90 cm per side, on a 2.5 m galvanized post. Three black arrows circling on white inside a red border, on an aluminium blank with riveted rails and strap clamps.

models.name: Diagonal Roundpole Fence
models.description: Nordic diagonal roundpole fence section, 3 m long and about 1.25 m tall. Grey split poles lean at 45 degrees between paired posts tied with twisted withy bands; weathered silver-grey wood with bark remnants and lichen. Place copies every 3 m along X.

models.name: Rowan
models.description: Rowan (mountain ash), about 7.5 m tall, with smooth grey-brown bark, a light, open crown of feathery pinnate leaves and heavy clusters of orange-red berries.

models.name: Rowing Boat
models.description: Small white fibreglass rowing boat, 3.8 m long and 1.4 m wide, with two oars. Wooden thwarts, rubbing strakes and floorboards; chalky, scuffed gelcoat above a brown scum line and blue-grey antifouling below. Sink it so the waterline is 0.1 m above the origin.

models.name: Rubber Medicine Ball
models.description: Medicine ball 30 cm across in pebbled black rubber with moulded seams, for strength and core training.

models.name: Large Rubble Heap
models.description: Big demolition rubble heap about 9.5 m across and 3 m tall: broken concrete slabs with bent rebar, loose bricks, mortared wall chunks and plaster dust.

models.name: Medium Rubble Heap
models.description: Demolition rubble heap about 6 m across and 1.8 m tall: broken concrete slabs with bent rebar, loose bricks, mortared wall chunks and plaster dust.

models.name: Small Rubble Heap
models.description: Low demolition rubble heap about 3.5 to 4 m across and 0.9 m tall: broken concrete slabs with bent rebar, loose bricks, mortared wall chunks and plaster dust.

models.name: Rubble Pile Asteroid
models.description: Large rubble pile asteroid about 27 m across, a loose clump of boulders and gravel held together by its own weight. Dark, dusty and pitted, centred on its origin.

models.name: Rubble Pile Set
models.description: Set of three demolition rubble heaps, about 3, 5 and 8 m across, each a separate model. Broken concrete slabs with bent rebar, loose bricks, mortared wall chunks and plaster dust.

models.name: Ruined Apartment Shell
models.description: Ruined four-storey concrete apartment frame, about 18 x 12 m and 13 m tall. Collapsed floors, broken brick infill, exposed rebar, bent balcony railings, rubble heaps around the base and a stairwell that still climbs to the top.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Ruined Colonnade
