models.description: Ruined 24 m Ionic colonnade on a two-step marble base, about 7 m tall, with a limestone back wall. Six columns still carry a broken entablature and stone ceiling beams, while the far end has collapsed into fallen drums, beams and wall blocks.

models.name: Single Bed with Rumpled Bedding
models.description: Slept-in single bed in oiled oak, 0.96 m wide and 2.14 m long, for a 90 x 200 cm mattress. A blue grey linen duvet is thrown back and slides off one side, with a creased white sheet, one dented and one leaning pillow and a rust knit throw at the foot.

models.name: Russet Pear
models.description: A russet pear, 6.6 cm across and 12.8 cm tall with its stem. Its leaning, bottle-shaped body has a matte golden brown russet skin over green.

models.name: Sack of Presents
models.description: Full burlap sack of presents, 0.85 m tall, tied at the neck with rope. A bulging jute sack gathered in folds at the knot, its mouth flopping open, with four wrapped presents in red, green, navy and gold poking out of the top.

models.name: Safety Glasses
models.description: Clear wraparound safety glasses about 15 cm wide, resting open on their temples. Black brow bar and arms, scratched polycarbonate lens.

models.name: Sage Ceramic Toothbrush Cup
models.description: A matte sage green ceramic cup holding two toothbrushes, about 19 cm tall with the brushes. For a vanity, sink or bathroom shelf.

models.name: Sage Linen Cushion
models.description: A square scatter cushion in washed sage green linen with piped edges, about 46 cm across. Plump and soft, with a pressure dent and creases pulled in from the corners.

models.name: Sage Stand Mixer
models.description: A sage green tilt head stand mixer about 35 cm tall, with a polished steel mixing bowl and a beater lowered into it. Smooth enamel body with chrome trim.

models.name: Saguaro Cactus
models.description: Giant saguaro cactus, 8.5 m tall with three upturned arms, plus a young 1.7 m single stem. Dusty green pleated ribs with felted areoles and rows of grey spines, the stems narrowing where the arms join and domed at the tips.

models.name: Giant Saguaro Cactus
models.description: Mature saguaro cactus about 8.7 m tall with three upturned arms. Dusty green pleated ribs with felted areoles and rows of grey spines, narrowing where the arms join and domed at the tips.

models.name: Young Saguaro Cactus
models.description: Young saguaro cactus, a single stem about 1.9 m tall with dusty green pleated ribs, felted areoles and rows of grey spines, domed at the tip.

models.name: Sailing Yacht
models.description: Modern 14 m cruising sloop with a 20 m mast, plumb bow and wide open transom. White gelcoat hull with long dark windows, teak decks, twin wheels, fin keel with a bulb and lightly worn antifouling. Sails come set and furled: hide whichever pair you do not need.

models.name: Worn Tyre Stack
models.description: A stack of worn tyres with one leaning against it and one lying flat. Use it as cover, a barrier or simple yard clutter.

models.name: Salvage Workbench
models.description: A rusty welded workbench with an old door for a top, a vice, a car battery and an oil lamp. Tools hang from a plywood back board and a jerry can sits underneath.

models.name: Sandbag Firing Position
models.description: Horseshoe-shaped sandbag firing position about 3 m wide and 0.9 m tall, a low ring of stacked burlap bags open at the back for one or two soldiers.

models.name: Sandbag Fortification Set
models.description: Military field fortification kit on a 1 m grid: sandbag walls (straight, curved and a corner), a horseshoe firing position, a 4 x 4 m timber and sandbag bunker, an earth-filled barrier block, razor wire on pickets and a camouflage net on poles. Wall pieces start at their origin.

models.name: Sandbag Wall Corner
models.description: Right-angle sandbag wall corner with two 1 m legs, 1.2 m tall, stacked burlap bags in staggered courses. Starts at its origin and joins the straight walls on the 1 m grid.

models.name: Curved Sandbag Wall
models.description: Quarter-circle sandbag wall of 2 m radius and 1.2 m tall, stacked burlap bags in staggered courses. A kit piece on a 1 m grid that starts at its origin and chains with the straight wall.

models.name: Straight Sandbag Wall
models.description: Straight sandbag wall about 2 m long and 1.2 m tall, stacked burlap bags in staggered courses. A kit piece on a 1 m grid that starts at its origin and chains with the curved and corner pieces.

models.name: Sandstone Formation Set
models.description: Four layered red sandstone formations: a mesa block about 40 m wide and 20 m high, a 22 m fin with a natural arch, an 11 m hoodoo spire and a pile of fallen slabs. Ledged beds, vertical joints, dark desert varnish streaks and sand on the ledges.

models.name: Sandstone River Stone
models.description: Rounded grey sandstone river stone about 0.6 m long and 0.3 m tall, smoothed by water, with a wet, darker lower part below a soft water mark.

models.name: Sanke Koi
models.description: A single koi carp about 0.6 m long, its body bent mid-stroke. Sanke pattern: white scales with red patches and small black spots on the back.

models.name: Father Christmas
models.description: Father Christmas figure, 1.80 m tall. A long red wool coat with white fur trim, black belt, red trousers, black boots, mittens, a fur-brimmed hat and a full white beard. Animated idle, walk, wave and look around.

models.name: Lakeside Sauna
models.description: Small Nordic lakeside sauna, 3 x 4 m, with a covered plank porch. Red ochre board-and-batten cladding on a fieldstone plinth, a black tin gable roof with a stovepipe, white porch posts, a bench, a small window and a green door that opens onto a dark interior.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Savanna Grass Patch
models.description: A 4 x 4 m patch of dry season savanna grass, knee high, with straw and rusty red tussocks, seed heads and bare gaps. Copies placed 4 m apart join edge to edge without a seam.

models.name: Savanna Thornbush
models.description: A dense African thornbush about 2 m tall and 2.5 m across. Many wiry zigzag stems set with paired thorns carry tiny dusty olive leaves.

models.name: Scaffolding Boarded Lift
models.description: One 2 m lift of tube and coupler scaffolding, 2.5 m long and 2 m deep, with a boarded working deck and guard rails. Galvanised tubes and couplers with weathered timber boards splashed with concrete. Stacks with the other scaffold pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scaffolding Corner Bay
models.description: A square corner bay of tube and coupler scaffolding, about 2.3 m on a side and one 2 m lift high, for turning a scaffold round a building corner. Galvanised tubes and couplers with weathered timber boards splashed with concrete. Stacks with the other scaffold pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scaffolding Debris Netting Panel
models.description: A 2.5 x 1.9 m panel of orange debris netting stretched on a light frame, hung on the outside face of scaffolding to catch falling material.

models.name: Scaffolding Ground Bay
models.description: A ground bay of tube and coupler scaffolding, 2.5 m long, 2 m deep and one 2 m lift high, with braces, base plates and sole boards. Galvanised tubes and couplers with weathered timber boards splashed with concrete. Stacks with the other scaffold pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scaffolding Kit
models.description: Modular tube and coupler scaffolding, 2.5 m bays, 2 m deep and 2 m lifts, with a ground bay, a boarded lift, a corner bay, a ladder bay, a loading bay with a pallet gate and an orange netting panel. Galvanised tubes, weathered timber boards with concrete splashes, stacks on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scaffolding Ladder Bay
models.description: A scaffold bay with an aluminium ladder up through a hinged trap door in its boarded deck, about 2.8 m long and 4 m tall with the ladder. Galvanised tubes and couplers with weathered timber boards splashed with concrete. Stacks with the other scaffold pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scaffolding Loading Bay
models.description: A boarded scaffold bay with a yellow mesh pallet gate that swings open for loading materials, about 2.7 m long and 2.2 m high. Galvanised tubes and couplers with weathered timber boards splashed with concrete. Stacks with the other scaffold pieces on a 2 m grid.

models.name: Scarecrow
models.description: Straw-stuffed scarecrow on a wooden cross post, 1.8 m tall and 1.6 m wide. A patched red plaid shirt, faded denim trousers, a burlap sack head with a stitched face and a worn felt hat, with straw poking out. The straw and loose cloth sway in the wind.

models.name: Scholar's Writing Desk
models.description: An oak writing desk 1.15 m wide with turned legs, a drawer and a raised gallery at the back. On top stand a lit candle in a chamberstick, an inkwell with a quill, loose sheets and two closed books.

models.name: School Building
models.description: Two storey school, 40 x 20 m, with a taller sports hall wing and a fenced yard. Buff brick with stone bands and big gridded classroom windows, orange ribbed cladding on the hall, a glazed entrance under a cantilevered canopy, solar panels on the roof and court markings in the asphalt yard.

models.name: School Corridor Double-Door Screen
models.description: School corridor module 4 m long with a glazed screen across it and double doors that swing open. Painted blockwork in cream over blue, tiled vinyl floor and a tiled ceiling.

models.name: School Corridor Kit
models.description: School corridor modules with a 3.6 m storey: a 4 m run of two-tier lockers, a 4 m run with notice boards, a glazed double-door screen and a dog-leg stair core. Painted blockwork in cream over blue, tiled vinyl floor and a tiled ceiling with light panels.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: School Corridor with Lockers
models.description: School corridor module 4 m long with a 3.6 m storey and a run of two-tier lockers whose doors open. Painted blockwork in cream over blue, tiled vinyl floor and a tiled ceiling with light panels.

models.name: School Corridor with Notice Boards
models.description: School corridor module 4 m long with a 3.6 m storey, notice boards and a door that opens. Painted blockwork in cream over blue, tiled vinyl floor and a tiled ceiling.

models.name: School Dog-Leg Stair Core
models.description: Dog-leg stair core about 4 by 6 m rising one 3.6 m storey for a school, with painted blockwork walls in cream over blue. Joins the 4 m corridor modules.

models.name: Sci-Fi Airlock
models.description: Sci-fi airlock module, a 4 x 4 m cell with a hinged outer pressure hatch and a sliding inner door pair. Suit lockers with spacesuits line both walls, amber beacons sit over both doors and hazard stripes frame the openings. Snaps onto the corridor kit like a straight module.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sci-Fi Command Bridge
models.description: Sci-fi command bridge interior, 12 x 8 m with a 3.4 m ceiling and a wide raked viewport. A curved console bank with glowing displays faces the glass, with a command seat on a raised dais behind it and graphite and off-white wall panels around.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Corner
models.description: Sci-fi corridor module 4 by 4 m that turns 90 degrees, with off-white and graphite panelling, floor grating, pipe runs and glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Crossing
models.description: Four-way sci-fi corridor crossing 4 by 4 m with off-white and graphite panelling, floor grating, pipe runs and glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Dead End
models.description: Sci-fi corridor module 4 m long closed by an end wall, with off-white and graphite panelling, floor grating and glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Door
models.description: Sci-fi corridor module 4 m long with split sliding doors that open, in off-white and graphite panelling with glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Kit
models.description: Modular sci-fi corridor kit on a 4 m grid: straight, corner, T, cross, dead end and a door module with split sliding doors. Off-white and graphite panelling with structural ribs, floor grating, overhead pipe runs and glowing light strips, lightly worn from service.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor Straight
models.description: Straight sci-fi corridor module 4 m long and 4.15 m tall with off-white and graphite panelling, structural ribs, floor grating, overhead pipe runs and glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Corridor T-Junction
models.description: Sci-fi corridor module 4 by 4 m where three corridors meet in a T, with off-white and graphite panelling, floor grating and glowing light strips. Snaps on a 4 m grid.

models.name: Sci-Fi Dropship
models.description: Original heavy sci-fi transport dropship, about 25 m long and unarmed. Worn grey armoured hull with dark trim, a glazed cockpit, four tilting engine pods with glowing exhausts, sliding side doors, a rear ramp, folding landing legs and a troop bay lined with fold-down seats.

models.name: Sci-Fi Interceptor
models.description: Original single-seat sci-fi interceptor, about 14 m long with a 10.5 m wingspan. Off-white panelled hull with dark grey and orange trim, a sharp chined nose, swept wings that fold up, twin engines with glowing nozzles and light service wear.

models.name: Sci-Fi Freighter
models.description: Original boxy sci-fi cargo freighter, about 41 m long, carrying four 40 ft cargo containers under its spine. Worn industrial yellow paint with dark grey trim, a glazed cockpit module with a bow ramp, four engine pods with glowing nozzles and four landing legs.

models.name: Sci-Fi Hangar Bay
models.description: Sci-fi hangar bay interior, 20 x 30 m and 14 m tall, with a lifting blast door, an overhead gantry crane and two refuelling arms. Off-white wall panels between graphite columns, a painted landing box on the deck plates, light troughs overhead and a control booth above the rear door.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sci-Fi Reactor Room
models.description: Sci-fi reactor hall interior, 16 x 16 m and 14 m tall, around a 10 m glowing cyan reactor core. A cage of coolant pipes wraps the core, two ring catwalks with yellow railings circle it, reached by a stair and a ladder, and control consoles on the floor face it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sci-Fi Shuttle
models.description: Original 12-passenger sci-fi shuttle, about 18 m long. White panelled hull with dark grey and teal trim, a wide glazed cockpit, sliding side doors, a rear ramp and two tilting ducted thruster nacelles, with a seated cabin visible through the windows.

models.name: Scots Pine
models.description: Mature Scots pine, about 20 m tall, with a long bare orange upper trunk, a flat-topped crown and tufts of paired needles.

models.name: Scramble Crossing Signal Corner
models.description: Sidewalk corner for a scramble crossing, 6 x 6 m with a 3 m kerb radius. Grey concrete paving, yellow tactile landings, granite kerbs and a steel pole with lit walk signals and a vehicle signal on an arm. Fits the 6 m kit module.

models.name: Scramble Crossing Junction Box
models.description: Flat 16 x 16 m junction box where two four-lane city roads meet, painted with two diagonal zebra crossings. Worn asphalt with white thermoplastic markings. The centre of the scramble crossing kit, ringed by its zebra arms.

models.name: Scramble Crossing Kit
models.description: Flat kit for a big city scramble junction of two four-lane roads, 40 x 40 m assembled. A junction box with two diagonal zebras, zebra crossing arms, kerbed corners with lit signals, plain road, a refuge island and fenced sidewalks, on a 6 m module that tiles.

models.name: Scramble Crossing Zebra Arm
models.description: Flat 16 x 6 m road arm of a four-lane city junction with a full-width zebra crossing and a stop line on the approach half. Worn asphalt with white thermoplastic paint and gutters. Joins the junction box on the 6 m kit module.

models.name: Scrap Metal Barricade Gate
models.description: An improvised gate of welded scrap sheet and bars hung on two posts, about 3.4 m wide and 2.4 m tall, that swings open. Rusted, weathered and patched.

models.name: Scrap Shanty
models.description: A 4 x 3 m one room survivor shack built from salvage, about 3 m tall at the stove pipe. Mismatched corrugated sheet, boards, a car door and blank road signs clad a raised timber frame, with tyres weighing down the roof and a faded tarp awning over the plank door.

models.name: Scrap Wall Corner
models.description: An L shaped corner of a 3 m tall scrap settlement wall, 2 m along each side. An I beam post in a stack of earth filled tyres ties the runs of sheet, car doors and a blank stop sign.

models.name: Scrap Wall Gate
models.description: A 4 m wide gate in a scrap settlement wall: I beam posts in tyre stacks under a lintel with a blank sign and barbed wire. The swinging gate is clad in car doors and corrugated sheet.

models.name: Scrap Wall Lookout
models.description: A 2 m section of scrap settlement wall with a firing slot and a pallet deck behind it at 1.5 m. A ladder, a guard rail and a lean to sheet roof shelter an ammo box and a water drum.

models.name: Scrap Wall Section
models.description: A 2 m section of a 3 m tall survivor settlement wall. Pipe posts carry mismatched corrugated sheet, battens, boards and a blank road sign under rebar spikes and barbed wire.

models.name: Scree Slope
models.description: Talus fan of broken granite at a cliff foot, 20 m wide and 7.5 m high. A concave slope of angular rocks sorted by size, from fine gravel under the cliff to big blocks rolled out at the toe, with lichen on the old stones and grass and a shrub at the edges. Its back is made to stand against a cliff.

models.name: Scrying Orb on Stand
models.description: A glass scrying orb with a swirling light inside, floating in a bronze claw stand 22 cm tall. A band of glowing runes rings the stand's foot, and the orb can bob and spin.

models.name: Sea Anemone
models.description: Cluster of three sea anemones on a small reef rock, about 0.5 m across. Soft, fat tentacles in pink with purple tips, green with pink tips and orange, around short columns. The tentacles sway in the current.

models.name: Sea Stack
models.description: Limestone sea stack rising 25 m above the water, about 10 x 7 m at the base, with a 3.5 m stump beside it. Layered beds form ledges, a wave-cut notch runs round the base, with wet algae, black and orange lichen bands, bird streaks and a grass cap. Sea level is at the origin.

models.name: Sea Turtle
models.description: Green sea turtle, 1 m long. Olive brown shell with radiating amber streaks on every plate, scaled flippers and head with pale scale edges, cream underside. The clips swim in place.

models.name: Seabed Shells and Starfish
models.description: Six small seabed pieces for scattering, 7 to 25 cm: an orange starfish, a spiny black sea urchin, a closed and an open clam shell, a knobbed conch and a small yellow vase sponge. Wet, clean surfaces with natural shell patterns.

models.name: Seagrass Patch
models.description: Patch of ribbon seagrass about 1 m across, with long, narrow green blades 30 to 70 cm long rising from the sand and leaning with the current. Older blades fade to brown at the tips. Light enough to scatter in hundreds.

models.name: Sealed Parchment Scroll
models.description: A rolled parchment scroll about 25 cm long, tied and closed with a red wax seal.

models.name: Sedge Tuft
models.description: A sedge tuft about 0.5 m tall: a fountain of narrow keeled leaves with brown spikelets on thin three-angled stems, a few dry leaves among them.

models.name: Semi Truck and Trailer
models.description: Generic long-nose tractor unit with a sleeper cab and a 13.6 m box semi-trailer, about 19.8 m long, 2.55 m wide and 4.2 m tall. Deep blue tractor with chrome stacks, tanks and grille, a plain white trailer with aluminium rails, light road grime.

models.name: Automated Sentry Turret
models.description: Original automated sentry turret about 2 m tall on a folding tripod, with a cable to a small power unit. Worn olive paint and dark gunmetal, a sensor block with camera lenses, twin barrels and a side ammo box with a feed chute.

models.name: Server Room
models.description: Office server room, 6 x 4 m with a glazed front and a steel door. Two rows of black 42U racks with glass doors and blinking status lights stand on a raised floor under ladder cable trays, with a cooling unit and a red sprinkler pipe. One floor tile is lifted to show the void.

models.name: Wheeled Service Droid
models.description: Original wheeled service robot about 1.5 m tall, with a humanoid upper body on a rounded drive base. Clean white shell with grey joints, a black visor screen on a rounded head, a serving tray at the front and two arms with three-finger hands.

models.name: Service Pistol
models.description: Semi-automatic service pistol, about 19 cm long, an original generic design. A black polymer frame with an accessory rail and stippled grip, a nitrided steel slide with angled serrations and three-dot sights.

models.name: Sewer Tunnel Kit
models.description: Six 4 m pieces of an old brick barrel-vault sewer, 3.5 m wide: straight, T junction, corner, dead end with an outflow grate, ladder shaft to a manhole and a side pipe outlet. Damp, sooty brick, a central water channel between two walkways, caged wall lamps.

models.name: Shaggy Area Rug
models.description: A 1.6 x 2.3 m cream shag rug with a deep pile of long soft yarn tufts. The tufts lean in slow swirls and spill over the edges onto the floor.

models.name: Sheep
models.description: Woolly white sheep, 0.75 m at the shoulder and 1.2 m long, polled. Thick lumpy cream fleece with a darker belly, bare black face, long drooping ears and black legs. Walk and trot play in place: move it at 1.0 m/s walking and 2.5 m/s trotting.

models.name: Sheepskin Rug
models.description: A 0.6 x 0.9 m natural sheepskin with an irregular hide outline. Soft long curly wool in off white, spilling over the edges, with one leg of the hide curling up.

models.name: Open Sheer Linen Curtains
models.description: A pair of sheer cream linen curtains drawn open on a black iron pole, about 2 m wide and 2.4 m tall. The thin, see-through cloth gathers at each end in soft uneven folds to the floor.

models.name: Sheriff's Office and Jail
models.description: Small frontier sheriff's office and jail, 7 x 9 m with its boardwalk and hitching rail. A sun-bleached brick front with a corbelled parapet and sandstone lintels, faded oxblood board-and-batten sides and a tin roof. Inside are the office with a desk and an empty rifle rack, and two barred cells.

models.name: Ship Anchor and Chain
models.description: A 2.5 m stockless ship's anchor lying flat on the seabed with 6 m of heavy stud-link chain curving away from it. Rusted dark brown and crusted with barnacles, pink coralline patches and small sponges, half settled into the silt.

models.name: Shipping Container Set
models.description: A 20 ft and a 40 ft ISO shipping container, 2.44 m wide and 2.59 m tall, as separate objects. Corrugated steel in faded red and faded blue with dust, grime and rust on worn edges, corner castings and locking bars, and no text or codes.

models.name: 20 ft Shipping Container
models.description: A 20 ft ISO shipping container, about 6.1 m long, 2.44 m wide and 2.59 m tall. Corrugated steel in faded paint with dust, grime and rust on worn edges, corner castings and locking bars on the double doors, and no text or codes.

models.name: 40 ft Shipping Container
models.description: A 40 ft ISO shipping container, about 12.2 m long, 2.44 m wide and 2.59 m tall. Corrugated steel in faded paint with dust, grime and rust on worn edges, corner castings and locking bars on the double doors, and no text or codes.

models.name: Shipwreck Bow
models.description: Bow section of a sunken 40 m steel cargo ship, 13 m long, sitting upright in the silt. Rusted plating holed through to a dark hold, a raised forecastle with a windlass, all crusted with barnacles, sponges and coral. Lines up with the midship and stern sections.

models.name: Shipwreck Midship
models.description: Midship section of a sunken 40 m steel cargo ship, 13 m long, sitting upright in the silt. Two open holds with fallen hatch boards, a broken mast and its toppled top across the deck, rusted plating holed through and crusted with marine growth. Lines up with the bow and stern sections.

models.name: Shipwreck Stern
models.description: Stern section of a sunken 40 m steel cargo ship, 13 m long, sitting upright in the silt. A gutted two-deck wheelhouse with a leaning funnel, the propeller and a rudder jammed hard over, all rusted and crusted with marine growth. Lines up with the midship section.

models.name: Shopping Trolleys
models.description: Supermarket shopping trolley set: a wire trolley about 1 m long and 1 m to the handle, a nested row of five and a stack of five plastic hand baskets. Chrome tube frames with wire mesh baskets, red handle grips, bumpers and baskets, and grey swivel casters.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Lake Shore Stones
models.description: Cluster of rounded, water-worn granite stones at a lake shore, about 3 x 2 m, with boulders up to 1 m. Wet and dark with brown algae below the water line, dry grey with lichen spots above it. The water level is at the origin height.

models.name: Short Hanging Vine
models.description: A short leafy vine about 3 m long that hangs from its top. Heart-shaped glossy leaves end in a curled growing tip.

models.name: Short Stone Lantern on Rock
models.description: Short granite garden lantern about 0.9 m tall set on a rough fieldstone, weathered with lichen and moss on its cap. The firebox glows at night.

models.name: Showa Koi
models.description: A single koi carp about 0.6 m long, its body bent mid-stroke. Showa pattern: a black body with red and white patches.

models.name: Corner Shower Enclosure
models.description: A 0.9 by 0.9 m corner shower enclosure, 2 m tall, on a low slate stone tray. Clear toughened glass with a light limescale haze, a hinged door, chrome fittings, a thermostatic mixer with a rain head and hand shower, and stone effect wall boards.

models.name: Shrink-Wrapped Cash Brick
models.description: A brick of ten banknote bundles sealed in wrinkled clear shrink film, 16 x 14 x 7 cm. Plain green-tinted notes with no text or currency design.

models.name: Signal Box
models.description: A two storey railway signal box, 6.4 x 3.8 m, in red brick below and cream timber above. The operating floor is glazed along the track side under a hipped slate roof, with coloured levers, block instruments and a desk inside; a timber stair climbs to the door.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Silage Bales
models.description: Group of five round silage bales in stretch film, each 1.2 m across and 1.2 m long. Three lie end to end and two stand stacked, in white and pale green film with overlapping wrap bands, pleated ends, a few tears with hay showing, soil and green algae near the ground.
models.changes: Rebuilt: sagging bales with flattened contact faces, overlapping film bands, net wrap, pleated ends, tears, algae and a pale green variant.

models.name: Silver Birch
models.description: Mature silver birch, about 16 m tall, with white papery bark that turns black and fissured at the base, weeping outer twigs and an airy crown of small triangular leaves.

models.name: Silver Cup Trophy
models.description: Silver cup trophy about 49 cm tall: a deep bowl with a rolled lip and handles on a knopped stem, standing on a black plinth. Plain, with no text.

models.name: Single Traffic Mirror Post
models.description: Orange convex traffic mirror 80 cm across on a steel post about 3.9 m tall. Sun-faded paint with grime streaks, a hooded frame and a dusty stainless mirror face.

models.name: Site Cabin Stack
models.description: Two stacked 6 x 2.5 m steel site cabins with an external stair and landing, about 9.6 m wide with the toilet block beside them. Grey ribbed walls on dark frames, roller shutters over the windows, air conditioner units and floodlights, with dust, rust runs and mud splash.

models.name: Site Hoarding Kit
models.description: Construction site boundary kit: 2.4 m painted plywood hoarding, 3.5 m mesh fence panels on rubber feet with clamps, a 4.8 m double vehicle gate and a pedestrian gate. Blank green boards on timber framing with scuffs and mud splash, galvanised mesh and steel posts.

models.name: Site Hoarding Pedestrian Gate
models.description: Plywood hoarding piece 2.4 m long with a 1 m pedestrian door that opens, blank green boards on timber framing with scuffs and mud splash. Lines up with the hoarding panels.

models.name: Site Hoarding Vehicle Gate
models.description: Double vehicle gate 4.8 m wide for a construction site, two leaves of green painted boards on steel frames that swing open between steel posts. Fits the plywood hoarding line.

models.name: Skate Bowl Corner
models.description: An inside corner of a 1.2 m deep concrete skate bowl on a 4 by 4 m footprint. A precast pool coping turns the corner over a band of blue tiles.

models.name: Skate Flat Rail
models.description: A round steel grind rail 3.2 m long and 38 cm high on a concrete pad. The rail kinks down into posts at both ends, set on steel base plates.

models.name: Skate Funbox
models.description: A cast concrete skate funbox 8 m long with a 0.5 m high flat top and a bank at each end. Steel angle protects the long top edges for grinds.

models.name: Skate Half Pipe
models.description: A cast concrete skate half pipe 4 m wide and 8 m long with two 1.2 m transitions facing each other over a flat bottom. Each lip carries galvanised steel coping and a 0.8 m deck.

models.name: Skate Helmet
models.description: A round skate helmet about 26 cm long, resting on its rim with the chin straps lying open on the ground. Shell with vents, a foam liner and a side release buckle.

models.name: Skate Quarter Pipe
models.description: A cast concrete skate quarter pipe 4 m wide and 1.3 m tall with a smooth 2 m radius transition. Galvanised steel coping runs along the lip in front of a 0.8 m deck.

models.name: Skate Stair Set
models.description: A concrete skate stair set 4 m wide with six steps down from a 1.2 m landing. Steel edged hubba ledges run down both sides and a round handrail runs down the centre.

models.name: Walking Skeleton
models.description: Walking human skeleton, 1.75 m tall, in aged ivory bone. Every bone is modelled, from the skull and jaw to the fingers and feet. Animated idle, walk, wave and look around, sharing the people models' skeleton.

models.name: Ski Boots
models.description: A pair of white hard shell ski boots, about 34 cm tall, standing side by side. Four buckles on each, red power straps and dark liners at the cuff.

models.name: Ski Lodge
models.description: Alpine ski lodge, 12 x 20 m, with a fieldstone ground floor under dark stained timber and a steep roof deep in snow. A glazed front gable looks over a raised sun deck with railings and stairs, beside a ski rack and a stone chimney.

models.name: Ski Poles
models.description: A pair of aluminium ski poles, 1.25 m long, lying side by side. Black grips with wrist straps, red caps and small powder baskets.

models.name: Skis in Snow
models.description: A pair of white skis stuck upright in a small snow drift, splayed into a V and about 1.7 m tall.

models.name: Skyscraper Kit
models.description: Modular glass and steel tower kit on a 24 x 24 m footprint: a 7.2 m glazed lobby with a revolving door and canopy, a 3.6 m office floor, a louvred plant floor, a terrace floor with a set-back glass line and a crown with roof plant and a mast. Pieces stack to any height.
models.changes: Far LOD keeps the full facade (colour, depth, lit windows) on a clean low shell; facades weather with grime toward the ground and rain streaks; lit windows read as dark glass by day.

models.name: Slate Foam Exercise Mat
models.description: Slate grey foam exercise mat 1.85 m long rolled out flat, with a fine embossed grip and pressed patches where hands and feet go.

models.name: Sledgehammer
models.description: A 90 cm sledgehammer with a long hickory handle, lying flat. The heavy steel head is chipped and rusty at the edges, and the handle is stained where it is held.

models.name: Sleigh
models.description: Classic wooden sleigh, 2.4 m long, with a red curved body and curled steel-shod runners. Glossy red lacquer with gold pinstripes, a button-tufted green bench, black scrolled runners and two shafts for one reindeer or horse. Light snow lies in the corners.

models.name: Small Granite Pebble
models.description: Small rounded granite pebble about 10 cm across, speckled grey, with a wet lower part below a soft water mark.

models.name: Small Metallic Asteroid
models.description: Small metallic asteroid chunk about 2 m long, dense iron-nickel rock with a dark, pitted, faintly shiny surface. Centred on its origin.

models.name: Small Orange Pumpkin
models.description: A small ribbed orange pumpkin about 21 cm across with a dry curved stem. A harvest and Halloween decoration for porches and markets.

models.name: Small Sandstone Pebble
models.description: Small, smooth grey sandstone pebble about 14 cm long and 6 cm thick, dry and water-worn.

models.name: Small Stone Figure with Red Bib
models.description: A little weathered stone guardian figure, about 0.4 m tall, wearing a faded red cloth bib. Figures like it stand beside roadside shrines and along temple paths.

models.name: Small White Pumpkin
models.description: A small ribbed white pumpkin about 18 cm across with a dry stem. A pale harvest decoration for porches and autumn displays.

models.name: Smart Speaker
models.description: A round fabric smart speaker, 15 cm tall and 10 cm across. A matte top carries touch dots and a glowing blue light ring.

models.name: Smartphone
models.description: A slab smartphone, 15 cm tall and 7.8 mm thin, standing upright. Flat sided grey metal frame, slate blue frosted back with a glossy raised camera island holding three lenses and a flash; the blank screen is ready for an image or video.

models.name: Snake Plant in Concrete Pot
models.description: A snake plant in a plain grey concrete pot about 21 cm wide, with tall upright sword shaped leaves banded in dark and pale green with yellow edges.

models.name: Snow Groomer
models.description: Red piste groomer, about 9 m long from blade to finisher mat, on wide rubber belt tracks with aluminium cleats. A glazed cab with a roof light bar sits ahead of the engine, with a winged front blade and a rear tiller with a comb mat.

models.name: Snow Marker Pole
models.description: A roadside snow marker pole 2 m tall that shows the road edge in deep snow. Banded orange red and black with a white reflective sleeve and a black cap, leaning a little toward the road, sun faded and grimy low down.

models.name: Snow Marker Poles
models.description: Pair of roadside snow marker poles, 2.0 m tall and 1.6 m apart, that show the road edge in deep snow. Banded orange-red and black with a white reflective sleeve and a black cap. Both lean a little; sun-faded, scuffed and grimy low down.

models.name: Snow Pusher Shovel
models.description: Snow pusher shovel with a 0.66 m wide blue plastic blade and a 1.1 m aluminium shaft with a D-grip. The curved blade has back ribs and a riveted steel wear strip. It stands leaning back about 15 degrees, as if against a wall.

models.name: Snow-Viewing Stone Lantern
models.description: Three-legged snow-viewing lantern of weathered granite about 1.5 m tall, with a wide, low umbrella roof gathering moss. The firebox glows at night.

models.name: Ploughed Snowbank
models.description: Ploughed snow ridge along a road, 6 m long and about 1.2 m high. A steep blade-cut road face with layered plough lines, grit and slush staining low down, broken lumps on the crest, ice clods in the windrow at its foot and a lumpy back. Place copies 6 m apart.
models.changes: Rebuilt: layered blade-cut face, crest lumps, ice clods and slush at the foot, grit staining and an irregular back.

models.name: Snowboard
models.description: A teal and black striped snowboard, 1.55 m long, lying flat with two strap bindings. Each binding has a curved highback and ankle and toe straps.

models.name: Snowman
models.description: Snowman of three packed snow balls, 1.6 m tall to the top of an old bucket hat. Lumpy snow with leaves and dirt picked up on the lower balls, coal eyes and buttons, a carrot nose, stick arms, a red and cream knitted scarf and a dented galvanized bucket.

models.name: Snowmobile
models.description: Generic trail snowmobile, 3.2 m long. Black hood with teal panels, a windscreen, twin steering skis, a two-up seat with a grab rail and an aluminium tunnel over a lugged rubber track.

models.name: Snowy Granite Boulder
models.description: Granite boulder about 1.5 m across under a thick, rounded cap of snow, with windblown snow plastered on one side. The snow on the windward side faces front left (glTF -X, +Z). Origin at ground level; about 0.2 m sits below the ground line.

models.name: Snowy Scots Pine
models.description: Snow-covered pine, about 12 m tall, with its orange upper bark showing. Rounded clumps of snow lie on the flat upper crown and the branch whorls and sway with the needles under them.

models.name: Snowy Norway Spruce
models.description: Snow-laden spruce, about 10 m tall, with a snow cap on its top. Rounded clumps of heavy snow lie on the drooping branches and sway with the needles under them.

models.name: Pair of Soda Crates
models.description: Two stacked plastic soft drink crates, a green one full of bottles on a grey one, about 0.4 m tall. Scuffed from street use.

models.name: Wooden Frame Sofa
models.description: Two-seat sofa, 1.6 m wide, 0.8 m deep and 0.86 m tall, in a simple Nordic cabin style. A pine frame with flat arm boards and slatted sides and back, and four loose cushions in heathered grey wool.

models.name: Solar Array Truss
models.description: A 20 m lattice truss segment for a space station, with two long solar array wings on rotating gimbals and two folding white radiators. Its end ports match the Space Station Modules set, so it docks between any two of them.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Solar Farm Block
models.description: Ground-mounted solar table of 40 dark mono-crystalline panels, 4 high and 10 wide (about 20 m), on a row of steel posts. The whole table tilts on its tube. Includes an inverter cabinet on a plinth, a cable tray and a chain-link fence section with barbed wire.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sourdough Boule
models.description: A round sourdough loaf, 20 cm across and 10 cm tall. A deep curved score opens into a dark ear on a blistered, crackled crust flecked with flour.

models.name: Sourdough Half Loaf
models.description: Half of a round sourdough loaf, 20 cm across and 10 cm tall, cut open to show its crumb. The pale, open crumb has irregular holes under a dark blistered crust.

models.name: Space Station Airlock
models.description: Space station airlock module about 4.3 m long with an EVA hatch that opens, handrails, shield plates and gold foil. Docks to the other station modules through its common port.

models.name: Space Station Docking Node
models.description: Spherical space station docking node about 4 m across with six docking ports, bolted shield plates, handrails and gold foil. All ports share one size so modules join in any direction.

models.name: Space Station Habitat Module
models.description: Cylindrical space station habitat module about 8.4 m long with bolted shield plates, handrails, payload boxes, line bundles and gold foil. Its ports dock end to end with the other station modules.

models.name: Winged Spaceplane
models.description: Original small reusable winged spaceplane, about 9 m long with a cranked delta wing and a single fin. White quilted blankets on top, black heat-shield tiles underneath, a dark nose cap and leading edges, three engine bells and its landing gear down.

models.name: Specimen Jar Shelf
models.description: A steel shelf of preserved specimens, 0.9 m wide and 1.8 m tall. Glass jars of amber, green, red and clear fluid hold brains, coiled snakes, small octopuses and pale tissue.

models.name: Specimen Stasis Tank
models.description: An upright glass specimen tank, 2.2 m tall and 0.84 m across, on a lit pedestal. Hoses arch from its cap to a life support cabinet behind it. The tank stands empty, ready for a game to put something inside.

models.name: Speed Bag Stand
models.description: A speed bag platform on a black steel stand about 2 m tall. A small leather speed bag hangs under the round wooden rebound board and swings on its swivel.

models.name: Speed Limit Sign (80)
models.description: Round 600 mm European-style speed limit sign showing 80, aluminium blank with folded rim and retroreflective face, bare aluminium back with hat-section rails and strap clamps on a 60 mm galvanized tube post. Lower edge 1.75 m above ground; origin at ground level on the post axis, face toward +Z.

models.name: Speedboat
models.description: Open-bow sport boat 8 m long with a deep-V hull and twin outboard engines. White gelcoat with a navy stripe, a curved walk-through windscreen, bucket seats at the helm, a rear bench, teak-look floor and swim platforms with a boarding ladder.

models.name: Spherical Hover Sentry Drone
models.description: An original spherical hover sentry drone about 0.65 m across, with one glowing lens eye and stub fins. Olive-grey composite shell with dark carbon parts and navigation lights.

models.name: Open Cash Duffel Bag
models.description: A black nylon duffel bag, 66 cm long, lying open on its side with banded cash bundles heaped inside and spilled across the floor in front. The lining is bright orange.

models.name: Split Firewood Stack
models.description: A small stack of thirteen split logs, about 0.6 m wide and 0.5 m tall. Rough bark on the outside and pale split faces and end grain on the cut sides.

models.name: Split Granite Boulder
models.description: A low granite boulder about 2.1 m long, split across by an open joint. Pinkish tan granite with dark patina and lichen, with a few tufts of dry grass at its foot.

models.name: Split Leaf Monstera
models.description: A split leaf monstera about 1.3 m tall for jungle floors and gardens. Broad glossy heart-shaped leaves, deeply cut and pierced with rows of holes, arch out on long stalks.

models.name: Spooky Dead Tree
models.description: Dead, leafless broadleaf tree, about 7 m tall, with a gnarled trunk and long reaching bare branches. The burly grey-black trunk has a dark hollow at its foot and splits low into twisting limbs that end in fine twigs. Branches and twigs carry _WIND data. Origin on the ground at the base of the trunk.

models.name: Sport Motorcycle
models.description: Generic full-fairing 1000 cc-class sport motorcycle, 2.05 m long. Pearl white with graphite and copper accents, a twin-lamp nose, clip-on bars, an alloy beam frame, braced swingarm, twin drilled front discs and an underseat exhaust, lightly road-dusted.

models.name: Spreading Thornbush
models.description: A low, wide African thornbush about 0.9 m tall and 2.4 m across. Thorny zigzag stems lean out from the base under tiny dusty olive leaves.

models.name: Square Hand Hole Cover
models.description: Small square utility hand hole cover about 0.46 m across, set flush in a sidewalk. Plain anti-slip surface.

models.name: Square Straw Bale
models.description: A small square straw bale, 1 m long, with rounded pressed edges, visible flake seams and two sisal twine bands. Loose straws stick out of its sides.

models.name: Stacked Marble Ovoid Sculpture
models.description: A modern sculpture of three smooth white marble ovoids stacked on a limestone block, 1.45 m tall overall.

models.name: Stacked Shopping Baskets
models.description: Stack of five red plastic shopping hand baskets with steel handles folded down, about 45 cm long and 41 cm tall, ready at a store entrance.

models.name: Stacked Terracotta Pots
models.description: Empty clay flower pots nested in a stack, with one more lying on its side, about 0.6 m across. Plain terracotta with dirt stains and chipped rims.

models.name: Staghorn Coral
models.description: Branching staghorn coral about 0.9 m across and 0.75 m tall, a thicket of antler-like branches with pale growing tips.

models.name: Long Stainless Prep Table
models.description: A stainless steel kitchen prep table with a back splash, 180 by 76 cm at 90 cm work height. Brushed top with folded edges, an undershelf, round tube legs and adjustable bullet feet.

models.name: Short Stainless Prep Table
models.description: A stainless steel kitchen prep table, 90 by 76 cm at 90 cm work height. Brushed top with folded edges, an undershelf, round tube legs and adjustable bullet feet.

models.name: Stainless Saucepan
models.description: Stainless steel saucepan 16 cm across with a long handle, about 32 cm long overall. Brushed steel with spun rings.

models.name: Stainless Stock Pot with Lid
models.description: Stainless steel stock pot 22 cm across with two handles and a fitted lid that lifts off. Brushed steel with spun rings, for a hob or kitchen shelf.

models.name: Stainless Wall Hand Sink
models.description: A wall mounted stainless steel hand sink, 43 cm wide. A deep bowl with a splash, a chrome gooseneck tap with wrist blades, a drain and a P-trap into the wall. Its origin is on the wall at the bottom of the mounting edge.

models.name: Stainless Wall Shelf
models.description: A wall mounted stainless steel shelf, 120 by 30 cm, on two folded brackets. Brushed steel with fine scratches along the grain. Its origin is on the wall at the bottom of the brackets.

models.name: Standing Amphora
models.description: A terracotta transport amphora about 1 m tall, its pointed toe pushed into a small mound of earth. The clay shows firing clouds, a pale slip and lime crust.

models.name: Standing Bronze Figure
models.description: A slender standing bronze figure with a rough cast surface, on a limestone block, 2 m tall overall.

models.name: Standing Iron Brazier
models.description: A standing iron brazier about 1 m tall with a wide bowl heaped with glowing coals on three legs.

models.name: Star Tree Topper
models.description: Gold star tree topper, 20 cm across, pressed from metal with sharp faceted rays and a crimped rim. A ring of small warm bulbs glows on its face, and a coiled spring below slips over the top branch of a tree.

models.name: Start Light Gantry
models.description: Race start light gantry, a steel box truss across a 15 m track at 6 m, on two round posts. A central box holds five columns of red lamps over five green lamps, all under sun visors and facing the grid. The lamps are built lit and can be switched one by one.

models.name: Station Entrance Canopy
models.description: A 10 m street-level subway station entrance: a steel and glass canopy over a stairway and a down escalator that lead 3.6 m below the street. Granite upstands, tiled walls, a lit blank signboard, downlights and a row of bike racks beside it.

models.name: Space Station Modules
models.description: A modular space station set: an 8 m habitat module, a spherical docking node with six ports and an airlock with an EVA hatch. All ports share one size, so pieces dock end to end in any combination. Bolted shield plates, handrails, payload boxes, line bundles and gold foil.

models.name: Station Platform
models.description: A 12 m section of concrete railway platform, 3.5 m deep and 1.19 m high, with an overhanging edge and a yellow safety line. A small timber shelter with a bench and a blank sign board on two posts stand on it. Sections chain end to end, edge toward the track.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Stealth Fighter
models.description: Original single-seat stealth fighter jet, about 17.7 m long with an 11.7 m wingspan, in dark grey. A faceted chined body with a cranked arrow wing, steeply canted twin fins, arrow-shaped tailplanes, light-lined side intakes, a gold-tinted canopy and light service wear.

models.name: Steam Locomotive
models.description: A 13.6 m express steam locomotive with a 4-6-2 wheel arrangement, big spoked driving wheels and outside cylinders. Deep green with black and brass, smoke deflectors and light road grime. Standard gauge; couples to the matching tender and its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Steam Pipe Run
models.description: A lagged steam pipe running along the foot of a wall, with flanges, a hand valve and a vent stack rising up. Rusty and streaked with grime.

models.name: Street Steam Stack
models.description: Orange and white striped street steam vent chimney, 1.55 m tall, on a cast-iron manhole cover. A banded plastic tube on a conical funnel, as set up over road works, with soot streaks from the rim and road grime at the foot. The steam itself is not included.

models.name: Locomotive Tender
models.description: An 8.7 m coal tender for a steam locomotive, with a heaped coal space and a water filler. The riveted deep green tank has a flared top and rides on two spoked four-wheel bogies. Standard gauge; its front couples to the matching steam locomotive.

models.name: Steel Canteen
models.description: A steel water canteen about 27 cm tall in a felt sleeve, with a ribbed screw cap on a short chain. The steel is scuffed and the felt is worn at the edges.

models.name: Steel Crowd Control Barrier
models.description: Galvanized steel crowd control barrier 2.4 m long and 1.1 m tall on bridge feet, with hooks to chain it to the next one. Plain, with street grime.

models.name: Teal Steel Oil Drum
models.description: 200 litre steel oil drum, 0.58 m across and 0.88 m tall. Rolled chimes, two rolling hoops and a recessed lid with bung and vent caps. Worn blue-green paint with rust at the edges, bare steel scrapes, rust streaks and a few dents.

models.name: Rusty Red Steel Drum
models.description: Rusty dark red 200 litre steel oil drum, 0.58 m across and 0.88 m tall. The same shape as the Steel Oil Drum. Dark oxide red paint with heavy rust at the chimes, hoops and lid, bare steel scrapes, rust streaks and a few dents.

models.name: Yellow Steel Drum
models.description: Faded yellow 200 litre steel drum, 0.58 m across and 0.88 m tall. The same shape as the Steel Oil Drum. Sun-faded safety yellow paint with chalky patches, rust at the chimes, hoops and lid, bare steel scrapes and a few dents.

models.name: Galvanized Field Gate
models.description: Galvanized steel tubular field gate, 4 m wide and 1.1 m tall, about 4.3 m with its posts. Five bars set closer near the ground and a diagonal brace, on a round hinge post with a latch post. Dull zinc with white rust streaks and soil splash.

models.name: Steel Great Helm
models.description: A flat-topped steel great helm 35 cm tall with eye slits and a riveted cross on the face. Breathing holes pierce the lower right side.

models.name: Steel Milk Jug
models.description: A 600 ml stainless steel milk frothing jug, 11 cm tall, with a sharp pouring spout and a flat strap handle.

models.name: Steel Pallet Rack
models.description: Three bay steel pallet rack, about 8.3 m long, 1.2 m deep and 5 m tall, with three beam levels. Blue slotted uprights, orange beams, galvanized wire decks and yellow and black end protectors.

models.name: Steel Security Door
models.description: Industrial steel door, 1.0 x 2.2 m, in a pressed steel frame: scuffed grey enamel with dirt runs, chips and rust at the foot, a small wired-glass window, heavy barrel hinges and a lever with a lock cylinder outside, a red panic bar, kick plate and overhead closer inside.

models.name: Steel Truss Bridge
models.description: A 40 m steel through-truss road bridge with a two-lane deck, 48 m long over its concrete abutments. Grey riveted steel with laced members, light rust at the rivets and lane-marked asphalt between kerbs and railings. The road runs left to right.

models.name: Step-Cut Emerald
models.description: Rectangular step-cut emerald about 3 cm long with real flat facets and a clear green refractive material that deepens through the thicker parts of the stone.

models.name: Step-Through Shopping Bicycle
models.description: Step-through city shopping bicycle about 1.8 m long on a two-leg stand, with a wire front basket, mudguards, a chain case and a rear carrier.

models.name: Stepped River Embankment
models.description: A 20 m section of stepped city river embankment, about 13.5 m deep. Stained concrete toe wall, a railed waterside ledge, sitting steps up to a paved path with trees in planters and benches, and a railed flood wall, 6.6 m from river bed to street.

models.name: Stepped River Embankment with Stairs
models.description: A 20 m section of stepped river embankment that adds stairs down into the water and up to the street. Stained concrete toe wall, a railed waterside ledge, sitting steps up to a paved path with trees in planters and benches, and a railed flood wall, 6.6 m from river bed to street.

models.name: Still Life Oil Painting
models.description: An old master style still life oil painting, 60 by 50 cm, in an ornate gilded frame. Apples, pears, grapes and a pewter jug sit on a table with a draped cloth, lit warmly against a dark background.

models.name: Stone Arch Bridge
models.description: A three-arch granite road bridge, 36 m long and 7 m wide, carrying a narrow country road 6.6 m above the river bed. Rock-faced ashlar with dressed voussoirs, coped parapets, pointed cutwaters rising to refuges and damp, algae-stained bases.

models.name: Stone Chapel
models.description: Small Romanesque stone chapel, about 14 x 8 m, with a slate gable roof, a round apse and a bell gable with two bells. Round-arched windows, pilaster strips with arched friezes and a stepped portal with a plank door that opens onto plastered walls, pews and a candlelit altar.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Stone Dais
models.description: A raised stone dais 3.2 m wide and 2.8 m deep, a 44 cm platform of flagstones with one step along its front.

models.name: Stone Face Totem
models.description: Totem pillar about 3.6 m tall of stacked carved faces on a square base. Original stylised design in weathered, mossy grey-green limestone.

models.name: Stone Feline Guardian
models.description: Weathered stone carving of a seated feline guardian on a plinth, about 2.5 m tall. Original stylised design in mossy grey-green limestone, for a jungle temple or ruin.

models.name: Stone Figure with Red Bib
models.description: A small weathered stone guardian figure, about 0.6 m tall, wearing a red knitted cap and a faded red cloth bib. Figures like it stand beside roadside shrines and along temple paths.

models.name: Stone Guardian Statues
models.description: Set of four weathered stone guardian carvings: a 2.5 m seated feline, a 3.5 m totem of stacked carved faces, a serpent-head balustrade end and a broken statue head half sunk in the ground. Original stylised designs in mossy grey-green limestone.

models.name: Stone Lantern Set
models.description: Four granite garden pieces up to 2.3 m tall: a tall hexagonal temple lantern, a short lantern on a fieldstone, a three-legged snow-viewing lantern and a water basin with a bamboo spout. Weathered stone with lichen and moss on the tops; the fireboxes glow at night.

models.name: Stone Serpent Head Balustrade End
models.description: Carved serpent head with bared fangs ending a sloped balustrade, about 2.8 m long and 1.3 m tall. Original stylised design in weathered, mossy limestone.

models.name: Dry-Stone Field Wall
models.description: Dry-stone field wall of rounded granite fieldstones, 3 m long, 0.8 m tall and 0.8 m wide. Two courses of face stones with a row of rounded stones on top, moss cushions on the top and pale lichen on the faces. Place sections every 3 m along X.

models.name: Stone Water Basin With Bamboo Spout
models.description: Granite water basin about 0.8 m tall with a bamboo spout feeding it, set among stones, about 1.6 m long overall. Weathered stone with moss.

models.name: Stack of Stoneware Plates
models.description: Stack of six glazed stoneware dinner plates, each about 25 cm across. Plain glazed plates for a kitchen table or dresser.

models.name: Stop Sign
models.description: Octagonal stop sign, 90 cm across, on a 2.4 m galvanized post. Red reflective face with a white edge and the word STOP in bold white capitals, on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back.

models.name: Storefront Base Module
models.description: Modular ground-floor shop front, 12 m wide and 6 m tall, for a downtown street. Lit shop windows on dark granite risers, a recessed glass door, a red fabric awning and a blank lit fascia sign under a stone band. The 12 m facade modules stack on top of it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Storm Lantern
models.description: Red hurricane (paraffin) lantern, 0.32 m tall with the handle up. A round fuel tank, two air tubes up to a vented hood, a brass burner, a clear glass globe in a wire guard and a wire bail. Red enamel with a few chips to bare tin and rust. The flame can be hidden.

models.name: Stormy Sea Oil Painting
models.description: A dramatic seascape oil painting, 90 by 60 cm, in a heavy gilded frame. Heavy waves break on dark rocks under a torn grey sky with a break of light.

models.name: Straddle Carrier
models.description: Container straddle carrier about 15.7 m tall, 11 m long and 5.7 m wide, stacking boxes one over three. Safety yellow legs and girders on eight steered rubber tyres, a high glazed corner cab, caged ladder and walkways, salt grime and rust streaks from yard work.

models.name: Strangler Fig
models.description: Giant strangler fig about 19 m tall with a crown 27 m across, for jungle scenes. Its grey trunk is a net of fused roots flaring into plank buttresses, braided pillar roots prop the great limbs, and curtains of aerial roots hang under a broad, dense crown of glossy leaves and small figs.

models.name: Straw Bale with Corn Stalks
models.description: Autumn porch display, 1.1 m wide and 1.9 m tall: a straw bale, a bundle of corn stalks and two pumpkins. A twine-bound bale, seven dry corn stalks with curled leaves tied against its back, and an orange and a white pumpkin. The stalks sway in the wind.

models.name: Straw Pallet Bed
models.description: A crude, low prison bed: a pallet of old grey oak planks with a lumpy straw-filled sack mattress and pillow, about 1.9 m long. Worn, dirty and damp.

models.name: Strawberry
models.description: A strawberry lying on its side, about 5 cm long with its stem. Glossy red flesh is studded with small seeds under a green leafy calyx.

models.name: Street Food Counter
models.description: A stainless street food counter about 2.8 m long, with gas burners and pots, as set up inside a night market tent bar.

models.name: Street Food Stall Cart
models.description: Wheeled street food stall about 2.3 m long with a red cloth canopy, a charcoal grill counter, a wooden customer counter and an indigo cloth banner. A big paper lantern, a bulb and the embers glow at night.

models.name: Street Gully Grate
models.description: Cast iron gully grating about 0.6 m wide over a storm drain pit at the road edge, with a concrete surround.

models.name: Street Lamp
models.description: Galvanized steel street lamp, 8 m tall, with a curved outreach arm and a flat LED luminaire. A tapered pole on a bolted flange plate and concrete footing, with a service door. The arm reaches 1.55 m out with a slight upward tilt.

models.name: Street Recycling Bin
models.description: Light blue bottle and can recycling bin about 1 m tall with two round openings, made to stand beside vending machines. Grimy and rusting at the foot.

models.name: Street Skateboard
models.description: A street skateboard 81 cm long and 20 cm wide, standing on its wheels. Seven ply maple deck with kicked nose and tail, black grip, alloy trucks with yellow bushings and hard white wheels.

models.name: Festoon String Lights
models.description: A 5 m string of twenty warm white globe bulbs hanging in two shallow swags between three wall hooks. A dark green cable with clip-on sockets every 25 cm and a plug at the start. The bulbs read lit at night.

models.name: Striped Lumbar Cushion
models.description: An oblong lumbar cushion in ecru woven cotton with ink blue and rust stripes, about 56 by 32 cm. Soft and full, with a light dent across the middle.

models.name: Small Submersible
models.description: A 4 m two-person research submersible in bright yellow, its crew seated in a clear acrylic sphere. Ducted thrusters with spinning props, a lamp bar ready to glow and a folded work arm; clean and in service, with light scuffs and grime.

models.name: Electrical Substation
models.description: Fenced 30 x 20 m high-voltage substation on a gravel pad. A lattice gantry takes the incoming line through disconnectors, breakers and porcelain insulators to two oil transformers with radiators and bushings, split by a fire wall. A control kiosk, floodlights and a double gate complete it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Subway Stair Entrance
models.description: Subway stair entrance set into the pavement, a 4.0 x 1.8 m opening with stairs dropping 3 m to a landing under the street. Green painted iron railings with two globe lamps on posts, white tiled walls and a blank sign plate. The ground around it needs a matching hole.

models.name: Sugar Maple
models.description: Mature sugar maple, about 18 m tall, with a dense, rounded crown of palmate leaves on a grey, furrowed trunk. It carries two foliage sets on the same branches, summer green and autumn orange-red: show one of them.

models.name: Sun Lounger
models.description: A white slatted sun lounger, 1.9 m long and 0.68 m wide, with its backrest raised. Painted hardwood worn through to grey timber on the edges, two wheels at the head end and a folded striped beach towel on the seat.

models.name: Sunburst Electric Guitar
models.description: Double-cutaway solid-body electric guitar about 1 m long with a sunburst finish, maple neck, rosewood fretboard and two humbuckers. Shown upright as if on a stand.

models.name: Sunflower
models.description: A single tall sunflower about 1.9 m high. Its large head with a spiralled seed disc and golden petals faces forward above rough leaves that dry out low on the stem.

models.name: Sunflower Patch
models.description: A patch of fifteen tall sunflowers about 2 m high, covering about 3 by 2 m. Heavy heads with spiralled seed discs and golden petals face the same side above rough leaves that dry out low on the stem.

models.name: Sunken Broken Column
models.description: The lower part of a fluted classical column snapped off about 2.2 m up, standing on the seabed. Pale stone pitted and crusted with algae, sponges and silt.

models.name: Sunken Fallen Column
models.description: A classical fluted column fallen on the seabed and broken into drums, about 4 m long and 1 m high. Pale stone pitted and crusted with algae, sponges and silt.

models.name: Sunken Fluted Column
models.description: A whole classical fluted stone column standing on the seabed, about 4 m tall and 1.1 m wide at its base and capital. Pale stone pitted and crusted with algae, sponges and silt.

models.name: Sunken Stone Ruins
models.description: Weathered classical stone columns and a small arch lying in ruins on the seabed. Each piece stands alone, from a whole fluted column to one snapped short and another fallen in drums, the pale stone pitted and crusted with algae, sponges and silt.

models.name: Sunken Stone Arch
models.description: A small classical stone arch on two piers, about 3.4 m wide and 3.6 m tall, standing alone on the seabed. Pale stone pitted and crusted with algae, sponges and silt.

models.name: Mid-Engine Supercar
models.description: Modern mid-engine supercar, 4.6 m long and 2.06 m wide, in pearl orange. A faceted wedge body with scissor doors, deep side intakes, Y-graphic head and tail lamps, a glass engine cover over the V12 and hexagonal grilles and exhaust, on staggered Y-spoke wheels with red calipers.
models.changes: Rebuilt faceted body with opening panels, Y-graphic head and tail lamps, a glass engine cover, honeycomb grilles and new Y-spoke wheels with red calipers.

models.name: Supermarket Building
models.description: Single-storey supermarket building, 30 x 20 m and 4.6 m to the parapet, with an empty interior ready to fit out. A glazed shopfront with sliding doors under a canopy, ribbed grey cladding on a brick plinth, a blank green fascia, ceiling panel lights and a stockroom with a loading door.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Surfboard
models.description: A 2.1 m shortboard with three fins, lying deck up on the sand. Pale yellowed resin with a teal rail stripe, a visible wooden stringer, a grooved tail pad, rubbed wax over the deck and a coiled leash.

models.name: Mid-Size SUV
models.description: Generic five-seat mid-size crossover SUV, 4.65 m long and 1.88 m wide, in dark metallic red. A tall rounded nose, rising beltline, black wheel-arch cladding, roof rails and 18 inch wheels. Wheels and the left-hand-drive steering wheel turn.

models.name: Swamp Root Tangle
models.description: A tangle of wet roots about 3 m across, snaking in and out of the mud and looping over each other. Dark brown bark, muddy where it meets the ground.

models.name: Swamp Shack
models.description: Weathered 5 x 4 m board-and-batten cabin on stilts above swamp water, with a rusty corrugated tin roof running out over a small front porch. Steps lead down to a plank walkway.

models.name: Chain Swing Ride
models.description: A 15 m chain swing ride with 24 single seats hanging from a red and white striped canopy. The scalloped skirt, crown and base drum carry painted diamonds and bulbs; a round ride floor, a fenced queue ring and an operator booth sit around it.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Sword Scabbard
models.description: Medieval sword scabbard, 0.82 m long, sized for the Arming Sword. Dark leather over a wooden core with a steel throat and chape, two strap bands and a belt strap with a D-ring and buckle.

models.name: Table Coral
models.description: Flat table coral about 1.1 m across on a short stalk, 0.6 m tall, with a broad plate of fine branches and a pale growing rim.

models.name: Table Lamp
models.description: Table lamp, 0.5 m tall, with a turned wooden base and a pleated linen shade. An oiled birch column on a round foot, a brass lamp holder and a braided fabric cord with a plug trailing from the back. The bulb glows.

models.name: Tablet Computer
models.description: A 25 cm tablet computer in silver aluminium, docked in landscape on a folding graphite aluminium desk stand. Thin even bezels, rounded edges, a single rear camera and rubber pads on the stand; the blank screen is ready for an image or video.

models.name: Tactical Flashlight
models.description: Tactical flashlight, 15 cm long, in black anodized aluminium. A knurled body, a finned head with a notched strike bezel, a clear lens over a smooth reflector and LED, a pocket clip and a rubber tail switch.

models.name: Takeaway Coffee Cup
models.description: A 13 cm paper takeaway coffee cup with a black snap on sip lid and a plain kraft sleeve with no print.

models.name: Tall Glass Display Case
models.description: A museum vitrine 2 m tall and 62 cm square: a glass case with a glass shelf on a white cabinet, under a canopy with warm light strips. The case is empty.

models.name: Tall Hexagonal Stone Lantern
models.description: Tall hexagonal temple lantern of weathered granite about 2.4 m high, with lichen and moss on the roof. The firebox glows at night.

models.name: Tall Stoneware Vase
models.description: A tall stoneware vase about 42 cm high, with a full rounded belly and a narrow neck. Speckled brown glaze that thins to bare clay at the rim and foot.

models.name: Tall Tin Can
models.description: A sealed tin can about 11 cm tall with a plain cream label, scuffed and water stained, torn back to bare tin at one corner.

models.name: Tandem-Rotor Heavy Helicopter
models.description: Heavy-lift tandem-rotor helicopter, 16 m fuselage and about 31 m long with both 18.2 m three-blade rotors. Slate over pale grey with an amber stripe, a chined cargo cabin, an engine spine rising into the rear pylon and four wheels in short sponsons. The ramp lowers and the crew door opens.

models.name: Tape Measure
models.description: A 5 m tape measure about 7 cm across, with a short length of yellow tape pulled out. The case is scuffed and grimy, and the tape has black tick marks without numbers.

models.name: Tavern Ale Barrel Rack
models.description: An oak cradle of five ale barrels, about 2 m long and 1.2 m high. Three barrels with wooden taps lie on the bottom tier and two rest on top, their staves held by iron hoops.

models.name: Tavern Bar Counter
models.description: A panelled oak tavern bar counter, 3 m long and 1.1 m high, with a polished top. A foot rail runs on iron brackets along the front, a shelf lines the bartender's side, and pewter tankards stand on both.

models.name: Tavern Beamed Ceiling
models.description: A 3 by 3 m bay of tavern ceiling: a chamfered oak beam and close-set joists under boards, with the upper floor on top at 3 m. It rests on the 2.75 m tavern walls.

models.name: Tavern Floorboards
models.description: A 3 by 3 m tile of worn oak floorboards for a tavern interior, with dark gaps between the boards. It snaps to the same 3 m grid as the tavern walls.

models.name: Tavern Oak Staircase
models.description: A straight oak staircase 1 m wide that climbs 3 m over a 3 m run. Newel posts, a handrail and square balusters guard its open side, and it reaches the upper floor of the tavern ceiling piece.

models.name: Tavern Timber Frame Wall
models.description: A 3 m section of timber framed tavern wall, 2.75 m high, with oak posts, studs and braces round limewashed plaster panels. A boarded oak wainscot runs along the bottom on both faces, and sections chain post to post.

models.name: Teal Potion Vial
models.description: A small glass vial of glowing teal brew, about 7 cm tall, under a red wax seal. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Race Team Transporter
models.description: Articulated race team transporter, 16.5 m long and 4.0 m tall: a cab-over tractor unit and a three-axle box trailer. White over deep blue colour blocks with a light blue pinstripe, a side door each side, skirt lockers and a tail lift folded up at the rear. No text or logos.

models.name: Tee Markers and Ball Washer
models.description: Two round blue tee markers, 15 cm across, and a 1.25 m ball washer post. Domed plastic markers with grass scuffs, and a dark green steel post with a plunger ball washer and a white terry towel hanging from a hook. Each piece can be placed on its own.

models.name: Telehandler
models.description: Generic 4 x 4 telescopic handler, about 5 m long to the fork carriage, 2.3 m wide and 2.5 m tall. Yellow body and three-section boom on a dark grey chassis, the cab on the left, pallet forks, front stabiliser legs and big lugged tyres, dusty and scuffed from site work.

models.name: Street Telephone Booth
models.description: Modern street telephone booth, about 1 by 1 m and 2.3 m tall, glazed on three sides with an open front under a canopy. Inside, a stainless payphone with a metal keypad and an armoured handset cord sits above a steel shelf, and a lit handset sign tops the roof.

models.name: Temporary Mesh Fence Panel
models.description: Temporary construction fence panel about 3.5 m long and 2.1 m tall, galvanised steel mesh in a tube frame standing on rubber feet, with clamps to join the next panel.

models.name: Tennis Ball
models.description: Tennis ball, 6.7 cm across, in optic yellow felt with the curved white seam. Fuzzy felt in two dog-bone shaped halves with fluffed edges at the seam and light court dust.

models.name: Tennis Court
models.description: Hard tennis court, 23.77 x 10.97 m doubles, with run-off to 36.6 x 18.3 m. Blue sand-textured acrylic inside a green surround, white lines at their real widths, and shoe scuffs and ball marks behind the baselines. The net is a separate model.

models.name: Tennis Net
models.description: Doubles tennis net, 0.914 m high at the centre, between two green 1.07 m posts 12.8 m apart. A black mesh net with a white canvas top band, a white centre strap, black side bands and a crank winder on one post.

models.name: Tennis Racket
models.description: Tennis racket, 68.5 cm long, standing upright on its butt. A gloss black graphite frame with an oval head and open throat, a 16 x 19 string bed, a scuffed bumper guard and a white overgrip with black finishing tape.

models.name: Cathedral Termite Mound
models.description: A cathedral termite mound of sun baked red clay, about 3.5 m tall. Fluted chimneys, some broken open into dark vents, rise from a buttressed base cut by rain runnels.

models.name: Test Tube Rack
models.description: A white plastic test tube rack, 21 cm long, with twelve holes holding seven glass test tubes. Most tubes hold a little red, blue, green, amber or clear liquid.

models.name: Thatching Grass Tussock
models.description: A tall tussock of dry thatching grass, about 1.5 m to the top of its seed heads. Straw and weathered grey blades arch out from a dense base under rusty, feathery heads.

models.name: Thick Glass Bowl
models.description: A wide bowl of thick clear glass with a faint green tint, about 28 cm across and 10 cm tall, on a small round foot.

models.name: Through-Wall ATM
models.description: A through-wall bank cash machine, 0.9 m wide and 1.2 m tall at the fascia, with its steel chest 0.87 m deep behind the wall. A glowing screen under a privacy hood, a sloped keypad, a card reader and a cash slot with green lights; it needs a wall opening to sit in.

models.name: Ticket Gate Row
models.description: A 6.4 m row of station fare gates: five ivory cabinets forming four aisles (one wide), with a staffed window booth at one end. Lit card reader pads, green and red entry lamps, orange flaps, a railing and a blank lit fare chart above the booth window. The flaps fold back into the cabinets.

models.name: Metro Ticket Hall
models.description: A 20 x 12 m underground metro ticket hall with a 3.6 m panel ceiling and lit strips. A line of stainless ticket gates with glass paddles crosses it between grey tiled walls with a blue band, with three ticket machines, a staffed kiosk, tiled columns and blank sign boxes.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Tied Burlap Sack
models.description: A full burlap sack 63 cm tall, its neck gathered and tied with rope. The coarse weave sags into soft folds.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Arched Wall
models.description: A 3 m pool hall wall, 4.05 m tall, with a round headed opening 1.6 m wide and 3.1 m to the crown. Pale glazed tile on both faces with a rounded tile nosing round the arch.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Ceiling
models.description: A 3 m square cell of flat pool hall ceiling in pale glazed tile. It hangs 4.0 m above its origin.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Floor
models.description: A 3 m square cell of pale grey glazed pool hall floor tile, 15 cm tiles with clean grout and a wet sheen. A small steel drain grate sits in the middle.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Pillar
models.description: A 0.5 m square tiled pier 4.05 m tall with rounded corners and aqua bands, for the grid nodes of a pool hall.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Pool Section
models.description: A 3 m square open pool cell: an aqua tiled pool bottom 0.6 m down with a dark lane line, under still water. It has no sides, so cells join into larger pools.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Pool Edge
models.description: A 3 m pool edge: a white tiled pool wall 0.6 m deep under a rounded bullnose coping, with a deep blue band at the water line and three handhold slots.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Pool Steps
models.description: A 3 m square cell of tiled steps into a pool: three 0.2 m risers with dark nosing tiles down to the pool bottom, a stainless centre handrail and still water.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Skylight Ceiling
models.description: A 3 m square tiled pool hall ceiling cell with a 1.5 m square skylight: a tiled light well 0.9 m deep under a white glazing frame. It hangs 4.0 m above its origin.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Vaulted Ceiling
models.description: A 3 m tiled barrel vault for a pool hall, springing at 2.6 m from the wall faces to its crown at 4.0 m. Open at both ends so vault cells run on along a hall.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Wall
models.description: A 3 m wide, 4.05 m tall pool hall wall tiled on both faces in pale glazed tile with aqua bands near the floor and at shoulder height, and a coved tile base.

models.name: Tiled Pool Room Water Channel
models.description: A 3 m square pool hall floor cell with a 1 m wide, 0.3 m deep water channel along its middle. Aqua tiled channel, bullnosed edges and shallow still water; cells chain end to end.

models.name: Tilled Vegetable Bed
models.description: Raised bed of freshly tilled garden soil, 5.2 by 2 m. Ridged rows run along its length with darker, moister soil in the furrows, crumbly clods, pebbles and bits of straw.

models.name: Tilt-Back Tyre Changer
models.description: A garage tyre changer about 1.9 m tall, with a light grey cabinet, a turntable that spins, a swing-out bead breaker and a teal column that tilts back with a yellow mounting head. Scuffed by rubber.

models.name: Timber-Framed House
models.description: Two-storey medieval timber-framed cottage about 9 x 6 m with a jettied upper floor and a steep thatched roof. Dark oak framing over lime-washed daub, a stone chimney, shuttered windows and a lean-to woodshed; the ground floor is one furnished room you can walk into.

models.name: Timber and Sandbag Bunker
models.description: Field bunker about 4 m wide, 5 m deep and 2 m tall: timber and sandbag walls with a firing slit and a rear entrance behind a blast wall. Fits the 1 m fortification grid.

models.name: Timber Sawhorse
