models.description: A timber sawhorse about 1 m long and 70 cm tall with splayed legs. The top rail is scored with saw cuts and the wood is flecked with paint.

models.name: Tipped-Over Steel Cabinet
models.description: Tall steel medical cabinet lying tipped over on its back, about 1.8 m long. Chipped white enamel over rust, dents and grime.

models.name: Toilet
models.description: White ceramic close-coupled toilet, 0.36 m wide, 0.66 m deep and 0.79 m tall. A smooth glazed pan and cistern with a chrome dual flush button, and a white seat and lid that lift on their hinges.

models.name: Tool Chest and Bench
models.description: Workshop tool station, 2.8 m wide: a red rolling tool chest with six drawers beside a 2 m steel workbench. The bench has a vice, a pegboard of spanners, screwdrivers, pliers and a hammer under a lit shelf, and parts and oil cans below, with light grime and worn paint.

models.name: Tool Shed
models.description: Small Nordic tool shed, 3 x 2.6 m, with ledged double doors and a shed roof. Red ochre board-and-batten cladding, white trims, a green tin roof, a four-pane side window and a fieldstone plinth. The doors open onto a dark interior.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Torn Hospital Privacy Screen
models.description: Three-panel hospital privacy screen about 1.7 m wide and 1.8 m tall: a pitted chrome frame with stained, torn curtains.

models.name: Tow Truck
models.description: Generic two-axle medium tow truck, about 8.6 m long, 2.4 m wide and 3.1 m tall. White cab with a black wrecker body, a telescoping boom with a hook on the winch line, a wheel-lift underlift under the tail, diamond-plate toolboxes and amber light bars.

models.name: Towed Howitzer
models.description: Generic 155 mm-class towed field howitzer in travel pose, about 10 m long with the long barrel locked over its closed split trails. Matte olive drab with a muzzle brake, a gun shield and two road wheels, worn and dusty from the road.

models.name: Tower Crane
models.description: Generic hammerhead tower crane, about 50 m tall with a 50 m jib and a 15 m counter-jib. White lattice mast and jib on a concrete foundation, with concrete counterweights, a glazed operator cab, a trolley and a hook block, grimy from steady use on a building site.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Town Hall
models.description: Sandstone town hall, 30 x 20 m, with a six column portico and a clock tower rising to 30 m. Rusticated ground floor, tall sash windows in moulded surrounds, a dentil cornice, broad entrance steps with lantern posts, and a tower with plain lit clock dials, an open belfry and a green copper dome.

models.name: Track Curve 30°
models.description: 30 degree left-hand race track bend, 80 m radius, 12 m wide. A red and white kerb on the inside. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam. Driven the other way it is a right-hander.

models.name: Track Curve 45°
models.description: 45 degree left-hand race track bend, 50 m radius, 12 m wide. A red and white kerb on the inside. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam. Driven the other way it is a right-hander.

models.name: Track Curve 90°
models.description: 90 degree left-hand race track corner, 40 m radius, 12 m wide. Red and white kerbs at the apex and exit. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam. Driven the other way it is a right-hander.

models.name: Track Footbridge
models.description: Covered steel truss footbridge over a 20 m wide track, deck about 6 m up, with stair towers at both ends. Pale grey painted steel, a sheet roof, tread plate deck and plain colour-block banner panels along both faces, with lit strips under the roof.

models.name: Track Hairpin
models.description: 180 degree left-hand race track hairpin, 18 m radius, 12 m wide. Apex and exit kerbs and an asphalt run-off up to 6 m wide on the outside. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam.

models.name: Red-White Track Kerb
models.description: Red and white painted concrete race track kerb, 5 m long and 1 m wide. A rounded ramp up from the track to a rumble strip, with light tyre marks and worn paint. Sections tile end to end every 5 m.

models.name: Start-Finish Straight
models.description: 40 m start-finish straight, 12 m wide, with a white start line and a chequered band. Painted grid boxes for six cars face the direction the kit is driven. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam.

models.name: Track Straight 20 m
models.description: 20 m straight piece of race track, 12 m wide, with white edge lines. Grey asphalt on sloped skirts. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam.

models.name: Track Straight 10 m
models.description: 10 m straight piece of race track, 12 m wide, for filling short gaps. Grey asphalt with white edge lines. Part of the snap-together track kit: any exit joins any entry with no seam.

models.name: Tracked Infantry Fighting Vehicle
models.description: Generic tracked infantry fighting vehicle, about 7 m long and 3.7 m wide over its slat armour. Matte olive drab with a long sloped glacis, a small two-person autocannon turret and a troop compartment behind a rear ramp with its own small door, weathered and muddy low down.

models.name: Traffic Barrel
models.description: Orange road works traffic barrel, 1.0 m tall and 0.69 m wide at its rubber base ring. Moulded ribs separate four retroreflective bands in orange and white, with a hand slot on top, scuffs, tyre marks and road dirt at the foot.

models.name: Traffic Cone
models.description: Orange traffic cone, 75 cm tall, with two white reflective bands on a square black rubber base. Fluorescent orange PVC with retroreflective sleeves, a 38 cm recycled rubber base and light scuffs and road dirt from use. Origin on the ground at the centre of the base.

models.name: Traffic Light
models.description: Pedestrian crossing traffic light, 3.5 m tall, with a black three-lamp signal head on a yellow-bordered backplate. A galvanized pole on a bolted flange with a yellow push-button box at hand height. The lamps glow and can be switched one by one; the model shows red.

models.name: Traffic Mirror Post
models.description: Orange convex traffic mirrors on steel posts, 3.6 to 3.9 m tall, as a single 80 cm mirror and a double pair of 60 cm mirrors on a T arm. Sun-faded orange paint with grime streaks, a hooded frame and a dusty stainless mirror face.

models.name: Traffic Signal Mast Arm
models.description: Traffic signal mast arm, 7 m tall, with a 6 m arm over the road. A heavy dark grey steel pole on a bolted base plate carries two hooded three-lamp signal heads on yellow-bordered backplates and a blank green street name plate. The lamps glow and can be switched one by one; the model shows red.

models.name: City Tram
models.description: A 29 m three-section low-floor city tram with a cab and wrap-round windscreen at each end, double sliding doors on both sides and a pantograph on the middle section. White with a teal skirt and a dark window band, seats and grab poles inside. Standard gauge; its wheels sit on the rail kit's rails.

models.name: Wooden Utility Pole with Transformer
models.description: A 10.4 m creosoted wooden power pole at the end of a rural line, with a pole mounted transformer. Weathered, checked timber carries double crossarms, porcelain insulators, fuse cutouts and a guy wire to a ground anchor.

models.name: Travel Trailer
models.description: Rounded aluminium travel trailer, about 7 m long with its hitch and 2.9 m tall. A riveted, softly weathered skin with a slate blue skirt, a curb-side door, a striped fold-out awning, two propane bottles on the tongue and a simple lived-in interior.

models.name: Treadmill
models.description: Motorised running treadmill, 1.9 m long, with a black belt between grey foot rails. Two raked uprights carry a console with a dark screen and side handlebars with rubber grips; the screen material can be made to glow.

models.name: Sunken Treasure Chest
models.description: A 1 m iron-banded wooden chest half sunk in the silt, its barrel lid open over a heap of plain gold coins and goblets. Dark waterlogged boards, rusted bands and a few coins spilled onto the seabed; the lid swings closed on its rear hinge.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Tree Fern
models.description: Tree fern about 5 m tall with a slender fibrous trunk, dark and thickened at the foot. A spreading crown of long arching fronds sits over a skirt of dead brown fronds, with tight hairy fiddleheads uncoiling in the centre.

models.name: Tree Philodendron
models.description: A tree philodendron about 1.3 m tall for jungle floors and gardens. Broad, deeply lobed arrowhead leaves arch out from a short scarred stem with thick aerial roots.

models.name: Old Spruce Stump
models.description: Felled spruce stump, about 0.55 m high and 0.45 m across the cut, with buttressed roots. The weathered grey cut shows the notch, torn hinge fibres and the higher back cut, with growth rings and checks. Bark with peeled patches and moss at the base.

models.name: Fresh Spruce Stump
models.description: Freshly felled spruce stump, about 0.5 m high and 0.45 m across the cut. Pale fresh wood with growth rings, sawdust and beads of resin, a felling notch and torn hinge fibres. Intact scaly bark with fresh tears, resin runs and a little moss.

models.name: Truck Stop Canopy
models.description: Truck stop fuel canopy, 30 x 14 m with 5.4 m clearance over four truck lanes on a concrete pad. A white fascia with a grey band and light strip, five kerbed islands with blank diesel and DEF dispensers, hanging hoses, yellow crash guards and bollards, oil-stained concrete.

models.name: Tube Combo Guitar Amp
models.description: Tube combo guitar amplifier about 62 cm wide and 54 cm tall in black tolex with woven grille cloth, a carry handle and a chrome control panel with a red pilot light.

models.name: Harbour Tug
models.description: Harbour tug about 30 m long and 11 m wide with twin steerable stern thrusters. Dark navy hull with heavy black rubber fenders, a cream deckhouse and tall glazed wheelhouse, mustard funnels and mast, and the rust streaks and scuffs of daily ship handling. It floats with the origin at the waterline.

models.name: Tulip Cluster
models.description: A small cluster of red and yellow tulips about 50 cm tall. Cup-shaped blooms of separate petals stand above broad blue-green leaves.

models.name: Tunnel Portal
models.description: A concrete road tunnel portal with splayed wing walls and a 10 m arched liner section for a two-lane road. Battered head wall with lane signals, soot-stained lining with pale wall panels, shoulder lamps, cable trays and an emergency niche. Liner sections chain end to end.

models.name: Locomotive Turntable
models.description: A 20 m locomotive turntable: a brick-lined pit with a rotating riveted girder bridge carrying a track. It has plank walkways, railings, hand winches and a small operator's hut. The bridge rails sit at the rail kit's height, so track pieces meet the pit edge.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: TV Camera Tower
models.description: Trackside TV camera tower, a 6 m galvanized scaffold with a railed platform at 5 m. A broadcast camera with a long lens stands on a tripod under a grey tarp sunshade, with black wind scrim on three sides and an inside ladder. The camera looks out of the open front.

models.name: TV Stand With Television
models.description: Low walnut media unit, 1.6 m wide and 0.48 m tall, with a 55 inch class flat television on a centre foot. Two sliding walnut fronts with slim black finger pulls on black steel legs. The picture area is its own mesh with 0 to 1 UVs, shipped switched off in glossy black.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Twisted Liana
models.description: A woody liana about 8 m long that hangs from its top: two corky strands twisted like rope, with leafy shoots along its length.

models.name: Two-Lobed Asteroid
models.description: Elongated two-lobed asteroid about 13 m long and 6 m thick, two rocky lumps joined at a narrow waist. Dark, dusty and pitted, centred on its origin.

models.name: Two-Post Car Lift
models.description: Hydraulic two-post car lift, 3.6 m tall with 2.9 m between the columns, sized for cars and SUVs. Blue-grey columns over a chequer floor plate, anthracite swing arms with rubber pads and a power pack on one column, with light workshop grime and worn edges.

models.name: Two-Seat Restaurant Table
models.description: A two seat restaurant table, 60 by 75 cm and 76 cm tall. A honey oak print laminate top with a black edge, worn pale along the edges, stands on a black cast iron X base.

models.name: Two-Tier Bicycle Rack with Bicycles
models.description: Two-tier galvanized bicycle rack 2.5 m wide and 2.3 m tall with five step-through city bicycles parked in it in different colours. Used as one piece at a busy station or street corner.

models.name: Two-Tone Tackle Box
models.description: A scuffed plastic tackle box about 36 cm long, dark green below and grey on top, with a carry handle and a latch. The lid opens on its hinge.

models.name: Tyre and Pallet Barricade
models.description: An improvised survivor wall of stacked old tyres and wooden pallets, about 3.8 m wide and 2 m tall. Cracked rubber and grey, weathered pallet wood.

models.name: Tyre Wall Barrier
models.description: Race circuit tyre wall, a 4.0 m section about 0.9 m tall and 1.3 m deep. Old road tyres in bolted stacks four high and two rows deep, faced with a red and white conveyor belt bolted on with large washers. Sections tile every 4 m.

models.name: Tyre Machines
models.description: Tyre bay equipment: a tilt-back tyre changer, 1.9 m tall, a wheel balancer with a wheel on its shaft and a stack of used car tyres. Light grey cabinets with teal columns and arms, a yellow mounting head and rubber scuffs. Each of the three is a separate node, so they can be placed apart.

models.name: Stack of Old Tyres
models.description: Stack of four worn car tyres, 0.63 m across and 0.80 m tall, lying flat and slightly offset. Worn tread with grooves and sipes, plain sidewalls, and the lower tyres squashed a little. Dusty black rubber with dirt, scuffs and fine age cracks, no brand text.

models.name: Tyre Trolley
models.description: Two-wheel pit trolley holding a stack of four race tyres on rims, 1.5 m tall. The tyres wear dark grey quilted electric blankets with a light blue band, their leads plugged into a controller on the deep blue frame. No markings.

models.name: Umbrella Acacia
models.description: Umbrella thorn acacia of the African savanna, about 8 m tall with a crown some 10 m wide. A short trunk forks low into crooked, leaning stems under a thin, flat-topped canopy of tiny dusty olive leaves.

models.name: Unfinished Column Drum
models.description: A plain, unfluted marble column drum about 1 m tall and 1 m across, with two lifting bosses still on its sides. The stone is weathered and dusty at the foot.

models.name: Upright Book Row
models.description: A row of twelve upright books for a shelf, about 33 cm long and 25 cm tall. Cloth hardcovers and printed paperbacks of mixed heights with blank, sun faded spines and rubbed corners.

models.name: Used Car Tyre Stack
models.description: A stack of worn used car tyres, about 1.1 m tall and 1.2 m across with one leaning against it. Scuffed black rubber with tread wear.

models.name: Twin-Engine Utility Helicopter
models.description: Medium twin-engine rescue helicopter, 14.2 m long with a 13.9 m four-blade main rotor. Plain red and white with a rescue hoist over the right cabin door, a stretcher in the cabin and retractable wheels. Rotors spin, cockpit doors open, cabin doors slide and the gear retracts.

models.name: Wooden Utility Pole
models.description: Creosoted wooden power pole, 9 m tall, with a cross arm and three brown glazed insulators. A weathered pine pole with a timber arm on steel braces and a guy wire with a yellow guard to a ground anchor. No wires between poles; games can string them.

models.name: Stone Barrel Vault
models.description: Stone barrel vault ceiling segment, 4 m long and spanning 4 m, rising 2 m above the wall tops to a round crown. Courses of rough granite voussoirs in lime mortar with staggered joints, darkening toward the crown. Segments chain end to end along the vault.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Stone Vault Outside Corner
models.description: Stone cellar corner column, 0.5 m square and 4 m tall, of dressed granite quoins that close the outside corner where two vault walls meet. Its courses line up with the walls and it fills the square the walls leave open behind a room corner.

models.name: Stone Vault Doorway
models.description: Stone cellar wall module, 4 x 4 m and 0.5 m thick, with a round-arched doorway 1.2 m wide and 2.2 m tall. Granite quoins, a ring of voussoirs and a worn threshold frame a heavy oak plank door with black iron strap hinges and a ring pull. It snaps like the vault wall.

models.name: Stone Vault End Wall
models.description: Stone cellar end wall, 4 m wide and 0.5 m thick, rising to a half-round top that closes the end of a 4 m barrel vault. Rough coursed granite in lime mortar with rising damp, laid in the same courses as the vault wall it replaces.

models.name: Stone Vault Floor
models.description: Stone cellar floor module, 4 x 4 m and 0.2 m thick, of worn granite flagstones. Flags of mixed sizes sit in rows with packed dirt in the joints and grime gathering toward the edges.

models.name: Stone Vault Pillar
models.description: Square granite cellar pillar, 0.6 m across and 4 m tall, on a chamfered plinth with a simple chamfered capital. Dressed blocks in courses with crisp edges and damp at the foot. It stands centred on a grid corner, covering where two walls meet or carrying vaults.

models.name: Bank Vault Room
models.description: Steel-lined bank vault room, 6 x 5 m inside and 3.2 m high, with a round opening for a vault door. Three walls of brushed steel safe deposit boxes with brass locks, a few standing open, a steel table with an opened box, a terrazzo floor and four ceiling lights.

models.name: Stone Vault Stairs
models.description: Straight granite cellar stair, 4 m wide, rising 4 m (one storey) over a 6 m run in twenty steps. Long worn stones with hollows and rounded nosings along the walking lines. It fills a 4 x 8 m footprint, leaving a 2 m landing at the foot, and tops out flush with an upper floor.

models.name: Stone Vault Wall
models.description: Stone cellar wall module, 4 m wide, 4 m tall and 0.5 m thick, of rough coursed granite in lime mortar. Damp darkens the lowest courses below a pale tide line. All vault pieces snap on a 4 m grid from a floor-level corner, with walls standing behind the grid line.

models.name: Velvet Queue Rope
models.description: A red velvet queue rope with brass end caps and hooks, sagging between two queue posts 1.4 m apart. It hangs from hooks 0.94 m above the floor.

models.name: Vending Machine Bank
models.description: Row of three street drink vending machines and a recycling bin, 3.4 m long and 1.83 m tall. White, red and dark machines with lit display windows of blank drink dummies, glowing buttons, coin slots and pickup flaps, their painted sides scratched, stickered and rusting at the foot.

models.name: Vermilion Arched Garden Bridge
models.description: A small arched footbridge for a garden pond, about 3.1 m long, 1.1 m wide and 1.4 m high. Grey weathered plank deck between vermilion lacquered rails with bronze finials, set on low stone footings at each end.

models.name: Short Striped Sign Box
models.description: Short projecting sign box about 2 m tall in a white frame with a striped yellow and red lit face, on steel brackets. Glows at night.

models.name: Vertical Sign Set
models.description: Six building-mounted projecting signs, 1 to 6 m tall: stacked multi-tenant sign boxes, a short box and two blade signs. Blank lit panels in many colours with abstract stripes, rings and blocks, steel brackets and wall plates. They glow at night.

models.name: Stacked LED Edge Sign
models.description: Projecting sign box about 5.8 m tall with five lit panels in blank colours and patterns, edged with colour LED strips, on steel brackets. Glows at night.

models.name: Medium Stacked Tenant Sign
models.description: Projecting sign box about 4.6 m tall with four stacked lit panels in a dark frame, in blank colours with abstract rings and shapes, on steel brackets. Glows at night.

models.name: Tall Stacked Tenant Sign
models.description: Projecting sign tower about 7 m tall with six stacked lit tenant panels in blank colours with abstract stripes and blocks, on steel brackets and wall plates. Glows at night.

models.name: Viking Longship
models.description: Clinker-built Viking longship about 23 m long with high curved stems ending in plain scrolls. Tarred oak strakes, a red and cream striped square sail, round painted shields along the rails and 16 oars a side. The sail comes set and furled: hide the one you do not need.

models.name: White Village Church
models.description: Plain white Nordic village church, 24 x 11 m, with a west tower and spire 30 m tall. Lime-rendered walls on a granite plinth, a steep black roof, round-arched leaded windows and a wooden door with iron hinges. The black spire ends in a gilt ball and an iron cross.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Two-Storey Wooden House
models.description: Two-storey 1930s Nordic timber house, 10 x 8 m and 11.6 m tall. Cream-yellow lap cladding, white trims and two-pane windows, a steep dark-grey tile roof with a brick chimney, and a glazed front porch, all on a stone plinth. Curtains hang behind dark glass.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Village Grocery Shop
models.description: One-storey village grocery shop, 14 x 10 m and 5.6 m tall, with a glazed shopfront. Pale panel boards with white trim, shelves of goods behind the glass, a blank green sign board and a green canopy with lit downlights. A loading door and a heat pump at the back.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Village Well
models.description: Round fieldstone village well 1.8 m across with dressed coping, a moss line and a worn step. Two oak posts carry a small shingled roof and a winch drum with a crank, and a wooden bucket hangs on its rope over the open shaft.

models.name: Vine Swag
models.description: A leafy vine slung between two points 3 m apart, sagging 1.5 m, with short strands hanging from the swag. Both ends sit at the same height, the second one along +x.

models.name: Vintage Propeller Fighter
models.description: Original 1940s-style single-seat piston fighter, about 9.5 m long with an 11.1 m wingspan. Worn olive drab over light grey with chipped paint and exhaust stains, a rounded elliptical wing, a framed sliding canopy and a three-blade propeller. It rests nose-up on its tailwheel.

models.name: Violet Crystal Cluster
models.description: A cluster of glowing violet crystals 26 cm tall growing from a lump of dark rock. Light seems to come from inside each translucent point.

models.name: Violet Potion Flask
models.description: A long-necked round flask, about 22 cm tall, half full of glowing violet brew and stopped with a cork. The hand-blown glass is a little uneven.

models.name: Walk-In Cooler
models.description: A 3 x 2.4 m walk-in cold room built from white insulated panels, 2.4 m tall, with a condensing unit on the roof. A heavy door with a lever latch and a dial thermometer opens onto a clear strip curtain, chrome wire shelving stocked with cartons and an evaporator inside.

models.name: Pedestrian Crossing Signal
models.description: Pedestrian crossing signal, 3.3 m tall, on a black steel pole. A hooded two-section head shows a raised hand above a walking figure, both made of LED dots that glow, with a push-button unit at hand height. The model shows the hand lit.

models.name: Long Sagging Cable Bundle
models.description: A long bundle of mixed power and data cables sagging between two rusty wall brackets. Tape wraps, grime and rain streaks make it fit any worn back alley wall.

models.name: Short Sagging Cable Bundle
models.description: A short run of bundled cables dipping between two wall clamps. Good for filling gaps between doors and windows on dirty city walls.

models.name: Wall Clock
models.description: Round wall clock, 30 cm across and 4 cm deep, in a plain modern style. A matte black case, a white face with simple tick marks and no numerals, black hands, and a red second hand. The hands are separate parts that can be set to any time.

models.name: Wall Exhaust Fan
models.description: A round exhaust fan in a painted shroud on a square wall plate, behind a spoked guard. Rust runs and soot streak down from it.

models.name: Wall Lever
models.description: Medieval wall lever set in a 0.6 x 0.9 m section of dressed stone wall. A chunky forged iron lever with a worn wooden grip turns on a pinned boss in a slotted iron plate with domed bolts; rust runs down the weathered blocks.

models.name: Wall Power Socket
models.description: White earthed wall power socket, 8 cm square, with two pin holes and side earth clips in its recess. Sits low on a plastered wall above the skirting.

models.name: Wall Torch Bracket
models.description: Forged iron wall bracket holding an unlit pitch torch, about 0.55 m tall and 0.2 m deep. A scrolled back plate and two rings hold a tapered wooden shaft with a charred rag head. A separate emissive flame card sits above it: hide it for an unlit torch.

models.name: Walnut Ceiling Fan
models.description: A five blade ceiling fan about 1.3 m across, with walnut blades on aged brass irons and an opal glass light under the hub. Hangs from its origin on the ceiling; the blades spin.

models.name: Two-Door Wardrobe
models.description: Two-door wardrobe, 2.0 m tall, 1.0 m wide and 0.6 m deep, in matt white. Flush doors with slim brushed steel bar handles on a recessed plinth, with a hat shelf and a hanging rail inside.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Steel Warehouse
models.description: Portal frame steel warehouse, 40 x 25 m and 9 m to the eaves, with three roller shutter loading doors. Light grey ribbed cladding on a dark brick plinth, a dark roof with rooflight strips, and an open interior with blue frames, high bay lamps and a sealed floor with yellow markings.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Wash Bottle
models.description: A 500 ml squeeze wash bottle, 23 cm tall, in frosted white plastic with a red screw cap and a bent delivery tube. It is half full of clear liquid.

models.name: Washing Machine
models.description: Freestanding front loading washing machine, 0.6 m wide and 0.85 m tall. White enamel with a plain control panel, program dial and dark display, a round door with tinted glass and a stainless perforated drum behind a grey rubber seal.

models.name: Public Waste Bin
models.description: Dark green public waste bin on a steel post, 0.93 m to the rim, with a domed rain hood. A 40 litre powder-coated steel bin with a black liner rim, a hood open toward the front and a blank aluminium sign plate.

models.name: Scrap Watchtower
models.description: A 9 m survivor watchtower of salvaged scaffold tube with a 3 m square lookout platform. Sandbags and mismatched sheet wall the platform under a lean to roof of rusty corrugated sheet, reached by a lashed timber ladder, with a rag flag, a spotlight and barbed wire round the base.

models.name: Water Lily Patch
models.description: Floating patch of white water lilies, about 2 x 2 m. Round, notched pads 12 to 35 cm across, glossy green with radiating veins, some yellowing and torn, with open white flowers and closed buds. Place it a few metres out from the shore.

models.name: Railway Water Tower
models.description: A 7.5 m railway water tower: a riveted iron tank of bolted, flanged plates on a red brick base with arched windows. A water crane arm with a leather hose swings out over the track, with a ladder, rim railing and a float gauge on the side.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Watering Can
models.description: A 10 litre galvanized steel watering can about 50 cm long, with a long spout ending in a rose. Dull zinc spangle, dents and soil stains.

models.name: Watermill
models.description: Two-storey stone watermill about 12 m long with a slate roof and a 5.2 m overshot timber water wheel that turns. A timber flume on trestles feeds the wheel from behind, and the mill has a loft hoist, shuttered windows, a plank door with a lantern and a spare millstone.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Wayside Shrine
models.description: Tiny roadside shrine on a granite base, 1.2 m tall: a weathered timber box with lattice doors under a green copper roof. A straw rope with paper streamers hangs across the front, with offerings of evergreen sprigs, a flask, cups, rice and coins.

models.name: Weathered Doric Column
models.description: A 5.4 m fluted Doric marble column with entasis, built of five drums under a plain cushion capital. The arrises are chipped and the stone is sun bleached, with lichen and rain streaks.

models.name: Weathered Ionic Column
models.description: A 5.4 m fluted Ionic marble column on a moulded base, with a scroll capital and egg and dart band. The stone is sun bleached and chipped, with lichen and rain streaks.

models.name: Weathered Ledger Gravestone
models.description: A flat ledger slab lying on a low stepped base over a grave, about 2 m long, 0.9 m wide and 0.4 m high. Weathered, with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front is blank and worn.

models.name: Weathered Pointed-Top Gravestone
models.description: An upright headstone with a pointed gothic arch top, about 1.3 m tall and 0.6 m wide, in dark granite. Weathered, with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front is blank and worn.

models.name: Weathered Round-Top Gravestone
models.description: A plain upright headstone with a rounded top, about 1.1 m tall and 0.7 m wide, in pale limestone. Weathered, with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front is blank and worn.

models.name: Weathered Stone Cross Gravestone
models.description: A stone cross on a stepped square plinth, about 1.3 m tall, in grey stone. Weathered, with lichen, black crust and moss toward the base; the front is blank and worn.

models.name: Adjustable Weight Bench
models.description: Adjustable gym bench, 1.4 m long, with black vinyl pads on a black steel frame. The backrest lies flat and tilts up from the seat end to an incline or upright; two small wheels at the head end and a handle at the foot end let it be rolled away.

models.name: Wheat Field Patch
models.description: Square 4 x 4 m patch of ripe wheat in rows, about 90 cm tall, that tiles edge to edge into a field. Golden straw stalks with short-bearded ears and dry, curling leaves. Copies placed on a 4 m grid join without a seam.

models.name: Wheel Balancer with Wheel
models.description: A garage wheel balancer about 1.3 m tall, with a light grey cabinet, a wheel mounted on its spinning shaft and a hood that swings up. Teal trim and rubber scuffs.

models.name: Pit Wheel Gun
models.description: Pneumatic pit stop wheel gun, 41 cm long, for a single centre-lock wheel nut. A dark housing with a blue collar, a deep steel socket, a rubber pistol grip and a short coiled air hose stub. A grip node marks the hand position.

models.name: Wheel Loader
models.description: Generic mid-size articulated wheel loader, about 8 m long with the bucket down and 3.4 m tall to the cab roof. Bright yellow with grey running gear, a wide general purpose bucket on lift arms, big lugged earthmover tyres and a glazed cab, dusty and scuffed from yard work.

models.name: Wheelbarrow
models.description: Single-wheel wheelbarrow, 1.5 m long, with a galvanized steel tub, wooden handles and green tubular legs. The tub leans out over a 39 cm pneumatic wheel; inside it is scuffed and crusted with dried soil, with a little rust. The wheel spins.

models.name: Wheelchair
models.description: A modern folding manual wheelchair with a graphite frame, cross brace and padded seat and back. Spoked 24 inch rear wheels with alloy hand rims and wheel locks, swivelling front castors, desk arms and flip up footplates.

models.name: White Data Outlet
models.description: A white network data outlet on a square 9 cm wall plate, with one square jack module standing proud of the plate.

models.name: White Display Plinth
models.description: A white lacquered gallery plinth, 50 cm square and 1 m tall, with a shadow gap at the floor. Made to stand a sculpture or an object on.

models.name: White Double Light Switch
models.description: A white two gang light switch on a square 9 cm wall plate, with two narrow rockers tipped opposite ways.

models.name: White Double Wall Socket
models.description: A white double power socket on a 15 by 9 cm wall plate. Two round socket faces stand proud of the plate.

models.name: White Enamel Mug
models.description: Off-white enamel camp mug about 9 cm tall with chipped edges. Sized for a kitchen table or cabin shelf.

models.name: White Kitchen Wall Cabinet
models.description: Kitchen wall cabinet 0.6 m wide, 0.72 m tall and about 0.35 m deep, made to hang with its underside at 1.45 m. Matt white slab door that opens, with a steel bar handle.

models.name: White Kitchen Wall Cabinet 2
models.description: Kitchen wall cabinet 0.6 m wide, 0.72 m tall and about 0.35 m deep, hung with its underside at 1.45 m. Matt white slab door that opens, with a steel bar handle hinged on the other side.

models.name: White Light Switch
models.description: A white rocker light switch on a square 9 cm wall plate, the wide rocker tipped slightly in its raised surround.

models.name: White Panel Radiator
models.description: A white double panel radiator 1 m wide and 60 cm tall, standing on the floor against a wall. Corrugated front, top grille and a thermostatic valve with pipes down to the floor.

models.name: White Paper Lantern String
models.description: A sagging cord of white paper lanterns, about 3.7 m long. Ribbed paper with black lacquered rims and blank faces, lit from inside at night. Ends in a hook and a ring so strings chain together.

models.name: White Roller Blind
models.description: Roller blind about 1.2 m wide for a 1 m house kit window, mounted on the wall over the opening. The fabric and bottom bar hang about 1 m and can be rolled up or down.

models.name: White Street Bollard
models.description: A white steel bollard about 0.9 m tall with a red reflective band, for kerbs, crossings and alley mouths. The paint is chipped to rust and grey with road spray.

models.name: White Wall Socket
models.description: A white single power socket on a square 9 cm wall plate, with a round socket face standing proud of the plate.

models.name: Wi-Fi Router
models.description: A black wireless router, 23 by 15 cm, with four hinged antennas tilted back. It has a perforated top, a row of status lights at the front, and network ports and a power jack at the back.

models.name: Wildflower Patch
models.description: Square 70 cm patch of short meadow grass with ox-eye daisies, yellow buttercups and a few red clovers, up to 50 cm tall. Every stem grows from inside the square, so copies on a 70 cm grid join edge to edge; the longest blades lean about 25 cm over the edges.

models.name: Wind Turbine
models.description: Three-blade wind turbine with a 90 m tapered steel tower and a rotor about 94 m across. Off-white paint with light grime near the ground, a rounded nacelle with a red aviation light, and a steel stair up to the tower door on a concrete footing.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Tower Windmill
models.description: Stone tower windmill about 18 m tall to the top of its cap, with four lattice sails 24 m across. A tapering rubble-stone tower with small windows and a plank door, a timber gallery on struts, and a white boarded cap with a tail pole.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Winners Podium
models.description: Three-step winners podium, 4.2 m wide, on an 8 x 4.5 m stage with a backdrop and three cup trophies. White steps with gold, silver and bronze stripes, a carpeted stage and a blue backdrop with a chequer band on box-truss towers. No text or numbers.

models.name: Winners Podium Stage
models.description: Three-step winners podium, 4.2 m wide, on an 8 x 4.5 m carpeted stage with side steps and a blue backdrop with a chequer band on box-truss towers. White steps with gold, silver and bronze stripes, no text.

models.name: Winter Village Oil Painting
models.description: A winter village oil painting, 70 by 50 cm, in a plain aged oak frame. Snowy cottages with warm lit windows, bare trees and a frozen pond at dusk.

models.name: Wire Shopping Trolley
models.description: Supermarket shopping trolley about 1.1 m long and 1 m to the handle, a chrome tube chassis, tapered wire basket with a swinging rear gate, red handle grip and bumpers, and four grey swivel casters.

models.name: Wireless Earbuds Case
models.description: A glossy white charging case for wireless earbuds, 6 cm wide, with one earbud lying beside it. A small status light glows on the front.

models.name: Witch Broom
models.description: Besom broom of birch twigs on a gnarled wooden handle, 1.50 m long. About two hundred twigs flare from two twine lashings to a 0.31 m wide brush, on a crooked, knotty handle polished where it is held. It stands upright on its twigs.

models.name: Witch Hat
models.description: Black felt witch hat, 0.47 m across, with a wide wavy brim and a tall crown bent over at the tip. Soft pressed felt with a stitched brim edge, a dark ribbon band and a plain square metal buckle. Open underneath to fit a head.

models.name: Wizard Staff
models.description: Wizard staff, about 1.85 m tall. A thick, gnarled hardwood staff with knots and branch stubs that swells into a burl head, where twisted, knotted prongs curl over a large faceted crystal glowing blue. Carved sigil bands inlaid with silver and a silver shoe.

models.name: Wizard Tower
models.description: Crooked wizard's tower, 22 m tall: a leaning round tower of grey stone with small lit windows, a jettied timber-framed top storey and a steep slate witch-hat roof whose tip bends over. Stone steps wind up the outside to a first floor door.

models.name: Cast-Iron Wood Stove
models.description: Black cast-iron wood stove on short legs, 0.8 m tall with a flue pipe rising another 1.2 m. A hinged door with sooty glass, an ash pan below it and a fire glowing behind the glass. The door opens on its hinge and the fire can be hidden.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Wooden Amphora Rack
models.description: A 1.45 m wooden plank rack about 0.8 m tall, holding two terracotta amphorae in its holes with the middle hole empty. The wood is grey and weathered.

models.name: Wooden Apple Bucket
models.description: A stave-built wooden bucket with iron hoops and a handle, heaped with red and yellow apples. It stands 37 cm tall with the heap.

models.name: Oak Barrel
models.description: Oak barrel with six iron hoops, 0.90 m tall and 0.70 m across the bilge. Twenty bulging staves with dark joints, rusted black iron hoops with rust running down the staves, a wooden bung and a weathered five-board head as the lid.

models.name: Wooden Baseball Bat
models.description: An 86 cm (34 in) ash baseball bat lying on the ground. Oiled wood with a straight grain, ball marks on the barrel and grip wear and pine tar on the handle.

models.name: Pine Bed
models.description: Low single bed in oiled pine, 2.0 m long and 0.95 m wide, in a simple cabin style. A plank headboard and footboard, a ticking mattress, a red and cream striped wool blanket turned down at the top and a soft, slightly sagging pillow.

models.name: Pine Spindle-Back Chair
models.description: Pine kitchen chair with a spindle back, 0.90 m tall with the seat at 0.45 m, in a Nordic cabin style. A worn oiled seat on turned legs with stretchers, five turned spindles and a curved top rail. Matches the pine kitchen table.

models.name: Wooden Crate
models.description: Nailed pine plank crate, 60 cm on each side. Two-board walls with corner battens, a two-board lid and bottom. Slightly weathered pine with drying checks, knots, rusty nail heads and soil splash along the lower edges.

models.name: Wooden Footbridge
models.description: Small wooden plank footbridge, 4 m long and 1.2 m wide, for crossing a ditch or stream. Grey weathered planks on two log stringers resting on log sills, with a simple handrail along one side. Drying checks, moss on the ends and damp dark undersides.

models.name: Wooden Farm Gate
models.description: Wooden farm gate, 3 m wide and 1.25 m tall, hung between two square posts (3.34 m overall). Five rails and a diagonal brace in grey weathered softwood with drying checks and algae, black iron strap hinges, bolts and a latch bar.

models.name: Wooden Interior Door
models.description: Four-panel interior door, 0.9 x 2.1 m, with raised and fielded panels in muted blue-green paint, set in an off-white frame with moulded casings and plinth blocks. Brass butt hinges and an aged brass lever on a keyhole backplate; paint chipped on the knocks and grubby round the handle.

models.name: Wooden Lake Jetty
models.description: Weathered wooden jetty, 9.7 m long and 1.6 m wide, running out over the water from the bank. Grey, checked deck planks with gaps on round piles with a slimy band below the water line, a swim ladder, a mooring post and a coiled rope. The water level is at the origin height.

models.name: Wooden Ladder
models.description: Straight wooden ladder, 3 m long with 10 round rungs, 0.46 m wide at the feet tapering to 0.38 m. Weathered spruce rails with checks and knots and wedged rung ends. The feet are darker and greener from wet ground and the rung tops worn pale by boots.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Corner
models.description: A corner of sharpened log palisade that turns 90 degrees, about 2.9 m on each side and 3.4 m tall. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails, on a 4 m module.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Gate
models.description: A 4 m palisade gateway with two log doors that swing open under a timber frame, about 5.8 m tall. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails, on a 4 m module.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Straight
models.description: A straight 4 m run of sharpened log palisade, about 3.4 m tall above its earth bank. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails, on a 4 m module.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Walkway
models.description: A raised timber walkway with a ladder, 4 m long and about 2.8 m high, that stands behind a palisade wall so defenders can look over it. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails, on a 4 m module.

models.name: Wooden Palisade Watchtower
models.description: A square log watchtower about 4.2 m wide and 10 m tall, with a lookout platform under a shingled roof, built into a palisade wall. Weathered oak logs set in an earth bank, tied by pegged rails, on a 4 m module.

models.name: Wooden Pallet
models.description: Standard European wooden pallet, 1200 x 800 x 144 mm, with the real board layout. Rough sawn pine with saw marks, nail heads over the blocks, scuffs on top and soil on the bottom.

models.name: Grey Weathered Pallet
models.description: Grey, sun-weathered European wooden pallet, 1200 x 800 x 144 mm, with broken board ends. Silver-grey pine with checks, saw marks, nail heads, trodden dirt on top and soil underneath; three boards have splintered, broken-off ends.

models.name: Wooden Venetian Blind
models.description: A wooden venetian blind, 1.2 m wide and about 1.4 m drop, with tilted oak slats on cloth ladder tapes under a matching valance. Pull cords and a tilt wand hang at the sides.

models.name: Wooden Water Tub
models.description: A stave-built wooden tub 60 cm across and 34 cm tall, bound with two iron hoops and filled with water.

models.name: Car Workshop
models.description: Two-bay car repair workshop, 16 x 12 m, with roller doors, an inspection pit and a glazed office. Steel portal frame, block plinth, grey cladding, rooflights, LED strip lights and an oil-stained floor inside. Roller door curtains roll up by scaling their node to zero height.
models.changes: Fixed flickering where overlapping surfaces shared the same plane.

models.name: Wrapped Pallet Load
models.description: A stretch wrapped load of cartons on a euro pallet, about 1.2 x 0.8 m and 1.3 m tall, ready to go into a rack or onto a truck.

models.name: Abandoned Ambulance
models.description: An abandoned box-body ambulance, about 6.5 m long, left on flat tyres. Grimy white with faded plain red stripes, broken lamps and glass, and the rear doors standing open on a ransacked interior with a toppled stretcher, emptied cabinets and litter.

models.name: Rusted City Bus Wreck
models.description: Rusted wreck of a 12 m low-floor city bus with a sagging roof, sitting on flat tyres. Faded green and cream paint, missing side panels over the bare frame, broken windows, stripped seats and bent grab poles inside, and a middle door jammed open.

models.name: Rusted Pickup Wreck
models.description: A rusted-out long-bed pickup wreck, about 5.3 m long, sunk on four flat tyres. Faded green and cream paint eaten through by rust, a cracked windscreen, smashed side glass, a torn bench seat, a rotted bed side and a tailgate hanging open.

models.name: Burnt-Out Sedan
models.description: Burnt-out four-door saloon, 4.6 m long, sitting on its bare rims. Scorched and blistered shell with blue paint left only low down, glass gone or shattered, seats burnt to springs, bonnet open over a rusted engine and doors that still swing.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Corner Wall
models.description: An L-shaped office partition corner with two 2.4 m arms, 2.75 m tall, in faded yellow wallpaper. Water marks, peeling seams and a steel guard on the outer corner.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Dark Ceiling
models.description: A 2.4 m square cell of stained suspended office ceiling with a dead fluorescent panel and one tile missing, pushed up into the dark void. It hangs 2.7 m above its origin.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Doorway
models.description: A 2.4 m office partition with an empty 0.95 by 2.1 m doorway in a painted steel frame. The door is gone; only its hinge leaves and strike plate remain.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Floor
models.description: A 2.4 m square cell of damp tan yellow office carpet with dark wet blooms and tide marks. Laid cells join into an endless floor.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Lit Ceiling
models.description: A 2.4 m square cell of stained suspended office ceiling with a buzzing fluorescent panel lit in its middle. It hangs 2.7 m above its origin.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Pillar
models.description: A 0.6 m square office column 2.75 m tall, papered in faded yellow wallpaper, with steel corner guards and a blank fire alarm call point.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze T-Junction Wall
models.description: A T-shaped office partition junction, 4.8 m across with a 2.4 m branch, 2.75 m tall. Faded yellow wallpaper with water marks, peeling seams and power sockets.

models.name: Yellow Office Maze Wall
models.description: A 2.4 m wide, 2.75 m tall office partition in faded yellow wallpaper on both faces. Water marks, rising damp, a peeling seam, a power socket and a rubber skirting.

models.name: Yellow Taxi Cab
models.description: Generic full-size four-door sedan taxi, 5.05 m long and 1.87 m wide, in taxi yellow. A black checker band along the doors, a blank light box on the roof and a plain door panel for a fleet number. Wheels and the left-hand-drive steering wheel turn.

models.name: Yellow Vase Sponge
models.description: Small yellow vase sponge about 23 cm tall, a cluster of porous tubes open at the top. Grows on reefs and rocky seabeds.

models.name: Yield Sign
models.description: Nordic yield (give way) sign, a 90 cm point-down triangle on a 2.4 m galvanized post. Red border and yellow reflective field, no text, on an aluminium blank with a bare aluminium back.

models.name: Young Bamboo Clump
models.description: A young clump of bamboo about 3 m tall. Slim green culms, some still wrapped in papery sheaths, arch under sprays of narrow leaves.

models.name: Young Corn Row
models.description: A 4 m row of young field corn about 75 cm tall. Broad arching green leaves grow from short stalks, and rows join end to end without a seam.

models.name: Young Potato Plant
models.description: Hilled potato mound about 85 cm long with young leafy shoots about 15 cm tall coming through the soil.

models.name: Young Pumpkin Vine
models.description: Young pumpkin vine about 60 cm long with a few lobed leaves and two orange flowers.

models.name: Young Norway Spruce
models.description: Norway spruce sapling, about 3.3 m tall, with dense regular whorls of branches down to the ground and a fresh green leader.

models.name: Young Tomato Plant
models.description: Young tomato transplant about 50 cm tall tied to a short garden cane, with yellow flowers opening.
